Workers in the Eastern District", purporting to have
emanated from the "Strike Committee of the Shanghai
Eastern District British American Tobacco Company No.3"
were found by the Municipal Police on November 22, 1934

除了谴责所谓的对工人的压迫外，该传单还敦促工人无视国民党在近期劳资纠纷中的调解，并等待“红色”工会的指导以推进其斗争。

November 20, 1934. Morning Translation.
China Times and other local newspapers
DISPUTE AT THE B.A.T. NO. 3 FACTORY
The "go-slow" strike of about 400 workers of the Rolled Tobacco Department of the British-American Tobacco No. 3 Factory on Thorburn Road has affected about 3,200 workers of other departments.
It is understood that the workers have submitted a petition for assistance to the local Tangpu and other political organs. Yesterday morning representatives of the workers were also detailed to call on Yuan Lee Tung (袁履登) at the American Tobacco Company and to request him to mediate with a view to preventing the dispute from being prolonged.
Metropolis (大都会), a mosquito paper, dated Nov. 13:
IMPROVEMENT OF TRAFFIC REGULATIONS IN FOREIGN SETTLEMENTS & CHINESE CONTROLLED TERRITORY
The municipal administrations in Chinese controlled territory and the foreign Settlements are independent. Drivers are greatly troubled as they have to observe the traffic regulations of Chinese controlled territory and the foreign Settlements, besides paying the necessary licence fees for the districts in which their vehicles have to operate.
It is now learned that the Shanghai City Government has considered that such conditions must be improved, and has presented the question of joint traffic regulations to the S.M.C. The other day representatives of various districts in Chinese controlled territory and the foreign Settlements held a meeting at which the introduction of improvements on such conditions was regarded as an important problem. A decision to adopt adequate measures will be reached after the problem has been discussed for a certain time, and these measures will be put in force as soon as they have been ascertained.
Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:
CHINESE DEPORTEES FROM JAPAN
At 4 p.m. yesterday a further 3 Chinese deportees from Japan arrived at Shanghai on board the Japanese steamer "Chikuba Maru". They are now residing at the Lau Kung Hsin (老公信) Lodging House in Nantao.

华界市政当局与外国租界各自独立。司机们深感困扰，因为他们除了要缴纳车辆运营所在区域的必要执照费外，还必须遵守华界和外国租界的交通法规。
现获悉，上海市政府认为此种状况必须改善，并已就联合交通法规一事向工部局（S.M.C.）提出。日前，华界各区及外国租界的代表举行会议，认为改善此类状况是一个重要问题。待对该问题进行一段时间的讨论后，将决定采取适当措施，并在确定后立即实施。

自日本被遣返的中国人
昨天下午4时，又有3名自日本被遣返的中国人乘坐日本轮船“筑波丸”号（Chikuba Maru）抵达上海。他们目前居住在南市老公信旅馆。

November 15, 1934. Morning Translation.

Shanghai Evening News and other local newspapers :-

B.A.T. NO.3 FACTORY WORKERS DECLARE GO-SLOW STRIKE

At 6 p.m. last Friday while a worker of the Rolled Tobacco Department of the B.A.T. No.3 Factory on Thorburn Road was leaving the factory carrying some thick clothes, he was suspected by a White Russian inspector who was on duty at the gateway for the purpose of searching workers leaving the factory.
The Russian inspector threw the worker's clothes on the ground at which he protested. As a result, a quarrel took place and the worker was kicked and knocked down by the inspector. Furthermore the inspector reported the matter to the management who dismissed the worker.
Indignant at the part played by the Russian inspector, the 300 workers of the Rolled Tobacco Department refused to enter the factory on the morning of November 13 and declared a go-slow strike as a warning to the management.
Following the go-slow strike, the work of the workers in other departments has been affected and over 3,600 have suspected work since the morning of November 14.
On November 14 the workers detailed representatives to call on the general manager of the factory requesting him to deal with the Russian inspector, but no result was reached up to noon November 14.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

BAN ON THE MIN CHUNG CONSTRUCTION COMPANY

The Bureau of Social Affairs yesterday noticed an advertisement in the Sin Wan Pao and the Shun Pao inserted by the Min Chung Construction Company Limited (民衆建築公司) inviting the public to become shareholders. The advertisement was worded in a manner liable to deceive the people.
Upon noticing this advertisement, the Bureau of Social Affairs, on the one hand, issued an instruction to the promoters of the Min Chung Construction Company including one named Yih Wen Wei (叶文蔚) ordering them to cease inviting the purchase of shares at once and to apply for registration, and on the other, ordered local newspapers to refrain from publishing the advertisement of the Company in question.
With a view to increasing the efforts to suppress unregistered banks and companies, the Bureau of Social Affairs recently sent a letter to local newspapers with a request that before publishing the advertisements of banks or companies, the newspaper offices must ask them to show registration certificates. In the case of a preparatory office of a bank or a company wishing to insert an advertisement in the newspapers, the latter must ask for the production of a document of evidence issued by the Bureau of Social Affairs.

《上海晚邮报》及其他本地报纸：

英美烟草三厂工人宣布怠工罢工

上周五下午6时，当韬宾路英美烟草三厂卷烟部的一名工人携带一些厚衣服离开工厂时，被一名在门口执勤、负责搜查离厂工人的白俄巡捕怀疑。
该俄籍巡捕将工人的衣服扔在地上，工人对此提出抗议。结果发生争吵，工人被巡捕踢倒并打倒在地。此外，巡捕将此事报告管理层，管理层遂将该工人解雇。
工人们对该俄籍巡捕的行为感到愤怒，卷烟部300名工人于11月13日上午拒绝进厂，并宣布实行怠工罢工，以此向管理层发出警告。
继怠工罢工之后，其他部门工人的工作也受到影响，自11月14日上午以来，超过3,600人停工。
11月14日，工人派出代表拜见工厂总经理，要求他处理该俄籍巡捕，但截至11月14日中午，未达成任何结果。

《晨报》及其他本地报纸：

取缔民众建筑公司

社会局昨日注意到，《新闻报》和《申报》上刊登了民众建筑有限公司（Min Chung Construction Company Limited）邀请公众入股的一则广告。该广告的措辞具有欺骗民众之嫌。
社会局注意到此广告后，一方面向民众建筑公司的发起人（其中包括一名叫叶文蔚（Yih Wen Wei）的人）发出指令，命令他们立即停止招揽购股并申请注册；另一方面，命令本地报纸不得刊登该公司的广告。
为了加大取缔未注册银行和公司的力度，社会局最近致函本地报纸，要求报社在刊登银行或公司广告前，必须要求其出示注册证书。如果是银行或公司的筹备处希望在报纸上刊登广告，后者必须要求其出示由社会局出具的证明文件。

B.A.T. NEW FACTORY & DESCHARGED WORKERS

Owing to business depression, the B.A.T.
New Factory is working three days per week. Recently
over 250 workers of the Printing Department of the
Factory were discharged. The worjers made a report
to the 5th District Rolled Tobacco Workers Union which
detailed representatives to open negotiations with the
Company. As a result the Company has agreed to

英美烟草新厂与被解雇工人

由于商业萧条，英美烟草新厂每周仅工作三天。最近，该厂印刷部250多名工人被解雇。工人们向第五区卷烟业工会报告，工会派出代表与公司进行谈判。结果，公司同意向服务满一年以上的工人发放相当于15天工资的退职金，向服务满两年以上的工人发放一个月工资的退职金。工人们对该安排表示满意。退职金已于8月14日和15日发放。

Labour

B.C.C. "New" Factory - Workers dismissed from
Printing Department

284 workers in the Printing Department of the
B.C.C. "New" Factory, Pootung, whose service with the
Company was less than 7½ years, were dismissed on
August 8. All of them were paid retiring gratuities
in accordance with their length of service (15 days'
wages to those who complete one year's service) in
addition to their wages, deposits and annual bonus.
According to the Management, the step was adopted owing
to trade depression.

China Merchants' Steam Navigation Company
- Compradores reject demand of tallymen

In connection with the demand of the tallymen of
the China Merchants Steam Navigation Company for a flat
increase of $8 in wages, it is learned that the Chung Hwa
Navigation Mutual Aid Society (Compradores) to which the
China Merchants Steam Navigation Company referred the
demand sometime ago for comment, has replied to the effect
that the increase is unreasonable on the grounds that the
wages of the tallymen in question are already higher than
those of men employed in similar capacities in other
companies. In consequence of this comment, the China
Merchants Steam Navigation Company has applied to the
Ministry of Communications for instruction.

浦东英美烟草公司（B.C.C.）“新”厂印刷部的284名工人，因在公司服务不满7年半，于8月8日被解雇。除工资、押金和年终奖金外，所有人均根据其服务年限领取了退职金（服务满一年者发给15天工资）。据管理层称，采取此举是由于贸易萧条。

招商局轮船公司——买办拒绝理货员的要求

关于招商局轮船公司理货员要求统一增加8美元工资一事，据悉，招商局此前曾将此要求转交中华航业互助会（买办组织）征求意见，该会回复称，鉴于相关理货员的工资已高于其他公司同类职位人员的工资，因此加薪要求不合理。鉴于此意见，招商局轮船公司已向交通部请示指示。

Labour

B.C.C. "New" Factory - unrest among workers in Tin Foil Room
Unrest now exists among the 130 workers in the Tin Foil Room of the B.C.C. "New" Factory, Pootung, who are agitating against a decision of the Management to abolish their monthly bonus with effect from August. The 5th District Cigarette Workers' Union, Pootung, is endeavouring to negotiate with the management over the matter in compliance with a request of the operatives concerned. It is learned that the step was taken by the management owing to trade depression.

Toilet Articles Trade - agitation of unemployed hands
At 7 p.m. August 4, a party of unemployed hands, numbering some thirty, called at the 1st District Toilet Articles Factory Workers' Union, 26 Pao An Road, Nantao, with the object of demanding that arrangements be made to secure employment for them. In view of the absence of responsible members, the callers started to create a disturbance and damaged some furniture in the Union. Further trouble was prevented by Chinese Police who succeeded in arresting one of the agitators.
The Union in question has decided to request the local Tangpu to deal with the matter.

Representatives to International Labour Conference - arrive at Shanghai
A party of seven Chinese representatives who attended the International Labour Conference at Geneva arrived at Shanghai from Europe on August 4. They took up their residence in the Chung Kuo Hotel, corner of Kweichow and Ningpo Roads.

化妆品行业——失业工人的骚动
8月4日晚7时，一群约三十人的失业工人前往位于南市保安路26号的第一区化妆品厂工人工会，要求安排就业。由于负责人不在，来访者开始闹事，并损坏了工会的一些家具。中国警察阻止了进一步的骚乱，并成功逮捕了一名煽动者。

have requested the Third Branch Citizens Federation for
assistance. The Federation, on July 23, detailed
representatives to submit an appeal to the Bureau.
They were promised that the order would be withdrawn.
Some 50 merchants held a meeting in the
Citizens Federation Branch yesterday at which it was
decided to detail representatives to open negotiations
with the parties concerned, to secure evidence of the
fact that the land along the bank had been bought by
merchants. The Authorities will be requested to give
some consideration to the hardships of the merchants and not
to demolish immediately the houses on that part of the
land which is not private-owned.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:
THE B.A.T. WORKERS

The entire body of strikers of the British-
American Tobacco New Factory have returned to work.
The issuing of three months' wages, the savings and
retained wages of the workers of the Old Factory was
completed on July 26 and 27.
At 8 a.m. July 29 the local Tangpu and other
political organs will pay each worker a sum of $6r
as relief fund for the period of the strike. The
payment will be made at the Yang Ching Miao Temple
( 洋廟 ) on Ching Juan Road, Lai Nyi Bro. Police
officers of the Public Safety Bureau will members
of the Volunteers Corps will be in attendance to afford
protection.

曹家渡商人举行紧急会议

工务局区办事处已通知曹家渡苏州河岸的店主拆除其房屋。店主们已请求第三区分市民联合会协助。该联合会于7月23日指派代表向该局提交申诉。当局承诺将撤销该命令。
约50名商人昨日在市民联合会分会举行会议，决定指派代表与有关方面展开谈判，以获取证据证实沿河土地已由商人购买。将请求当局体谅商人的困难，不要立即拆除那些非私有土地上的房屋。

英美烟草公司工人

Unrest exists among some twenty coolies of Kiangpeh

from boats on the Soochow Creek onto Soochow Road between
Fokien and Thibet Roads, who are protesting against the
who are natives of Changshu

苏州河上从事豆粉运输的苦力——动荡

目前，约有二十名籍贯为江北（Kiangpeh，即苏北）的苦力中存在不安情绪，他们此前一直负责将豆粉从苏州河上的船只搬运至福建路与西藏路之间的苏州路上。他们抗议豆粉商自1934年6月起将此工作分配给常熟人。两派于6月6日在福建北路发生斗殴，目前双方正在第一特区地方法院进行诉讼。江北帮已向市社会局求助。

July 27, 1934. Afternoon Translation.

China Times and other local newspapers:

THE OPPOSITION TO A BOOK

With reference to the controversy over the book "Talk about Yangchow" written by Yih Chun Chu (易君左), Chief of the Book Edition and Examination Section of the Education Department of Kiangsu Province and published by the Chung Hwa Book Company, the Yangchow Fellow Countrymen's Association some time ago organized a Yangchow Fellow Countrymen "Talk about Yangchow" Investigation Committee. In addition to issuing a manifesto, the Committee submitted a petition to the authorities appealing for justice.
Subsequently the Chung Hwa Book Company persuaded Mr. Sih Tou Pih (薛篤弼), a lawyer and formerly Minister of Interior, to mediate. In compliance with the request, Mr. Sih has called on Lawyer Zeu Yu Hwa (周毓華) and other prominent Yangchow residents and submitted the following conditions in settlement of the disputes:-
1) An apology to the natives of Yangchow to be published in the newspapers.
2) The Chung Hwa Book Company and its branches to cease selling the book "Talk about Yangchow."
3) All the proceeds from the sale of the book to be devoted to the purchase of anti-cholera medicines to be distributed in Yangchow.
4) The Chung Hwa Book Company to contribute several kinds of books published by itself to the Yangchow Library.

Following the receipt of the above proposal, the Yangchow Fellow Countrymen's Association held an urgent meeting yesterday, at which it was resolved (1) to increase the number of members on the Yangchow Fellow Countrymen "Talk about Yangchow" Investigation Committee by 20 persons and (2) to await a decision of the Yangchow Various Circles "Talk about Yangchow" Investigation Committee before considering the proposal submitted by Lawyer Sih Tou Pih on behalf of the Chung Hwa Book Company.

It is reported that the Yangchow Fellow Countrymen "Talk about Yangchow" Investigation Committee will hold a meeting at 8 p.m. to-day to discuss the proposal submitted by the Chung Hwa Book Company.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :

B.A.T. OLD FACTORY PAYING OFF DISCHARGED WORKERS

The B.A.T. Old Factory yesterday issued the pay of the discharged male workers. The factory, however, issued 26 days' pay as pay for one month. The workers were dissatisfied and some trouble arose but was suppressed by the Police. Subsequently the factory issued a notice instructing the male workers of the Old Factory to call for their pay at 2 p.m. to-day when pay for 30 days as pay for one month will be issued.

《时事新报》及其他本地报纸：

反对一本书

关于江苏省教育厅图书审查科科长易君左撰写、中华书局出版的《扬州话》一书引发的争议，扬州同乡会此前组织了扬州同乡“《扬州话》调查委员会”。除发表宣言外，该委员会还向当局提交请愿书，呼吁主持公道。
随后，中华书局说服律师、前内政部长薛笃弼先生进行调解。应此请求，薛先生拜访了周毓华律师及其他扬州知名人士，并提出以下条件以解决纠纷：
1) 在报纸上刊登向扬州籍人士的道歉声明。
2) 中华书局及其分店停止销售《扬州话》一书。
3) 该书销售所得全部用于购买霍乱预防药物，并在扬州分发。
4) 中华书局向扬州图书馆捐赠其出版的多种书籍。

收到上述提议后，扬州同乡会昨日召开紧急会议，决议：(1) 将扬州同乡“《扬州话》调查委员会”委员人数增加20人；(2) 在考虑薛笃弼律师代表中华书局提交的提议之前，等待扬州各界“《扬州话》调查委员会”的决定。

据悉，扬州同乡“《扬州话》调查委员会”将于今晚8时举行会议，讨论中华书局提交的提议。

英美烟草公司老厂向被解雇工人发放薪资

英美烟草公司老厂昨日向被解雇的男工发放薪资。然而，工厂按一个月26天计算并发放薪资。工人们对此不满，引发了一些骚乱，但被警方平息。随后，工厂发布通知，指示老厂男工于今日下午2时前来领取薪资，届时将按一个月30天标准发放薪资。

Labour (4) July 27, 1934.

B.C.C. "New" Factory - situation

A further 1,740 workers of the B.C.C. "New" Factory,
Pootung, resumed work this morning, July 27, thus bringing
the complement now operating up to 3,900 hands.

At 8.30 a.m. July 26, some 800 ex-male workers of the
"Old" Factory turned up at the "New" Factory to receive their
retiring gratuities, deposit and annual bonus. An immediate
protest was raised when they were informed at the office
that in computing retiring gratuities each month was counted
as 26 days on the ground that there were 4 Sundays in a month
for which no pay was issued. An attempt was then made to
prevent the operatives in the "New" Factory from working,
but members of the Chinese Police and Paoantui posted on the
scene dissuaded the disaffected men from taking such a step
and succeeded in dispersing them by 9.30 a.m.. At 11 a.m.
the management of the B.C.C. published a notice promising to
issue the gratuities to the workers computing a month as 30
days for the purpose of paying gratuities. A total of some
300 male workers received their money in the afternoon without
further incident.

The local Kuomintang Headquarters issued a notice on
July 26 to the effect that in compliance with one of the
measures settling the strike in the "New" Factory, the workers
of the Factory in question would be paid an advance of $6.00
each as relief for the period of the strike in the Yang Ching
Temple on Station Road, Pootung, between July 29 and August 1.

英美烟公司（B.C.C.）“新”厂——局势

英美烟公司浦东“新”厂又有1,740名工人于今晨（7月27日）复工，从而使目前在职人数达到3,900人。

7月26日上午8时30分，约800名“老”厂前男工来到“新”厂领取退休酬金、存款和年终奖金。当他们在办公室得知，在计算退休酬金时每月按26天计算，理由是每月有4个星期日不发工资时，立即提出抗议。随后，这些人试图阻止“新”厂工人工作，但现场的中国警察和保安团（Paoantui）成员劝阻了这些不满分子采取此类行动，并于上午9时30分成功将他们驱散。上午11时，英美烟公司管理层发布公告，承诺在支付酬金时将每月按30天计算。下午，约300名男工领取了款项，未再发生事故。

当地国民党党部于7月26日发布通知，称作为解决“新”厂罢工的措施之一，该厂工人将于7月29日至8月1日期间，在浦东车站路（Station Road）杨庆寺每人预领6.00元，作为罢工期间的救济金。

Min Pao and other local newspapers :

THE B.A.T. WORKERS

On the instructions of the local Tangpu and
other political organs, the New Factory of the B.A.T.
Company has resumed operations.
At about 6 a.m. yesterday some 620 workers of
the Brass-smith Department, 810 workers of the Printing
Department, 300 workers of the Leaf Department and 150
workers of the Tin Foil Department reported for work.
The Bureau of Public Safety sent police to
maintain peace and order at the factory and was withdrawn
after the workers had entered the premises. The workers
of other departments will return either to-day or to-morrow.
Yesterday the factory turned away 15 workers of
the Drafting Department. The 5th District Rolled
Tobacco Workers Union has sent the following petition to
the Shanghai City Government and the local Tangpu :-
Yesterday Tsih Ching Kung (戚敬耕) and 14 other
workers of the Drafting Department came to this Union and
reported that while they were entering the factory in the
morning, a foreigner of the Drafting Department stated that
there would be no work that day. Upon being asked when they
would get work, the foreigner replied that he did not know.
The workers requested this Union to open negotiations with
the management. This Union requests that a strong
protest be lodged with the management.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers :

REGISTRATION OF MUSICAL BANDS TO BE COMMENCED AUGUST 1

The Bureau of Social Affairs has drawn up
measures for the registration of musical bands. The
measures have been approved by the Shanghai City Government.
The registration will be commenced as from August 1 and
last three months. No charge will be made for registration.
Any musical band which fails to register with
the Bureau of Social Affairs within the specified period
will be suppressed.

China Times and other local newspapers :

RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

In a circular notice sent out yesterday, the
Rent Reduction Movement Committee informed its members
that a meeting will be held at 4 p.m. July 27 when Tsau
Tse Kung (曹志功), who recently returned to Shanghai
from Nanking where he submitted an appeal to the Government
relating to the rent reduction movement, will make a report
on his mission.

At 10 a.m. July 25 three Chinese claiming to represent
the tallymen of the Nisshin Kisen Kaisha, a Japanese steam-
ship Company with offices at No.5 The Bund, called at the
Chung Hwa Seamen's General Labour Union, 33 Qong Ka Tsz
Loong, City, and appealed for assistance in demanding an

Labour

B.C.C. "New" Factory - situation

In addition to the 400 workers who resumed operation
on July 23 (Vide I.R. 28/7/34), a further 1,600 operatives
returned to work this morning, July 25.

The 5th District Cigarette Factory Workers' Union.
issued on July 24 a circular letter expressing its
appreciation to local public bodies which were in sympathy
with and rendered assistance to the workers of the Factory
in their strike.

B.C.C. Thorburn Road Factory - Transient stoppage
in the Leaf Cutting Room

As a protest against the decision of the foreign
foreman to time the absence of any worker desirous of
going to the lavatory, some 400 workers of the Leaf Cutting
Room of the B.C.C. Thorburn Road Factory, 674 Thorburn
Road, suspended operation for five minutes at 2 p.m.
July 24. This system was subsequently cancelled by the
management.

Hire Car Chauffeurs Union - Meeting

Nine committee members of the Shanghai Hire Car
Chauffeurs' Union held a meeting in their office at No.2-3
Yung Ching Li, Min Kuo Road, at 7.15 p.m. July 24 and
passed the following resolutions :-

1. That efforts be made to remove the differences of
opinion between Chen Chu-keng (陳德慶) and Chu Vee-
chong (諸維昌), two committee members of the Union.

2. That the local Chinese Authorities be requested to
negotiate with the Managements of local garages to
advance money to chauffeurs in order to enable them
to pay, when necessary, fines imposed for traffic
offences.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

THE B.A.T. WORKERS

Through the mediation of the local Tangpu and other political organs, the entire body of strikers of the British-American Tobacco New Factory made preparations for resuming operations from 7 a.m. yesterday. However, owing to the fact that more time is required by the management to make the necessary readjustments in various departments of the Factory, only about 100 operatives commenced work yesterday morning.

The 200 workers of the Leaf Department, the 400 workers of the Brass-smith Department, the 1,200 workers of the Printing Department and the 150 workers of the Tin Foil Department will resume work on July 25, the 170 operatives of the Tobacco Stemmery on July 26 and the 3,000 operatives of the Box Department and the 500 operatives of other departments on July 28.

An official of the Social Bureau accompanied by representatives of the local Tangpu and the Public Safety Bureau yesterday morning proceeded to the New Factory at Pootung to supervise the resumption of operations. Policemen of the 3rd Branch of the Public Safety Bureau were also in attendance in the vicinity of the Factory and the Wharf. About 20 other policemen were in the Union.

The local Tangpu and other political organs have approved the closing of the B.A.T. Old Factory. Each discharged worker will be given a retiring gratuity equivalent to three months' pay.

The B.A. T. Company yesterday issued a circular notice stating that the retiring gratuities, the retained wages and the savings of male workers would be issued from 8.30 a.m. to 11 a.m. July 26, those of the female workers at the same hour on July 27 and those of the staff members and foremen on July 28.

At 4 p.m. yesterday, the Strike Committee held a meeting at which 29 members were present. Chen Bei-tuh presided. It was resolved that the Strike Committee be wound up at once and that all matters be dealt with by the 5th District Rolled Tobacco Trade Workers Union.

Mayor Wu Te-chen issued the following statement yesterday:- "The labour trouble at the B.A.T. Company, which lasted about two months, arose through the closing of the Old Factory employing about 2,000 workers. Their bitter condition arising out of unemployment deserved consideration. However, both the employers and employees were firm, thereby causing a delay in the settlement of the trouble. 《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

英美烟草公司工人

经当地党部及其他政治机关调解，英美烟草公司新厂全体罢工工人已于昨晨7时起准备复工。然而，由于资方需要更多时间对工厂各部门进行必要的调整，昨晨仅有约100名操作工开始工作。

烟叶部200名工人、铜匠部400名工人、印刷部1,200名工人及锡箔部150名工人将于7月25日复工，打梗间170名操作工将于7月26日复工，装箱部3,000名操作工及其他部门500名操作工将于7月28日复工。

社会局一名官员在当地党部和公安局代表的陪同下，于昨晨前往浦东新厂监督复工情况。公安局第三分局警员也在工厂及码头附近执勤。另有约20名警员在工会内。

当地党部及其他政治机关已批准关闭英美烟草公司旧厂。每位被解雇工人将获得相当于三个月工资的遣散费。

英美烟草公司昨日发布通函，声明男性工人的遣散费、留存工资及储蓄将于7月26日上午8时30分至11时发放，女性工人的上述款项将于7月27日同一时间发放，职员及领班的款项将于7月28日发放。

昨日下午4时，罢工委员会举行会议，出席成员29人。陈北土（Chen Bei-tuh）（音译）主持。会议决定立即解散罢工委员会，所有事务由第五区卷烟业工会处理。

吴铁城市长昨日发表如下声明：“英美烟草公司的劳资纠纷持续约两个月，起因是雇佣约2,000名工人的旧厂关闭。失业导致的困苦状况值得考虑。然而，雇主和雇员双方态度强硬，导致纠纷解决延误。鉴于工人生计和社区安宁均受影响，上海

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:-

FRUIT HAWKERS APPEAL FOR RELIEF

At 1 p.m. yesterday some 100 fruit hawkers
called at the Chinese Chamber of Commerce and afterwards
at the Citizens Federation where they made an appeal
stating that the Police arrested number of licensed
hawkers because the Police had been requested by a letter
from the Second Branch of the Citizens Federation on
July 16 to suppress unlicenced sock and underwear
hawkers. These latter keep a close watch for policemen and
as soon as they notice an officer approaching, they
quickly make their escape. The Police make no distinction
between licensed and unlicensed hawkers; thus, properly
licensed hawkers have sometimes been arrested four times
a day and fined 50 cents on each occasion. They declared
that as the letter in question had been written and sent
direct to the S.M.C. by the Second Branch of the Citizens
Federation, the representatives of the appealing hawkers
had been told to open negotiations with the Branch
Federation.
Later in the day a letter was sent by the
hawkers to the Branch Federation requesting it to send
another letter to the S.M.C. suggesting that the Council
permit the 1,000 hawkers to resume their business.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :

INSPECTION OF CHINESE MERCHANT VOLUNTEER CORPS

Under the auspices of the Shanghai Municipality
Guard Committee, an inspection of Merchant Volunteer Corps
in Nantao, Yang Ching (洋泾), Fahwa (法华), Poo Soong
(浦松) and Zao Ching (漕泾) District was held at
8.30 a.m. yesterday on the Public Recreation Ground,
Nantao. Some 812 volunteers were present.
At 7 a.m. to-day an inspection of the
Merchant Volunteer Corps in Chapei, Ban Poo (彭浦),
Chenju (真茹), Kiangwan (江湾) and Woosung Districts
will take place on the Kiangwan Race Course.

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

水果摊贩呼吁救济

昨日下午1时，约100名水果摊贩前往上海总商会，随后前往市民联合会，提出申诉称：警方逮捕了数名持照摊贩，原因是市民联合会第二分会于7月16日致函要求取缔无照售卖袜子和内衣的摊贩。这些无照摊贩密切监视警察，一旦发现警员靠近便迅速逃离。警方未能区分持照与无照摊贩；因此，持有合法执照的摊贩有时一天被捕四次，每次被罚款5角。他们声称，由于该信函是由市民联合会第二分会直接写给工部局的，上诉摊贩的代表被告知应与该分会进行交涉。
当日稍晚，摊贩们致函该分会，请求其再致函工部局，建议公董局允许1,000名摊贩恢复营业。

华商义勇队检阅

在上海市政警卫委员会的主持下，昨日上午8时30分在南市公共体育场对南市、洋泾、法华、浦松（音译）及漕泾地区的华商义勇队进行了检阅。约812名队员出席。
今日上午7时，将在江湾跑马厅对闸北、彭浦、真茹、江湾及吴淞地区的华商义勇队进行检阅。

B.C.C. "New" Factory - situation
The B.C.C. "New" Factory, Footung, is working to-day

July 23, 1934. Morning Translation.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :

B.A.T. WORKERS TO RESUME WORK THIS MORNING

As a result of the mediation by the local
Tangpu and other official organs, six measures have been
drawn up to settle the dispute. In compliance with the
instructions of the authorities, the 5th District Rolled
Tobacco Workers Union has dissolved the Maintenance
Corps, the Women's Corps, and the Propaganda Corps.

The Strike Committee yesterday held its last
meeting at which the following resolutions were passed :-
1) That the Strike Committee be dissolved at once.
2) That an advertisement be published in the
newspapers thanking the various bodies.
3) That a letter be addressed to the Various
Public Bodies Support Committee embodying the conditions
of the settlement.

Yesterday the 5th District Rolled Tobacco
Workers Union issued a circular notice instructing all
the strikers of the New Factory to resume work at 7 o'clock
this morning.
Since the strike, the cigarettes of the B.A.T.
Company were boycotted in Pootung, but yesterday they were
on sale again. The transportation of B.A.T. products
will be resumed to-day.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

ROBBERY CASE AT CHI YA MOUNTAIN STATION ALONG SHANGHAI-
NANKING RAILWAY

On the morning of July 21, over ten armed
bandits entered the Chi Ya Mountain Station (棲霞山站)
of the Shanghai-Nanking Line, took away some $500 from
the station and destroyed a quantity of apparatus.
The Gendarmerie Headquarters and the Police
of the Railway Administration immediately detailed squads
of men to arrest the robbers and traces of the bandits
were discovered at the Shih San Village (攝山鎮), seven
or eight li from the Chi Ya Mountain Station. Three
bandits were killed but the rest made good their escape.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers (Nanking telegram):

In view of the robbery of the Chi Ya Mountain
Station wherein the Chief of the station was injured;
the Ministry of Railways has instructed the Shanghai-
Nanking & Shanghai-Hangchow-Ningpo Railway Administration
to pay close attention to the guarding of the lines in
future.

《晨报》及其他本地报纸：

京沪铁路栖霞山站抢劫案

7月21日上午，十余名武装匪徒闯入京沪线栖霞山站（棲霞山站），抢走站内约500元，并毁坏大量设备。
宪兵司令部与铁路管理局警察立即派出小队缉捕劫匪，并在距离栖霞山站七八里的摄山镇（攝山鎮）发现匪徒踪迹。三名匪徒被击毙，其余匪徒成功逃脱。

《晨报》及其他本地报纸（南京电）：

鉴于栖霞山站发生抢劫案且站长受伤，铁道部已指令京沪及沪杭甬铁路管理局今后密切注意线路警卫工作。

of Shanghai Various Circles to Support the Labour Friends

Local Silk Filatures - situation

Of the five filatures in the Settlement which employ
a total of 4,020 hands, two are operating with a complement
of 810 workers.

Of the 51 filatures in Chinese controlled territory
which employ 23,644 operatives, 26 are working with a com-
plement of 13,172 hands.

These filatures suspend operations in the afternoon
when the temperature reaches 95 degrees or over.

Kiangsu & Chekiang silk merchants - meeting

Some 30 persons who claimed to be silk merchants of
various places in the Kiangsu and Chekiang Provinces held
a meeting in the Shanghai Silk Filature Owners' Association,
430 North Shanse Road, between 4 and 6.30 p.m. July 22
when the depression in the trade was discussed. It was
decided to notify various filatures in Shanghai now in
operation to pay their employees at a uniform rate of $0.38
per day and to operate between 5.30 a.m. and 6 p.m. daily.
At present these filatures issue wages to their workers at
a rate ranging from $0.38 to $0.42 per day, and work varying
periods. It was also resolved to solicit assistance from
the Silk Dealers' Association as well as the bankers in
stabilizing the price of silk.

July 22, 1934. Morning Translation.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers :

BAN ON THE PUBLICATION OF THE LUNAR CALENDAR

Having learned that the Koo Lai Kee Printing Shop (顧蘭記 ) on Kwenming Road, the Liu Tuh Kee Printing Shop (刘德記 ) on Haining Road, the Liu Loh Kee Printing Shop (刘小記 ) on Sinkieng Road and the Zung Zeu Kee Printing Shop (盛寿記 ) on Soong Kung Yuen Road (宋公園路), Chapel, have been printing large numbers of the lunar calendar every year and that these shops are now printing lunar calendars for next year, the 5th District Tangpu Branch some time ago submitted a petition to the local Kuomintang Headquarters requesting that the printing of lunar calendars be suppressed. Upon receipt of the above, the Tangpu sent deputies to call at these shops and to convey verbal instructions that the printing of lunar calendars must cease. The Tangpu has also requested the Shanghai City Government to place a strict ban on the printing of lunar calendars.
The local Book Store Owners Association has been directed by the Tangpu to order book stores and printing shops not to print or sell lunar calendars. Offenders will be dealt with severely.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :

THE STRIKE OF B.A.T. WORKERS

In connection with the strike of B.A.T. workers, the local Tangpu and other political organs have drawn up six measures for a settlement of the dispute.
Yesterday morning the Strike Committee sent several representatives to call at the local Tangpu. The visitors were received by Wu Kai Sien (吴開先 ), a committee member, who explained the measures to them.
According to information secured by a reporter of the Dah Kung News Agency, the strikers will resume work to-morrow morning (July 23) while the Maintenance Corps will be dissolved this morning. The Shanghai City Government, the local Tangpu and the Bureau of Social Affairs will deal with the issuing of relief funds which will be made on Saturday or Sunday next.
It is reported that following the withdrawal of the Maintenance Corps this morning, the Public Safety Bureau will detail members to maintain peace and order at the factory gates. The Strike Committee yesterday afternoon requested the Public Safety Bureau to send policemen to guard the premises.

《晨报》及其他本地报纸：

禁止出版农历历书

获悉昆明路顾兰记印刷店（顧蘭記）、海宁路刘德记印刷店（刘德記）、新江路刘小记印刷店（刘小記）及宋公园路（宋公園路） Chapel 盛寿记印刷店（盛寿記）每年大量印刷农历历书，且这些店铺目前正在印制明年的历书，第五区党部前曾向本地国民党总部呈请，要求取缔农历历书的印刷。接到上述呈请后，党部派员前往这些店铺，口头传达必须停止印刷农历历书的指令。党部还请求上海市政府严厉禁止印刷农历历书。
本地书业同业公会被党部指令，责令书店和印刷店不得印刷或销售农历历书。违者将受到严惩。

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

英美烟草公司工人罢工

关于英美烟草公司工人罢工一事，本地党部及其他政治机构已制定六项措施以解决纠纷。
昨日上午，罢工委员会派遣数名代表前往本地党部。来访者受到委员吴开先（吴開先）的接待，吴向他们解释了各项措施。
据大公通讯社记者获得的消息，罢工工人将于明日（7月23日）上午复工，而纠察队将于今晨解散。上海市政府、本地党部及社会局将处理救济金的发放事宜，发放时间定于下周六或周日。
据报道，继今晨纠察队撤出后，公安局将派遣人员维持工厂门口的治安秩序。罢工委员会昨日下午请求公安局派遣警察守卫厂区。

July 21, 4.

Labour (4)

B.C.C. Factories - Situation - Dispute nearing
settlement

The labour dispute in the B.C.C. Factories, Pootung,
is likely to come to an end on July 23 following the
acceptance by the Strike Committee of the following revised
measures of the City Government relating to a settlement.
These measures were issued on July 20 in the form of
instructions to the 5th District Cigarette Workers' Union,
78 Lan Nyi Doo Road, Pootung :-

1. That the services of the operatives of the "Old"
Factory be dispensed with in accordance with the agreement
between employers and employees, and that the Company
issue them a gratuity equivalent to three months'
wages each, in addition to their deposit and annual
bonus.

2. That the City Government will be held responsible to
pay an advance of $6.00 each to the workers of the "New"
Factory on behalf of the Company within one week of
their resumption as relief for the period of strike,
the date and venue for this distribution to be decided
later.

3. That the operatives of the "Old" Factory be given the
first preference of employment at their former pay rate
when the concern reopens.

4. That no workers in the "New" Factory be dismissed
after their resumption.

5. That the question of the continuation of validity of
the labour agreement concluded between the employers
and employees be dealt with separately by the City
Government.

6. That the picketing corps or Maintenance Corps formed
by the strikers be dissolved forthwith.

The Strike Committee will hold a meeting of representa-
tives of the workers concerned in the present dispute on
July 22 when these measures will be referred to the attendance.
It is reported that the workers in the "New" factory are
preparing to resume operation on July 23.

劳工 (4)

英美烟草公司工厂 - 局势 - 纠纷接近解决

浦东英美烟草公司工厂的劳资纠纷可能于7月23日结束，此前罢工委员会已接受市政府发布的以下有关和解的修订措施。这些措施于7月20日以指令形式发给位于浦东兰尼杜路78号的第五区卷烟业工会：-

1. 根据雇主与雇员之间的协议，终止“旧”厂操作工的雇佣关系，公司除退还押金和发放年终奖金外，另向每人发放相当于三个月工资的遣散费。

2. 关于“新”厂工人在罢工期间的救济，市政府将代表公司在复工后一周内向每位工人预付6.00元，具体发放日期和地点稍后决定。

3. 若公司重新开业，“旧”厂操作工在同等工资水平下享有优先受雇权。

4. “新”厂工人复工后，不得无故解雇。

5. 雇主与雇员之间签订的劳工协议是否继续有效的问题，由市政府另行处理。

6. 罢工工人组成的纠察队或维持队应立即解散。

罢工委员会将于7月22日召开涉及此次纠纷的工人代表会议，届时将这些措施提交会议讨论。据报道，“新”厂工人正准备于7月23日恢复运作。

July 21, 1934. Morning Translation.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :

THE STRIKE OF B.A.T. WORKERS

In connection with the strike of B.A.T. workers, six measures have been drawn up after several mediation meetings held by Mayor Wu Te Chen, Mr. Wu Sin Ye, the Chief of the Bureau of Social Affairs, Mr. Wu Kai Sien of the local Tangpu, Mr. Doo Yueh Sung, the Shanghai General Labour Union and other local leaders.
The Shanghai City Government and the local Tangpu have instructed the employees and employers to accept the following six conditions :-
1) Regarding the discharge of workers of the Old Factory, the B.A.T. Company will issue three months pay as well as the savings and yearly bonus of the workers.
2) As regards relief for the workers of the New Factory for the period of the strike, the Shanghai City Government will issue $6 in advance to each worker within one week of the resumption of work. The date and place for the issue of the fund will be fixed later.
3) In case the Old Factory resumes operations, the discharged workers of the factory are to be first employed at their former rate of wages.
4) The B.A.T. Company will not dismiss workers of the New Factory without cause.
5) The question of the validity of the original agreement between the employees and the employers will be considered by the City Government.
6) The Picketing Corps or the Maintenance Corps organized by the strikers during the strike should be dissolved at once.

Upon receipt of the above, the 5th District Rolled Tobacco Workers Union immediately held a meeting at which the measures were brought up for discussion. It was resolved that the measures be accepted. The Union has instructed the strikers to this effect. The hands of the New Factory have decided to resume work on Monday next, July 23.
It is reported that communists are still attempting to instigate the workers but the latter are guarding themselves against being used by the communists. The strike has thus been settled.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :

THE STABBING OF AN ITALIAN SAILOR

With reference to the assaulting of a ricksha coolie by an Italian sailor, and the stabbing of the sailor by a Chinese, a suspect named Ma Tai Chang (馬泰昌) was arrested soon after the incident together with certain pieces of evidence. He was sent to the Court for trial on July 18.

1934年7月21日。晨间译文。

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

英美烟草公司工人罢工

关于英美烟草公司工人罢工一事，经过市长吴铁城、社会局局长吴醒亚先生、本地党部吴开先先生、杜月笙先生、上海总工会及其他本地领袖多次调解会议，制定了六项措施。
上海市政府和本地党部已指令雇员和雇主接受以下六项条件：-
1) 关于旧厂工人的解雇，英美烟草公司将发放三个月工资，以及工人的储蓄金和年终奖金。
2) 关于新厂工人在罢工期间的救济，上海市政府将在复工后一周内向每位工人预付6元。资金发放的日期和地点稍后确定。
3) 若旧厂恢复运营，该厂被解雇的工人将以原工资标准优先受雇。
4) 英美烟草公司不得无故解雇新厂工人。
5) 雇员与雇主之间原有协议的有效性问题，将由市政府审议。
6) 罢工期间由罢工工人组织的纠察队或维持队应立即解散。

收到上述内容后，第五区卷烟业工会立即召开会议，对这些措施进行了讨论。会议决议接受这些措施。工会已据此指示罢工工人。新厂工人已决定于下周一（7月23日）复工。
据报道，共产党人仍试图煽动工人，但工人们正警惕不被共产党人利用。罢工 thus 得以解决。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

意大利水手被刺案

关于一名意大利水手殴打人力车夫，随后该水手被一名中国人刺伤一事，嫌疑人名叫马泰昌（馬泰昌），案发后不久即连同若干证据被捕。他已于7月18日被送交法庭受审。

although a part of the operatives concerned seem to be

is of the opinion that it must struggle against the
Company at any cost in order to attain its aims. It

B.C.C. Factories - Situation

The strike situation in the B.C.C. "New" Factory,
Pootung, remains unchanged.

At 9 a.m. July 18, twelve members of the Strike
Committee, including Chen Bei-teh, appealed to the local
Tangpu for permission to allow the existence of the
Maintenance Corps. In addition, the callers requested
that the settlement of the dispute in the B.C.C. "Old"
Factory should be based upon the principles, which it is
reported have been devised by the Executive Yuan (i.e.
(a) resumption of factory operation, (b) engagement of
unemployed hands and (c) distribution of compensation).
They were received by Doong Ying-pah, committee member
of the organ who promised to deal with the dispute in
conjunction with the Bureau of Social Affairs. Similar
appeals were made to the City Government and the Bureau
in question in the same afternoon.

Cabin Boys' Guild - Meeting

Some eighty members of the Cabin Boys' Guild held
a meeting in their office at No.26 Jeu Kao Zang Ka, City,
at 3 p.m. July 18 and passed the following resolutions:-

1. That all members be instructed to register with this
Guild not later than the end of September and that a
list of all members be then forwarded to the Seamen's
General Labour Union.

2. That the Chung Hwa Seamen's General Labour Union be
requested to adopt measures to prevent the No.1
Cabin boys of certain steamers from making compulsory
deduction from tips received by members of the Guild,
as commission.

英美烟公司工厂——局势
浦东英美烟公司“新”厂的罢工局势保持不变。
7月18日上午9时，包括陈北德（音译）在内的十二名罢工委员会成员向当地党部提出申请，请求允许维持纠察队的存在。此外，来访者还请求，英美烟公司“老”厂纠纷的解决应基于据报由行政院制定的原则，即：(a) 恢复工厂运营，(b) 雇佣失业工人，以及 (c) 发放补偿金。接待他们的是该机构委员董英伯（音译），他承诺与社会局共同处理此纠纷。同日下午，他们又向市政府及该局提出了类似的请求。

舱面服务生公会——会议
7月18日下午3时，约八十名舱面服务生公会在市区九江路26号的办公室举行会议，并通过以下决议：

1. 指示所有成员不迟于9月底向本公会登记，随后将所有成员名单报送海员总工会。

2. 请求中华海员总工会采取措施，防止某些轮船的一等舱面服务生以佣金名义强制扣除公会成员收到的小费。

B.C.C. Factories - Situation
The strike situation in the B.C.C. "New" Factory,
Pootung, remains unchanged.
Three delegates of the Strike Committee, including
Chen Bei-teh, made a further appeal to the City Government
at 9 a.m. July 13 for the relief of the workers concerned
in the present dispute in the B.C.C. Pootung Factories,
and to negotiate with the Management for the reopening
of the "Old" Factory. The callers were received by
Yui Hung-chun, Secretary of the City Government, who
promised to refer their requests to the Mayor.
At 7 a.m. July 13, a party of members of the
Maintenance Corps appeared at the Wharf of the "New"
Factory, and prevented some ten Russians, who have been
in the employ of the concern since the strike, from
entering the premises. The matter was brought to the
notice of the Officer in charge 3rd District Chinese
Police Station in Pootung and through his efforts the
Russians succeeded in resuming work.

Tokwa Box Factory - Workers dismissed
The twenty-three workers in the employ of the Tokwa
Box Factory, a Japanese concern located at 510 Point Road,
were paid off on July 12 in consequence of their refusal
to obey an instruction of the Management to work faster in
order to complete orders in hand. Six Chinese females were
engaged in their place to carry on the work in the morning
of July 13. These new hands however failed to turn up in
the afternoon as a result of intimidation by old operatives,
and are still out this morning, July 14.

浦东英美烟公司“新”厂的罢工局势保持不变。
7月13日上午9时，包括陈北德（音译）在内的三名罢工委员会代表再次向市政府提出呼吁，要求救济目前卷入浦东英美烟公司纠纷的相关工人，并与管理层谈判以重新开放“老”厂。接待来访者的是市政府秘书长俞鸿钧，他承诺将他们的请求转呈市长。

德和盒厂——工人被解雇
位于宾乐路510号的日商德和盒厂（音译）的二十三名工人，因拒绝服从管理层为完成手头订单而加快工作速度的指令，于7月12日被结清工资解雇。7月13日上午，六名中国女工被雇用以接替工作。然而，由于受到老工人的恐吓，这些新工人下午未能上班，直至今天（7月14日）上午仍未复工。

Labour

China Merchants Steam Navigation Co. Tallymen - Unrest

Some thirty members of the China Merchants Steam
Navigation Co.'s Tallymen's Guild, held a meeting in their
office at 11 Foh Yeu Li, Foh Yeu Road, City, at 5 p.m.
July 18 and passed the following resolutions :-

1. That a petition be forwarded to the Chung Hwa Seamen's
General Labour Union urging them to negotiate without
further delay with the C.M.S.N. Co. for an increase
in wages to tallymen.

2. That should the question of an increase be not settled
in the near future, a "tai-kung" strike of all tallymen
in the employ of the Company be declared.

3. That all members be informed of the cause of the delay
in negotiation in order to avoid misunderstandings.

4. That negotiation be carried out with the Chief Steward
of the S.S. "Yuen An" over the recent dismissal of
three tallymen without reason.

B.C.C. Factories - Situation

The strike situation in the B.C.C. "New" Factory,
Pootung, remains unchanged.

The City Government has, in cooperation with the
local Tangpu, devised measures for the solution of the
dispute existing in the B.C.C. Pootung factories and
given instructions to the following effect to both sides
concerned :-

1. That the operatives in the "New" Factory resume work
first.

2. That the Maintenance Corps be dissolved.

3. That in addition to one month's wages, and deposits as
well as annual bonus which the management has promised,
each worker in the "Old" Factory be given a gratuity
equal to two months' wages.

1. That the workers in the "New" Factory persist in the
strike until the "Old" Factory resumes operation.

2. That the Maintenance Corps be not dissolved before
a settlement of the dispute, as it was formed to maintain
order among workers and protect the foreign employees
as well as the property of the company from possible
disturbance by reactionary elements.

3. That the settlement of the dispute in the "Old" Factory
be based upon the principles devised by the Executive
Yuan, i.e. (a) resumption of factory operation, (b)
engagement of unemployed hands and (c) distribution of
compensation, and that each dismissed worker be granted
a gratuity equivalent to one year's wages.

4. That the old hands be employed first with original pay
when the No.1 (Old) Factory reopens.

5. That the labour agreement concluded between the
employers and employees be considered to be still
effective.

6. That endeavours be made to secure approval from the
City Government for the amendment of the factory
regulations.

7. That representatives be appointed to appeal to the
official organs and public bodies for relief of the
workers concerned in the present dispute.

Poo Yih Cotton Mills:- further reduction in working days

The Poo Yih No.1 Cotton Mill, 37 West Soochow Road,
and No.2 Mill, 8 Robison Road, suspended night operations
from July 16. Workers on the night shift were transferred
to day duty and the total complement divided into two
shifts to operate three days each a week. This step was
taken owing to the hot weather and business depression.
There are some 1,000 hands in the employ of the former and
2,100 in the latter. The No.1 Mill and the Weaving
Department of the No.2 Mill has been operating 4 days and
4 nights a week since June 21.

Coolies attempt to seize work of unloading
at Tseng Kiang Jetty, Pootung

At 3 p.m. July 18, when some thirty coolies were
unloading machinery for the Heng Chong Machine Works,
Tseng Kiang Road, Pootung, from lighters moored alongside
the Tseng Kiang Jetty on the Whangpoo, some 40 coolies
interfered with a view to taking a part in the work of
unloading. A quarrel ensued and the Chinese Police came
on the scene. Two of the intruders were arrested while
the remainder were dispersed.

B.C.C. Factories - Situation

The strike situation in the B.C.C. "New" Factory,
Pootung, remains unchanged.

The Strike Committee is arranging to hold a meeting
of representatives of workers in the B.C.C. Pootung Fac-
tories this morning, July 17 at the 5th District Cigarette
Workers' Union, 78 Lan Nyl Doo Road, to discuss measures
in connection with the present dispute.

Between 4 p.m. and 5.40 p.m. July 16, thirty-nine
members of the Strike Committee met in the office of the
Union in question, when the following decisions were passed:-

1. That the labour agreement between the employers and
employees should be considered as still effective after
the dispute is settled.

2. That approval be secured from the City Government for
the amendment of the factory regulations.

3. That the Central Kuomintang, the Executive Yuan, General
Chiang Kai-shek and City Government be requested to
render immediate relief to the workers concerned prior
to a settlement of the dispute.

4. That the Management be instructed that wages be paid as
usual to the operatives of the "New" Factory for the
period of the strike.

5. That the Officer i/c 3rd District Police Station be
asked to instruct the B.C.C. watchmen to bear badges
when they go off duty in order to avoid misunderstanding.

Sung Sing No.5 Cotton Mill - working days reduced

The Sung Sing No.5 Cotton Mill, 1316 Ward Road which
employs a total of 2,150 hands, is operating five days and
five nights a week with effect from July 16. In addition
the services of half of the total complement have been
temporarily suspended until business conditions improve.

Min Pao :

THE STRIKE OF B.A.T. WORKERS

With reference to the strike of B.A.T. workers, the Shanghai General Labour Union on July 14 gave a reception to various local leaders at the Bankers Association, at which measures for the settlement of the dispute were discussed.
Yesterday Doc Yueh Sung, Sz Liang Zai, Wang Siao Lai, Ling Kong Hou and other local leaders sent a joint letter to Mayor Wu Te Chen requesting him to bring about an early settlement of the strike. It is probable that the strike may be settled as a result of the mediation by the local leaders.

The Shanghai Evening News :

The 4th District Rolled Tobacco Workers Union on the morning of July 15 sent two representatives to comfort the B.A.T. strikers.
The 15th meeting of the Strike Committee of the B.A.T. workers was held on July 15. Zung Bei Tuh (陈培德) presided.
The following resolutions were passed :-
1) That representatives be sent to join the "Persuading Corps" of the Shanghai Various Public Bodies B.A.T. Workers Support Committee.
2) That various transportation concerns be requested to cease carrying B.A.T. products.
3) That the resolution relating to the engagement of White Russians for work in the factories, be kept secret.

The Shanghai Evening News :

THE DAH YANG JAO INCIDENT

The other day Sung Kwei Fang (孫桂芳), manager of the Huh Zung Yah Kee Rice Shop at Dah Yang Jao, Chapei, was assaulted by members of the Peace Preservation Corps and was sent to the Paulunn Hospital for medical treatment. On July 14 his condition becoming serious, the Rice Dealers Association sent representatives to console him.
Wong Nyoh Sz (王下如), an assistant of the rice shop, entered the Pootung Hospital for treatment on July 14.
It is reported that the Peace Preservation Corps is making an investigation into the affair.

Social Affairs the task of dealing with the purchase of
pumping machines for the relief of farmers in consequence
of the drought. It was further decided that a sum of
$60,000 be earmarked for expenses to be incurred in this work.
On July 13, the Bureau of Social Affairs
issued the following circular notice :-
"During summer this year, very little rain
has fallen here and the weather has been very hot. Field
produce have been badly affected. With a view to
relieving the farmers, the Bureau intends to purchase
pumping machines of 6 to 12 horse power. Information
on the following points will be secured :-
1) How much water can a pumping machine draw in an hour ?
2) What kind of oil does the pumping machine use ?
3) What is the price of the machine ?
"Anybody who has such pumping machines for
sale should call at the Bureau between 9 a.m. and 4 p.m.
July 14."
At 9 a.m. yesterday, representatives of
farmers visited the Shanghai City Government in the Civic
Centre.
An official who received the callers on behalf
of the Mayor informed them that the City Government had
decided to appropriate a large sum of money for the
purchase of pumping machines to be distributed among farmers.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :

THE STRIKE OF B.A.T. WORKERS

The Strike Committee of the B.A.T. workers
yesterday detailed Zung Bei Tuh (陈培德), Lou Ching Kuan
(楼景观), Toong Ngao Sung (董敖生) and others to make
a further appeal to the Shanghai City Government. As
Mayor Wu Te Chen was absent, the petitioners were received
by Mr. O.K. Yui, Chief Secretary of the City Government,
who stated that Mayor Wu Te Chen was devising measures to
settle the strike and promised to convey their demand for
relief to the Mayor. The representatives were satisfied
and withdrew.
The Shanghai General Labour Union will give a
reception to representatives of various public bodies this
afternoon at the Bankers Association at which effective measures
to settle the strike will be discussed.
Yesterday the Strike Committee sent a letter to
Wong Siao Lai, Doo Yueh Sung, Ling Kong Hou and other local
leaders requesting them to mediate in the dispute.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别分部登记处。
编号 D 5894
日期 1934年7月14日

1934年7月14日。上午译文。

《晨报》及其他本地报纸：

旱灾：救济农民

上海市政府昨日举行会议，各局局长出席。市长吴铁城主持。
决议指派社会局负责购买抽水机，以救济因旱灾受困的农民。并决定拨出60,000元作为此项工作的经费。
7月13日，社会局发出如下通告：-
“今年夏季，本地降雨极少，天气酷热。农作物受到严重影响。为救济农民，本局拟购买6至12马力的抽水机。需获取以下信息：
1) 一台抽水机每小时能抽多少水？
2) 抽水机使用何种油料？
3) 机器价格是多少？
“凡有此类抽水机出售者，请于7月14日上午9时至下午4时之间前往本局联系。”
昨日上午9时，农民代表前往市中心上海市政府拜访。
代表市长接待来访者的官员告知他们，市政府已决定拨出巨款购买抽水机，分发给农民。

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

英美烟公司工人罢工

英美烟公司工人罢工委员会昨日指派陈培德（Zung Bei Tuh）、楼景观（Lou Ching Kuan）、董敖生（Toong Ngao Sung）等人再次向上海市政府请愿。因市长吴铁城缺席，请愿者由市政府秘书长余鸿钧（O.K. Yui，音译）先生接待，余表示吴市长正在制定解决罢工的方案，并承诺将他们的救济要求转达给市长。代表们表示满意并离去。
上海总工会将于今日下午在银行公会招待各界代表，讨论解决罢工的有效措施。
昨日，罢工委员会致函王晓籁、杜月笙、林康侯及其他本地领袖，请求他们调解纠纷。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5894
July 13 Date 13, 7. 1. 34

Labour

B.C.C. Factories - Situation

The strike situation in the B.C.C. "New" Factory,
Pootung, remains unchanged.

Thirty-two members of the Strike Committee met in
the 5th District Cigarette Workers' Union, 78 Lan Nyi Doo
Road, Pootung, between 4 p.m. and 5 p.m. July 12 when it
was decided that the "Committee of Shanghai Various Circles
to Support the Labour Friends of B.C.C. Factories" be
requested to endeavour to form branches throughout the
country. It was further resolved that the Cigarette and
Money Exchange Shop Owners' Association be asked to notify
its members not to deal in B.C.C. products.

The Branch Office of the Shanghai Municipality
Chamber of Commerce at Pootung, despatched a letter to
Tu Yueh-sung, soliciting his assistance in settling the
present dispute in the B.C.C., Pootung Factories.

The meeting scheduled by the "Committee of Shanghai
Various Circles to Support the Labour Friends of B.C.C.
Factories" in the Young Men's Lecturing Group Society
Building, Nantao, in the afternoon of July 13 failed to
materialize, the number of persons attending being insufficient.

It is reported that the General Labour Union is
arranging to entertain representatives of various local
public bodies to dinner in the Bankers' Association, 9
Hongkong Road, at 12 noon, July 14, at which discussions
will take place in support of B.C.C. workers concerned in
the present dispute.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别分部登记处。
编号 D 5894
日期 1934年7月13日

劳工

英美烟草公司工厂 - 局势

浦东英美烟草公司“新”厂的罢工局势保持不变。

7月12日下午4时至5时，罢工委员会的三十二名成员在浦东兰尼杜路78号第五区卷烟工人工会集会，会上决定请求“上海各界支援英美烟草公司工厂劳工之友委员会”努力在全国各地建立分支机构。会议还决议，要求卷烟及钱庄店主协会通知其会员不得交易英美烟草公司的产品。

上海市商会浦东办事处致信杜月笙，恳请其协助解决目前浦东英美烟草公司工厂的纠纷。

原定于7月13日下午在南市青年宣讲团社大楼由“上海各界支援英美烟草公司工厂劳工之友委员会”召开的会议未能举行，因为出席人数不足。

据悉，总工会正安排于7月14日中午12时在香港路9号的银行公会宴请各地方公共团体代表，届时将讨论支持涉及当前纠纷的英美烟草公司工人的事宜。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5894
Date 13. 7. 34

July 13, 1934. Afternoon Translation

Eastern Times and other local newspapers:-

THE CANIDROME ROBBERY CASE

In connection with the Canidrome robbery case, four persons were arrested and were later found not guilty by the Court. Following the case, it was suspected that Lawyer Yien Loo Ching (顏魯卿) and a compradore named Chow Ching Kung (周景康) had attempted to extort $60,000 from Chang Chi Mang (張志孟) and $2,000 from Dong Ching Ngao (唐慶敖).
Lawyer Sung Chu Gee (孫祖基), representing the accused Dong Ching Ngao, and witness Pan Hoong Ting (潘鴻鼎) have made detailed reports to the French Police. An investigation was made and the Police have brought a public charge against Lawyer Yien Loo Ching and Chow Ching Kung in accordance with Article 370 of the Criminal Code. The case will come up for hearing at 10 a.m. to-day at the Second Special District Court.

Lawyer Yien Loo Ching had been accused in Court by two other lawyers with having attempted to extort $2,000 from a robber suspect in the Canidrome Case. For this reason, the Chief Procurator of the Second Special District Court requested the French Police to make an investigation in accordance with Article 4 of the Court Rendition Agreement. In conformity with Article 38 of the Bye-laws of the Bar Association and Article 18 of the regulations governing the Bar Association, a petition was sent to the Third Branch Kiangsu High Court requesting it to refer the lawyer to the Lawyers Disciplinary Committee of the Court for punishment.
The Committee has already notified Lawyer Yien to make a reply in defence.

Min Pao:-
The Lawyers Disciplinary Committee of the Third Branch Kiangsu High Court has decided to suspend Lawyer Yien.

Min Pao and other local newspapers:-

THE STRIKE OF B.A.T. WORKERS

Yesterday the Strike Committee of the B.A.T. workers held a meeting at which measures to deal with the dispute were discussed.
At noon July 14, the Shanghai General Labour Union will give a reception at the Bankers Association to leaders of various public bodies when ways and means to settle the dispute will be considered.
Yesterday the Strike Committee received a despatch from the Central People's Movement Direction Committee demanding relief for the strikers.

上海公共租界工部局警务处

编号 D 5894
日期 1934年7月13日

1934年7月13日。下午译文

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

跑狗场抢劫案

关于跑狗场抢劫案，四人被捕，后经法院宣判无罪。该案结束后，有人怀疑律师颜鲁卿 (Yien Loo Ching) 和一名名为周景康 (Chow Ching Kung) 的买办曾试图向张志孟 (Chang Chi Mang) 勒索60,000美元，并向唐庆敖 (Dong Ching Ngao) 勒索2,000美元。
代表被告唐庆敖的律师孙祖基 (Sung Chu Gee) 及证人潘鸿鼎 (Pan Hoong Ting) 已向法租界巡捕房作了详细报告。经调查，警方已根据刑法第370条对律师颜鲁卿和周景康提起公诉。该案将于今日上午10时在第二特区地方法院开庭审理。

律师颜鲁卿曾被另外两名律师在法庭上指控，称其试图向跑狗场案的一名抢劫嫌疑犯勒索2,000美元。为此，第二特区地方法院首席检察官请求法租界巡捕房根据《法院引渡协定》第四条进行调查。根据律师公会章程第38条及律师公会管理条例第18条，已向江苏高等法院第三分院呈请，要求将该律师移交法院律师惩戒委员会予以惩处。
该委员会已通知颜律师作出答辩。

《民报》：
江苏高等法院第三分院律师惩戒委员会已决定暂停颜律师的执业资格。

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

英美烟草公司工人罢工

昨日，英美烟草公司工人罢工委员会举行会议，讨论了处理此次纠纷的措施。
7月14日中午，上海总工会将在银行公会招待各公共团体领导人，届时将商议解决纠纷的方法。
昨日，罢工委员会收到中央民众运动指导委员会发来的一份电报，要求为罢工者提供救济。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5894
Date 11. 7. 34

July 11, 1934.    Morning Translation.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :

THE STRIKE OF B.A.T. WORKERS

With reference to the strike of B.A.T.
workers the Shanghai General Labour Union yesterday
sent the following telegram to General Chiang Kai Shek,
Chairman of the Military Affairs Commission, the
Executive Yuan, the Ministry of Industry and the Central
People's Movement Direction Committee :-
"The B.A.T. Company at Shanghai has suspended
operations in the No. 1 Factory without first securing
the sanction of the National Government. This has
thrown over 3,000 workers out of employment. Mediations
have been undertaken by the local Tangpu and other
political organs, but the company, ignoring the
instructions of the authorities, refused to detail
representatives to attend the mediation meetings.
Therefore, the 5,000 workers of the New Factory declared
a strike to support the workers of the No. 1 Factory.
They want the closed factory to resume operations.
Relying on the influence of the imperialists, the attitude
of the management is very firm. Over a month has
passed and the dispute is becoming more serious daily.
This Union hereby requests you to devise measures to
settle the dispute immediately."
Yesterday morning Zung Bei Tuh (陈培德)
and over 100 representatives of the workers made an
appeal to the Shanghai City Government at the Civic
Centre demanding relief for the strikers. The petitioners
were received by a representative of the City Government.
It is learned that the reply of the City Government was
satisfactory.
The Support Committee formed by various
local public bodies had planned to hold a meeting of all
committee members at 5 p.m. yesterday, but the meeting
failed to materialize owing to the small attendance.
A meeting of members of the Standing
Committee of the Support Committee will be held at 5 p.m.
July 12.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :

OPPOSITION TO A BOOK

Yih Chun Tsu (易君左), Chief of the
Book Edition and Examination Section of the Educational
Department of the Kiangsu Provincial Government, has written
a book entitled "Talk About Yangchow" (闲话扬州) which is
being published by the Chun Hwa Bookstore (中华书局),
Foochow Road. In view of the fact that the book contains
reflections upon the people of Yangchow, the local Yangchow
Fellow Provincials Association yesterday detailed one Hou
Dah Chun (侯大椿) to request the Commissioner of the
Bureau of Education of the Shanghai City Government to
prohibit the publication of the book in question.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别分部登记处。
编号 D 5894
日期 1934年7月11日

1934年7月11日。上午译文。

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

英美烟草公司工人罢工

关于英美烟草公司工人罢工一事，上海总工会昨日向军事委员会委员长蒋介石将军、行政院、实业部及中央民众运动指导委员会发出如下电报：
“上海英美烟草公司在未先获得国民政府批准的情况下，擅自停止第一工厂的运营。这导致三千多名工人失业。当地党部及其他政治机构已进行调解，但该公司无视当局指示，拒绝指派代表参加调解会议。因此，新厂的五千名工人宣布罢工，以支持第一工厂的工人。他们要求关闭的工厂恢复运营。管理层倚仗帝国主义的势力，态度十分强硬。一个多月过去了，纠纷日益严重。本会特此请求阁下立即制定措施解决此纠纷。”
昨日上午，陈培德 (Zung Bei Tuh) 及一百多名工人代表前往市中心上海市政府请愿，要求为罢工者提供救济。请愿者得到了市政府代表的接见。据悉，市政府的答复令人满意。
由各地方公共团体组成的支援委员会原计划于昨日下午5时召开全体委员会议，但因出席人数较少，会议未能举行。
支援委员会常务委员会委员会议将于7月12日下午5时举行。

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

反对一本书

江苏省政府教育厅图书审查科科长易君左 (Yih Chun Tsu) 撰写了一本名为《闲话扬州》的书，由福州路的中华书局出版。鉴于该书含有对扬州人民的诽谤性言论，当地扬州同乡会昨日特派侯大椿 (Hou Dah Chun) 请求上海市教育局局长禁止出版该书。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5894
Date 11. 7. 34
July 11,

Labour

B.C.C. Factories - Situation

The strike situation in the B.C.C. "New" Factory,
Pootung, remains unchanged.

Fifty-eight members of the Strike Committee,
including Chen Bei-teh and a number of workers, made a
further appeal to the City Government in the morning of
July 10 for relief to the operatives concerned in the
B.C.C. dispute, as well as assistance in securing wages
due to the workers of the "Old" Factory, and reopening
of the concern. The callers were received by Yui Hung-chun,
Secretary of the City Government, who promised to negotiate
with the Management regarding their requests.

Siao Keng-sung (萧根生), the delegate of the
Strike Committee who proceeded to Nanking on July 8 for
the purpose of making a further appeal to the Government
Authorities in connection with the B.C.C. labour dispute,
returned on July 10. According to Siao, the Central
Kuomintang is endeavouring to seek a solution of the dispute.

The "Committee of Shanghai Various Circles to Support
the Labour Friends of B.C.C. Factories", with offices in
the Young Men's Lecturing Group Society Building, Nantao,
is arranging to hold a meeting of the whole body of members
at the above venue in the afternoon of July 13 to discuss
ways and means to support the B.C.C. operatives concerned
in the present dispute. At a meeting held by seven members
of the Committee at 5 p.m. July 10 in its office, it was
decided that the local cigarette shops and seamen's bodies
products.
be urged to cease dealing in and transportation of B.C.C./
pages.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别分部登记处。
编号 D 5894
日期 1934年7月11日
7月11日，

劳工

英美烟草公司工厂 - 局势

浦东英美烟草公司“新”厂的罢工局势保持不变。

7月10日上午，包括陈培德 (Chen Bei-teh) 在内的一些工人共五十八名罢工委员会成员再次向市政府请愿，要求为涉及英美烟草公司纠纷的工人提供救济，并协助追讨“老”厂工人被拖欠的工资以及重启该企业。来访者受到市政府秘书俞鸿钧 (Yui Hung-chun) 的接见，他承诺就他们的请求与管理层进行谈判。

罢工委员会代表萧根生 (Siao Keng-sung) 于7月8日前往南京，旨在就英美烟草公司劳资纠纷进一步向政府当局请愿，并于7月10日返回。据萧称，国民党中央正努力寻求解决纠纷的方案。

“上海各界支援英美烟草公司工厂劳工之友委员会”办事处设在南市青年宣讲团社大楼，正安排于7月13日下午在上述地点召开全体成员会议，讨论支持涉及当前纠纷的英美烟草公司工人的方法和途径。在7月10日下午5时于其办事处举行的七名委员会成员会议上，决定敦促当地卷烟店和海员团体停止交易和运输英美烟草公司的产品。

pages.en:
July 11, 4.

Labour (2)

The General Labour Union despatched an Express
Letter on July 10 to General Chiang Kai-shek requesting
him to devise measures to settle the B.C.C. dispute.

Yih Sing Tooth Brush Factory - Situation

The strike situation in the Yih Sing Tooth Brush
Factory, Hwei Ning Road, Nantao, remains unchanged this
morning.

With a view to settling the dispute, the Bureau
of Social Affairs convened a meeting in the Bureau at
2 p.m. July 10, when representatives from the management
and the workers of the concern were present. A member
of the organ, who presided, advised the workers to resume
work pending a full settlement by the Authorities, in
reply to which the workers promised to convene a meeting
on July 11 to discuss same. The meeting then broke up.

Shanghai Hire Car Chauffeurs' Union - Club established
in Settlement

The Shanghai Hire Car Chauffeurs' Union has recently
established a club entitled "Lien Zoe" on the 2nd Floor,
872 Avenue Edward VII. Any member of the Union who wishes
to make use of this club must pay a fee of 50 cents per
mensem. This body has at present some 30 members.

It will be remembered that the Union in question
had a club at the same address in March, 1934 but it was
later closed down owing to lack of funds.
pages.zh:
7月11日，4.

劳工 (2)

总工会于7月10日发出快信给蒋介石将军，请求他制定措施解决英美烟草公司的纠纷。

益盛牙刷厂 - 局势

今晨，南市汇宁路益盛牙刷厂的罢工局势保持不变。

为解决纠纷，社会局于7月10日下午2时在该局召开会议，资方和工人代表均出席。主持会议的一名机关成员建议工人在当局全面解决之前复工，对此，工人承诺于7月11日召开会议讨论此事。随后会议解散。

上海出租汽车司机工会 - 在租界内建立俱乐部

上海出租汽车司机工会最近在爱多亚路872号二楼建立了一个名为“联佐” (Lien Zoe) 的俱乐部。任何希望使用该俱乐部的工会会员每月需缴纳50美分的费用。该团体目前约有30名会员。

值得注意的是，该工会曾于1934年3月在同一地址设有一个俱乐部，但后来因资金缺乏而关闭。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5894
D.C. (RTME) 7/10 34
July 10, 1934. Afternoon Translation.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

ANNIVERSARY OF THE NORTHERN PUNITIVE EXPEDITION.

July 9 being the 8th anniversary of the Northern
Punitive Expedition of the national revolutionary army
in 1926, a commemoration meeting was held at 9 a.m.
yesterday at the auditorium of the local Tangpu. About
100 persons were present, including Shon Lien-yien
( 熊烈賢 ) of the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commissioner's
Headquarters, Chang Hwei-chun ( 張輝軍 ) of the Shanghai
Farmers Federation, Hsu Zoong-hwa ( 徐宗華 ) of the
China Youths Federation, teachers of various primary
schools and members of the staff of various district
Tangpus.
Tao Pah-chow ( 陶百川 ), committeeman of
the local Tangpu, explained the significance of the
anniversary of the Northern Punitive Expedition.
Local official organs such as the Customs, the
District Courts, the Shanghai City Government as well
as schools observed the day as a national holiday.
Lest reactionary elements should take advantage
of the occasion to create disturbances yesterday, extra
precautionary measures were adopted by the Public Safety
Bureau. Similar measures were adopted by the foreign
Police in the factory districts in the Eastern and the
Western Districts of Shanghai. No untoward incidents
occurred.
Another commemoration meeting was held at
10 a.m. yesterday at the auditorium of the Shanghai-
Nanking & Shanghai-Hangchow-Ningpo Railways Special Tangpu.
About 100 persons attended.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

COLLECTION OF AVIATION CONTRIBUTIONS FROM LOCAL HOTELS.

According to information from the China Aviation
Co-operative Association in the Chinese Y.M.C.A. Building,
Boulevard de Montigny, French Concession, the collection
of aviation contributions from hotels has been postponed
because the preparations have not yet been completed.
It is understood that various local hotels
have decided to make contributions as from to-day.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

北伐周年纪念。

7月9日是1926年国民革命军北伐八周年纪念日，昨日上午9时在当地党部礼堂举行了纪念大会。约有一百人出席，其中包括吴淞上海警备司令部熊烈贤 (Shon Lien-yien)、上海农民联合会张辉军 (Chang Hwei-chun)、中国青年联合会徐宗华 (Hsu Zoong-hwa)、各小学校教师及各区分部工作人员。
当地党部委员陶百川 (Tao Pah-chow) 阐述了北伐周年纪念的意义。
海关、地方法院、上海市政府以及学校等当地官方机构将这一天作为国定假日予以纪念。
为防止反动分子利用此机会制造骚乱，公安局昨日采取了额外的预防措施。上海东西区工厂地带的外国警察也采取了类似措施。未发生不幸事件。
昨日上午10时，在京沪与沪杭甬铁路特别党部礼堂举行了另一场纪念大会。约有百人出席。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

向本地旅馆募集航空捐款。

据法租界蒙太尼路（莫利哀路）基督教青年会大楼内的中国航空协进会消息，由于准备工作尚未完成，向旅馆募集航空捐款的活动已推迟。
据悉，本地各家旅馆已决定从今天开始捐款。

Min Pao and other local newspapers :
COMPETITION BETWEEN RICSHAS AND BUSES AT KAOCHIAO

With reference to the trouble created by ricsha
coolies at Kaochiao on the evening of July 8, the Public
Safety Bureau has arrested over 30 ricsha coolies who had
started the trouble.
The buses were in operation as usual yesterday
and no untoward incidents happened. Following the clash,
the Bureau of Social Affairs, the local Tangpu and Mr. Doo
Yueh Sung detailed representatives to mediate in the dispute.
It is reported that the ricsha owners have
requested the authorities to deal with the arrested coolies
leniently but the Public Safety Bureau desire to deal
severely with the arrested men with a view to preventing
further disputes and maintaining peace and order in the
district.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:
THE ANTI-OPIUM MOVEMENT.

Some prepared opium shops and opium selling and
smoking shops at Minghong and vicinity have registered with
the Opium Suppression Committee of the Shanghai Hsien
Government. Nineteen opium smokers have called at the
office of the Committee expressing their willingness to
give up the habit. They have been sent to the Shanghai
Hospital (上海医院) for treatment.
The Opium Suppression Committee held a meeting
yesterday. Pan Chung Chia (潘忠甲), Chief of the
Committee, who is the Magistrate of Shanghai Hsien, was
in the chair. The following resolutions were passed:-
1. That one prepared opium shop or, at the most, two shops
be allowed to exist in each district.
2) That as there are many indigent residents in the Hsien,
one opium selling and smoking shop be established in
each town.
3) That the Shanghai Hsien Public Safety Bureau be instructed
to order its stations to complete the investigations
into the number of opium smokers in each district before
July 15.
4) That copies of a summary of the Anti-Opium Regulations
be printed and distributed among the residents.

《民报》及其他本地报纸：
高桥镇人力车与公共汽车之竞争

关于7月8日晚高桥镇人力车夫引发的骚乱，公安局已逮捕了三十余名肇事的拉车苦力。
昨日公共汽车照常运营，未发生任何意外事件。冲突发生后，社会局、当地塘浦及杜月笙先生均指派代表介入调解纠纷。
据悉，人力车车主已请求当局从宽处理被捕苦力，但公安局希望严惩被捕人员，以防止纠纷再起，并维持该地区的和平与秩序。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：
禁烟运动。

明弘及周边地区的一些熟膏店和鸦片售卖及吸食馆已向上海县政府禁烟委员会登记。十九名鸦片吸食者前往该委员会办公室，表示愿意戒除毒瘾。他们已被送往上海医院接受治疗。
禁烟委员会昨日召开会议。由上海县县长兼任的委员会主任潘忠甲主持了会议。通过以下决议：-
1. 每个区允许存在一家熟膏店，最多不超过两家。
2) 鉴于县内贫困居民众多，每个镇设立一家鸦片售卖及吸食馆。
3) 指令上海县公安局命令各分局在7月15日前完成对各区域鸦片吸食者人数的调查。
4) 印制《禁烟条例》摘要副本，并向居民分发。

B.C.C. Factories - Strike Situation

The strike situation in the B.C.C. "New" Factory,
Footung, remains unchanged this morning.

Siao Keng-sung (蕭根生), who was delegated by
the Strike Committee of the B.C.C. "New" Factory to
make a further appeal to the National Government in
connection with the dispute between the Management and
workers of the B.C.C. Factories, left Shanghai by rail
for Nanking on July 8.

General Labour Union - Meeting

At 4.15 p.m. July 7, five committee members of the
General Labour Union held a meeting in their office at
No.117 Foh Yeu Road, City and passed the following
resolutions :-

1. That the Shanghai City Government be requested to
negotiate with the British Authorities for the
cancellation of the decision to land British Marines
in Potung in connection with the B.C.C. strike, and
that the former be also asked to rescind the order
for the dissolution of the B.C.C. Strikers'
Maintenance Corps.

2. That the request of the Silversmith Workers' Union
for assistance in the strike of the workers of the
Sung Wan Zung Silversmith Workshop, City, as a protest
against a reduction in wages be forwarded to the local
Kuomintang

3. That the dispute in the Ih Sing Tooth Brush Factory,
Nantao between the workers and the management over
the question of reduction in working hours be referred
to the local Kuomintang for action.

英商中国烟草公司工厂 - 罢工局势

今晨，浦东英商中国烟草公司“新”厂的罢工局势保持不变。

萧根生受英商中国烟草公司“新”厂罢工委员会委派，就英商中国烟草公司工厂资方与工人之间的纠纷向国民政府进一步请愿，他已于7月8日乘火车离开上海前往南京。

总工会 - 会议

7月7日下午4时15分，总工会的五名委员在上海市福州路117号的办事处举行会议，并通过以下决议：-

1. 请求上海市政府与英国当局谈判，撤销因英商中国烟草公司罢工而在浦东登陆英国海军陆战队的决定，并要求撤销解散英商中国烟草公司罢工工人纠察队的命令。

3. 将南市怡盛牙刷厂工人与资方之间关于缩短工作时间的纠纷提交当地国民党处理。

Min Pao and other local newspapers :

THE STRIKE OF B.A.T. WORKERS

The Support Committee formed by the various
local public bodies will hold a meeting at 5 p.m. to-day
at which measures for the relief of the strikers will
be discussed.
In compliance with a resolution passed at its
13th meeting, the Strike Committee yesterday morning
detailed Siao Kung Sung (黄庆生) to Nanking for the
purpose of making further appeals to the Central
Kuomintang Headquarters, the National Government, the
Executive Yuan, the Central People's Movement Direction
Committee and the Ministries of Industry, Finance and
Foreign Affairs. The representative will ask that
relief be granted to the strikers and that the B.A.T.
Company be instructed to resume operations immediately.
The Strike Committee will also detail representa-
tives to attend the meeting to be held to-day by the
Support Committee.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

THE INSPECTION OF FACTORIES.

With a view to assuring safety in factories
throughout the country, the Central Factory Inspectorate
has divided the country into six districts in each of
which an office of the Inspectorate will be placed in charge.
As regards the question of the inspection of
factories in the Settlement, the Central Authorities will
draw up suitable measures to deal with this problem if an
amicable settlement can not be reached.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

THE CASE AGAINST YU YAH-CHING & OTHERS.

The case against Yu Yah-ching (虞洽卿) and
others brought by Chow Chung-ding (詹春廷) and other
representatives of the families of the victims in the
May 30th Incident on a charge of misappropriation of about
$80,000 of the compassionate grants has been dismissed
by the Second Branch Kiangsu High Court.
It is understood that the families of the
victims will carry the appeal to the Supreme Court.

A REFORMED COMMUNIST.

Kao Ching Sung (高金生) publishes the following
announcement in the "Chen Pao" and other local newspapers:-
In July 1932, I joined the Chinese Communist
Party at the instigation of Koo Zung Tsang (顾成章).

July 6, 1934. Afternoon Translation.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :

THE STRIKE OF B.A.T. WORKERS

With reference to the strike of B.A.T. workers,
the first meeting of the Standing Committee of the Support
Committee formed by the various local bodies was held
at 5 p.m. yesterday. Tse Wei Sun (褚慧僧) presided.
The following resolutions were passed:-
1) That with reference to the proposal of the
Strike Committee that a letter be sent requesting those
concerns which roll tobacco on behalf of the B.A.T.
Company to cease this work, a letter be written to the
Chinese Rolled Tobacco Trade Dealers Association leaving
the matter in its hands for decision.
2) That in connection with the request of the
Strike Committee for financial relief, the matter be
discussed by the Relief Section of the Support Committee.
3) That a letter be sent to the B.A.T. Company
advising it to re-open the factories.
4) That the Shanghai City Government be petitioned
to withdraw the order for the abolition of the "Maintenance
Corps" of the Strike Committee.
The following letter has been sent to the
B.A.T. Company :-
"Two months have passed since the suspension
of operations of the No. 1 Factory at Pootung and the
dispute is still unsettled.
"Your company has disregarded the suffering
of the workers and refused to accept mediation by the
Chinese authorities. In addition you caused a tragedy
last month.
"In order to preserve international
friendship, this Committee was formed by various public
bodies to support the workers. We hope you will resume
operations immediately, otherwise it is to be feared
that the trouble might spread."

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers :

STRIKE OF SILVERSMITHS

Some time ago the local silversmiths declared
a strike as a protest against a reduction of their wages.
Subsequently, the strike was settled through the mediation
of Doo Yueh Sung at the request of the General Labour
Union.
Recently the Vai Loong (萬隆) Silver Works,
Small West Gate, Nantao, reduced the workers wages. The
Silversmiths Union sent members to open negotiations but
this had no result.
Yesterday morning the owner of the silver works
suspended the supply of food to the workers. The silver-
smiths then declared a strike.
The General Labour Union has sent a representa-
tive to make an investigation into the facts of the strike
and will summon representatives of both parties to a
mediation meeting to be held this morning.

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

英美烟草公司工人罢工

关于英美烟草公司工人罢工一事，由各地方团体组成的后援委员会常务委员会第一次会议于昨日下午5时举行。褚慧僧主持。
通过以下决议：-
1) 关于罢工委员会提议致函要求那些为英美烟草公司卷制烟草的企业停止此项工作的建议，现致函中国卷烟业同业公会，将此事项交由其决定。
2) 关于罢工委员会请求财政救济一事，由后援委员会救济组进行讨论。
3) 致函英美烟草公司，劝其重新开工。
4)  petition 上海市政府撤销取消罢工委员会“纠察队”的命令。
已向英美烟草公司发出如下信函：-
“浦东第一厂停工已两月，纠纷仍未解决。
“贵公司无视工人疾苦，拒绝接受中国当局的调解。此外，贵公司于上月酿成悲剧。
“为维护国际友谊，各公共团体组成本委员会以支持工人。我们希望贵公司立即复工，否则恐怕事态会蔓延。”

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

银匠罢工

此前，当地银匠为抗议减薪而举行罢工。随后，应总工会的请求，经杜月笙调解，罢工得以解决。
最近，南市小西门万隆银楼降低了工人工资。银匠工会派员进行谈判，但未获结果。
昨日上午，银楼老板停止向工人供应食物。银匠随即宣布罢工。
总工会已派代表调查罢工事实，并将于今日上午召集双方代表举行调解会议。

The strike situation in the B.C.C. "New" Factory,
Pootung, remains unchanged.

Sung Wan Zung Silversmiths Workshop - situation
The strike situation in the Sung Wan Zung
Silversmiths Workshop, Zong Wen Road, Small West Gate,
remains unchanged this morning.
With a view to settling the dispute, the General
Labour Union convened a meeting in its office, 117 Foh
Yeu Road, City, at 9.45 a.m. July 6 when representatives
from the management, the workers and the Silversmiths'
Union, were present. Owing to the parties concerned
refusing to yield, the meeting broke up at 11 a.m. without
any result being reached.
The Silversmiths' Union is of the opinion that
should the management continue its stubborn attitude
towards the workers, all members should be notified to
declare a strike.

China Kung Saung Rubber Factory - dispute settled
The recent closing down of the China Kung Saung
Rubber Factory, 530 Brenan Road, O.O.L., owing to trade
depression (Vide I.R. 27/6/34), met with considerable
opposition from the workers numbering about 60. The
dispute was settled on July 6 on the management promising
to distribute one month's pay to the workers concerned as
repatriation allowance. It was also agreed that the
operatives would be notified to resume work should the
factory reopen.

The strike situation in the B.C.C. "New" Factory,

Four members of the "Committee of Shanghai Various
Circles to Support the Labour Friends of B.C.C. Factories"

1. That the Chinese Cigarette Factory Owners' Association
be urged to refrain from entrusting the rolling of
cigarettes to the B.C.C. Factories.

2. That the Management of the B.C.C. Factory be advised
to resume operation.

3. That the request of the Strike Committee for relief
measures for the benefit of the strikers be carefully
considered.

4. That the Shanghai City Government be urged to rescind
its order to the 3rd District Police Station to dissolve
the Strikers' Maintenance Corps.

Thorburn Road Factory, 674 Thorburn Road, shut off the
power as a protest against the transfer of a colleague to
another room. Consequently 30 coolies were rendered idle.

July 5, 1934. Afternoon translation.
Min Pao and other local newspapers.

THE B.A.T. STRIKE

With reference to the strike of B.A.T. workers,
the Shanghai General Labour Union is paying particular
attention to the dispute. Apart from sending four
representatives to make an appeal to Mr. O.K. Yue, Chief
Secretary of the Shanghai City Government, on July 3,
the some four representatives were sent to call on Wu
Kai Sien (吴开先), Committee members of the local
Tangpu on July 4 to demand and immediate settlement of
the dispute. The result of the appeal was satisfactory.
Yesterday the "Committee of Shanghai Various
Circles to Support the Labour Friends of B.A.T. Factories"
issued the following manifesto addressed to the people
throughout the country:-
The B.A.T. Company is one of the large cigarette
manufacturing concerns owned by foreign capitalists.
It employs labourers at cheap wages and its profits are
estimated at $30,000,000 a year. The Company ill-
treats the workers although the latter had helped in
making this profit. The Company has now unreasonably
suspended operations, thereby endangering the livelihood
of 8,000 workers in its employ. We can no longer
tolerate the brutal actions of the company and we
should render effective support to the 8,000 workers.
This Committee was formed on June 28 to support
the B.A.T. workers. We hope the company will accept this
last chance to grant the demands of the workers and reopen
the factories at an early date in order that both parties
will not be made to suffer any more.
We hope that brethren throughout the country
will join the movement and render assistance to the workers.

英美烟草公司罢工

关于英美烟草公司（B.A.T.）工人的罢工，上海总工会正特别关注此纠纷。除了于7月3日派遣四名代表向上海市政府秘书长余井塘（O.K. Yue）先生提出呼吁外，这四名代表还于7月4日拜访了当地党部委员吴开先，要求立即解决纠纷。呼吁的结果令人满意。
昨日，“上海各界支援英美烟草公司工厂工友委员会”发表了如下致全国同胞的宣言：
英美烟草公司是外国资本家拥有的大型卷烟制造企业之一。它以低廉的工资雇佣劳工，据估计其年利润达3,000万美元。尽管工人帮助创造了这一利润，该公司却虐待工人。该公司现在无理停工，危及其雇佣的8,000名工人的生计。我们不能再容忍该公司的暴行，我们应该给予这8,000名工人有效的支持。
本委员会于6月28日成立，以支持英美烟草公司工人。我们希望公司能接受这最后的机会，满足工人的要求并早日重开工厂，以免双方再受苦难。
我们希望全国同胞加入运动，援助工人。

to the workers of the B.C.C. "Old" Factory. The

to consider their requests.

China Times and other local newspapers.

THE B.A.T. STRIKE

Fearing that the strike at the B.A.T. Factories might assume serious proportions, the Shanghai General Labour Union yesterday detailed four representatives to proceed to the Shanghai City Government. Mr. O.K. Yui, Chief Secretary, received the delegates, who submitted the following requests;-

1) That the order for the dissolution of the Maintenance Corps organized by the B. A. T. Strike Committee be withdrawn.

2) That relief be issued to the strikers pending a settlement of the dispute.

3) That the Shanghai City Government devise effective ways and means to bring about a settlement of the strike.

Mr. Yui replied that if the Maintenance Corps did not do anything against the law, the City Government would not interfere with their activities. Relief will be given workers when circumstances warrant. The City Government is about to hold a joint meeting with the District Kuomintang with a view to finding a solution of the trouble.

Mr. Yui also told the representatives to advise the workers not to act in a disorderly manner.

Petitions were submitted yesterday by the B.A.T. Strike Committee to the local Tangpu and the City Government appealing for relief.
