Labour (3)

B.C.C. Factories in Pootung - situation

The strike situation in the B.C.C. "New" Factory,
Pootung, remains unchanged.

Between 4 p.m. and 5.20 p.m. June 4, some 25
local journalists were entertained by the 5th District
Cigarette Workers' Union at the Chinese Y.M.C.A., 123
Boulevard de Montigny. Chen Bei Teh presided and made
a report in connection with the disturbance in the
morning of June 4 at Pootung when workers attempted to
proceed to the factory by launches from the Nanking
Road Jetty. He stated that ten strikers had been
assaulted and injured by foreign employees to the number
of 50 who were armed with wooden bars. Three of them
are now detained in the Pootung Hospital. In conclusion
he requested the attendance to uphold justice. During
the entertainment, copies of four handbills bearing on the
strike and a list of names of workers injured were dis-
tributed.

In connection with the above disturbance, it is learned
that about 7.20 a.m. June 4, the strikers numbering 1,000
assembled on the Tien Tsang Wharf, Pootung. Forty of this
number armed with bamboo poles attempted to land on the
New Factory Wharf by boats from the river but were prevent-
ed from doing so by foreign employees including Russians,
who pushed the boats off and repelled the strikers with
wooden staves. In the melee ten of the strikers and four
foreigners were injured. Subsequently, the strikers
dispersed. It is believed that the strikers intended

Jetty with a view to proceeding to Pootung to resume work.
400 of them went to Pootung first by launches but were
prevented from landing by the strikers to the number
of 1,000, who were assembled, armed with iron bars, on
wharves in Pootung. Consequently they were compelled
to return and all dispersed at 9 a.m.

Chinese police are now posted in the "New" Factory to
guard against possible disturbance.

On June 3, a notice was issued by the Strike Committee
which states that all workers are determined to continue their
struggle as long as the No.1 Factory remains closed and
advises them not to believe rumours circulated by unruly
elements.

The propaganda corps continued their activities in
the vicinity of the City Temple on June 3 in persuading
the public not to smoke B.C.C. cigarettes.

Of the 2,750 operatives in the B.C.C. Thorburn Road
Factory, 200 failed to turn up this morning, June 4, while
a number were late in arriving for work. In addition,
some 70 out of the 550 workers in the Printing Department
at 1018 Whashing Road did not put in their appearance.
The majority of these workers live in Pootung and their
absence was the result of intimidation by the strikers at
Pootung.

劳工 (7)

浦东英美烟公司工厂 - 局势

英美烟公司“新”厂的罢工局势
保持不变。

今日上午6时10分，“新”厂约1,200名职员和
工人在南京路码头集合，拟前往浦东复工。
其中400人先乘小轮前往浦东，但被聚集在浦东
码头上、手持铁条的1,000名罢工者阻止登陆。
因此他们被迫返回，并于上午9时全部散去。

华警现已派驻“新”厂，以防可能发生骚乱。

6月3日，罢工委员会发布通告，声明只要一厂
仍然关闭，所有工人决心继续斗争，并劝告他们
不要相信不法分子散布的谣言。

6月3日，宣传队在城隍庙附近继续开展活动，
劝说公众不要吸食英美烟公司的香烟。

在英美烟公司韬朋路（Thorburn Road）工厂的
2,750名操作工中，有200人今晨（6月4日）未上班，
另有多人迟到。此外，华盛路（Whashing Road）
1018号印刷部的550名工人中，约有70人未露面。
这些工人大多居住在浦东，其缺席是受浦东罢工者
恐吓所致。

Labour (8)

A poster entitled "Urgent Notice of the B.C.C. 3rd
Factory Strike Committee" dated June 4, bearing the chop,
"Shanghai B.C.C. Strike Committee" was found posted on
the wall of the Thorburn Road Factory this morning. It
states that in accordance with the decision of the
representative meeting, all operatives and staff employees
should declare a strike, commencing from 7 a.m. June 4,
in support of the workers in the B.C.C. Nos. 1 & 2 Factories.
No workers are allowed to enter the factory without the
order of the Strike Committee, failing which they will be
severely dealt with. Copies of four handbills were also
found distributed in the vicinity of the factory. Two
of them purport to emanate from the 5th District Cigarette
Workers' Union and the "Shanghai B.C.C. 3rd Factory
Strike Committee in support of the Operation Resumption
Movement of the Old Factory" opposing the "illegal"
closing down of the No.1 Factory and urging all workers in
the employ of the B.C.C. throughout the country as well as
the public to render assistance to the affected hands.
The other two handbills are of a communistic nature. One
opposes the alleged suppression of the strike by the
Fascist Kuomintang.

Foh Chong Tobacco Factory - resumes operation

The Foh Chong Tobacco Factory, 965 Wuting Road, which
suspended operation on May 27 owing to business depression,
resumed this morning, June 4. This concern employs at
present a total of some 100 hands.

B.A.T. WORKERS

With reference to the labour dispute in the B.A.T. factories, the Strike Committee has commenced to register workers on strike. Many workers have applied for registration.
At 4 p.m. yesterday, the Strike Committee held a meeting at which the following resolutions were passed:-
1) That a reception to Chinese and foreign newspapermen be given at 3 p.m. June 4.
2) That the "Female Propaganda Section" detail members to visit various teashops, restaurants, hotels and amusement resorts to advise people not to smoke B.A.T. cigarettes.

Labour

B.C.C. Factories in Pootung - Situation

The strike situation in the B.C.C. "New" Factory,
Pootung, remains unchanged this morning, June 2.

39 members of the Strike Committee held a meeting
in the 5th District Cigarette Workers' Union, 78 Lan Nyi
Doo Road, Pootung, between 4 p.m. and 6 p.m. June 1.
Chen Bei-teh presided and the following resolutions
were passed :-

1. That local journalists be entertained at 3 p.m.
June 4 in the Chinese Y.M.C.A., 123 Boulevard
de Montigny.

2. That local newspaper offices be requested not to
publish advertisements of the B.C.C. prior to a
settlement of the present dispute.

3. That no workers be allowed to work in secret and
those who attempt to break the strike be dealt
with according to strike discipline.

4. That the female propaganda corps be notified to
continue their activities in Pootung.

5. That Chen Bei-teh and Lur Ching-kwan (樓景觀)
be appointed as representatives to appeal for
assistance to the Central Kuomintang, the Executive
Yuan and the Ministry of Industry.

6. That the Seamen's Unions, the S.N.R. & S.H.N.R.
Transportation Coolies' Union and the Wharf Coolies'
Unions be asked to refuse to transport B.C.C. products.

7. That the Chinese Authorities be requested to negotiate
with the Management for the issue of monthly allowance
due to the school for B.C.C. workers' children.

In connection with Resolution No.6, it is learned
that B.C.C. cigarettes are still being transported although
the Shanghai Branch of the Chung Hwa Seamen's General
Labour Union, City, arranged to notify local tallymen to
cease doing so with effect from June 1 at the request of
the 5th District Cigarette Workers' Union (Vide I.R. 28/5/34).

Cabin Boys' Union - Unemployed boys demand work
- fracas in Union office

At 3.15 p.m. June 1, some 70 unemployed cabin
boys called at the Cabin Boys' Union, 26 Jeu Chao Zang
Ka, City and demanded that efforts be made to secure
employment for them. An altercation commenced in which
the unemployed blamed a committee member of the Union
for failing to assist them to find work. A fight then

upon the arrival of a party of Police.

June 1, 1934. Afternoon Translation.

China Times and other local newspapers:

THE STRIKE OF B.A.T. WORKERS.

The general strike of workers at the British-American Tobacco New Factory at Pootung has not lasted 10 days. The Social Bureau held a mediation meeting, but it had no result owing to the absence of representatives of the management. Work in both the new and the old factories has therefore come to a standstill.

About 40 White Russians are reported to have been engaged for work in the Boiler Room. The strikers have formed propaganda corps to operate in various districts.

The rolled tobacco in the warehouse can not be delivered owing to lack of transportation workers. The gates of the two factories are being guarded by the Police of the 3rd Branch of the Public Safety Bureau.

As a rule, the Company issues the wages of the workers on the 15th and the 30th of each month. Yesterday the management sent out a circular notice stating that all workers of the New Factory would be given their pay at the Company. Formerly, half of the workers' pay is retained by the Company, but yesterday the management paid the wages in full.

The B.A.T. Workers Children School receives a monthly allowance of $1,050 from the Company. The money is handed by the management to Chang Ts-ping (張子平) and Ning Tseng-ziang (任楨祥), two members of the Economic Committee of the Board of Directors of the School, at the end of every month.

Yesterday, the officials called at the Company for the allowance but were informed that the money had been transmitted to Chinese official organs. Enquiries were made at the various official organs by representatives of the workers and the statement of the Company was found to be untrue.

The Shanghai Branch of the China Seamen's Union has ordered all workers on the various steamers engaged in loading and discharging cargoes to cease the transportation of the goods of the B.A.T. Company as from June 1.

The China Seamen's Tangpu yesterday despatched a letter to the Strike Committee to the effect that it has decided to order all subordinate seamen' bodies to render support to the B.A.T. workers.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

FAMILIES OF VICTIMS OF MAY 30TH TRAGEDY SUBMIT APPEAL

Some time ago, Tsan Chun Ding (詹春廷) and others, relatives of the victims of May 30th Tragedy, brought an action in the First Special District Court against Yu Ya Ching and others for misappropriation of over $70,000, part of the compassionate grant of $150,000 issued by the Shanghai Municipal Council to the families of the victims,

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸：

英美烟草公司工人罢工。

浦东英美烟草新厂工人的总罢工持续不到10天。社会局曾举行调解会议，但因资方代表缺席而无结果。因此，新厂和老厂的工作均已陷入停顿。

据悉，约有40名白俄受雇在锅炉房工作。罢工者已组建宣传队，在各区开展活动。

由于缺乏运输工人，仓库中的卷烟无法运出。两所工厂的大门正由公安局第三分局的警察把守。

通常，公司于每月15日和30日发放工人工资。昨日，管理层发出通告，称新厂所有工人将在公司领取薪水。以往，公司会扣留工人一半的工资，但昨日管理层全额支付了工资。

英美烟草公司工人子弟学校每月从公司获得1,050美元的津贴。这笔钱由管理层在每月底交给学校董事会经济委员会的两名成员张子平（Chang Ts-ping）和任楨祥（Ning Tseng-ziang）。

昨日，校方人员前往公司领取津贴，但被告知款项已汇交中国官方机构。工人代表向各官方机构查询，发现公司的说法不实。

中国海员工会上海分会已命令所有从事装卸货物的各轮船工人，自6月1日起停止运输英美烟草公司的货物。

中国海员塘沽分会昨日致信罢工委员会，表示已决定命令其下属所有海员团体支持英美烟草公司工人。

Labour

B.C.C. Factories in Pootung - Situation

The strike situation in B.C.C. "New" Factory,
Pootung, remains unchanged.

On May 31, some 800 workers of the "New" Factory
received their wages for May from the management.
During the payment, thirty members of the maintenance
corps formed by the Strike Committee were stationed
outside the factory to maintain order. The distribution
of wages will be continued to-day, June 1.

A notice was issued by the strike committee
instructing all workers not to pay attention to rumours,
not to break the strike nor to cause trouble.

At the request of the management, a party of Chinese
Police are now posted in the "New" Factory.

On May 31, two committeemen of the 5th District
Cigarette Workers' Union and concurrently the members
of the Board of Directors of the School for the Workers'
Children called upon the manager to receive the monthly
allowance to the school. The manager however refused
to pay in consequence of the present strike. The
Union has arranged to report the matter to the City
Government and the Bureau of Education for assistance.

浦东英美烟草公司工厂 - 局势

浦东英美烟草公司“新”厂的罢工局势保持不变。

5月31日，“新”厂约800名工人从管理层领取了5月份的工资。在发薪期间，由罢工委员会组建的纠察队三十名成员驻守在厂外维持秩序。工资发放将于今日，即6月1日继续进行。

罢工委员会发布通知，指示所有工人不要听信谣言，不要破坏罢工或制造事端。

应管理层要求，一批中国警察现已部署在“新”厂内。

5月31日，第五区卷烟业工会的两名委员兼工人子弟学校董事会成员拜访经理，要求领取给学校的月度津贴。然而，经理以当前罢工为由拒绝支付。工会已安排将此事项报告市政府和教育局以求协助。

May 31, 1934.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5894
Date 1 / 6 / 34

Afternoon Translation.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

B.A.T. WORKERS.

With reference to the strike of workers of the British-American Tobacco New Factory, the Social Bureau yesterday held a meeting which had no result owing to the absence of representatives of the management. The trouble has become more serious day by day and the No. 3 Factory will probably be affected.

The Frozen & Fresh Fish Dealers Association, the Fruit & Vegetable Dealers Association and 4 other shop-owners associations have issued the following joint manifesto:-

"The B.A.T. Old Factory did not close owing to trade depression or the disobedience of the workers. Actually, the Factory is attempting to discharge a number of old workers without issuing compassionate grants. This oppressive action on the part of the management has aroused our anger. We should assist these workers and do our utmost to make the management realize that oppression will not be tolerated.

"B.A.T. workers! You must do your utmost and unite with a view to securing a favourable settlement of the dispute. Otherwise, you will be sacrificed. Furthermore, other foreign capitalists will follow the example of the B.A.T. Company and more workers will be unemployed.

"The public are expected to support these several thousand workers."

30,000 seamen expressed dissatisfaction when the management ignored the order of the Authorities to attend the mediation meeting. Some days ago, the Strike Committee requested the seamen and railway workers not to transport B.A.T. goods.

To support the B.A.T. workers, all workers engaged in loading and discharging the goods will cease work on June 1. Other workers at Pootung will join the movement. The Pootung Fellow Countrymen's Association will hold a meeting at which measures to render assistance will be devised.

It is understood that a "B.A.T. Factory Workers Strike Support Committee" to be formed by the various public bodies will hold its inaugural meeting in a few days.

China Times and other local newspapers:

GENERAL STAFF HEADQUARTERS TO CANCEL FOREIGN PILOTS RIGHT

Hearing that foreign pilots had submitted some proposals for the amendment of the regulations prohibiting the employment of foreign pilots, the Chinese Chamber of Commerce some time ago despatched a telegram to the National Government requesting the authorities to remain firm in its determination to withdraw the pilots rights from foreigners.

Yesterday a reply was received from the General Staff Headquarters informing the Chamber that the decision made regarding the withdrawal of the pilots' right from foreigners will be strictly adhered to.

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

英美烟草公司工人。

关于英美烟草新厂工人罢工一事，社会局昨日举行会议，但因资方代表缺席而无结果。事态日益严重，第三厂可能会受到影响。

冰鲜鱼商公会、果蔬商公会及其他4个店主公会发表了以下联合宣言：

“英美烟草老厂关闭并非因为贸易萧条或工人不服从。实际上，工厂试图在不发放抚恤金的情况下解雇一批老工人。管理层的这种压迫行为激起了我们的愤怒。我们应该帮助这些工人，并尽最大努力让管理层认识到，压迫是不可容忍的。

“英美烟草公司的工人们！你们必须竭尽全力，团结一致，以争取纠纷的有利解决。否则，你们将成为牺牲品。此外，其他外国资本家将效仿英美烟草公司，导致更多工人失业。

“期望公众支持这几千名工人。”

当管理层无视当局出席调解会议的命令时，3万名海员表示不满。日前，罢工委员会请求海员和铁路工人不要运输英美烟草公司的货物。

为支持英美烟草公司工人，所有从事货物装卸的工人将于6月1日停工。浦东其他工人也将加入这一运动。浦东同乡会将举行会议，制定援助措施。

据悉，由各公共团体组成的“英美烟草厂工人罢工后援会”将于数日后举行成立大会。

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸：

参谋本部将取消外籍引水权

获悉外籍引水员提交了一些关于修改禁止雇佣外籍引水员规定的提案后，上海总商会日前致电国民政府，请求当局坚定决心，收回外籍人士的引水权。

昨日收到参谋本部的复电，告知商会，关于收回外籍人士引水权的决定将得到严格执行。

Labour (1)                                      May 31, 1934.

B.C.C. Factories in Pootung Situation

    The strike situation in the B.C.C. "New" Factory,
Pootung, remains unchanged.
    The Management of B.C.C. issued a notice on May 30
intimating that the wages due to the workers of the "New"
Factory for May would be distributed on May 31, June 1 and 2.
The 5th District Cigarette Workers' Union has notified the
operatives to keep strict order during the payment, and
arranged to detail propaganda corps to maintain order outside
the Factory.
    On May 30, a joint manifesto was issued by the Trade
Associations in Nantao including the Fishing Trade Association.
It states that the closing down of the No.1 Factory was not
due to business depression but was done with a view to
dispensing with the services of a number of old workers in
order to evade paying their bonuses. The B.C.C. workers
should, therefore, unanimously persist in the struggle
against the oppression by the Management. As there is
every reason to believe, the notice further states that
other foreign concerns may follow the example of the B.C.C.
thus resulting in an increase in the number of unemployed,
the public are to render justifiable assistance to the
B.C.C. workers to reach a settlement of the dispute.
    Some 20 members of the propaganda corps formed by
the strike committee carried out their activities on May 30
in the vicinity of Small East Gate, Nantao, in persuading
the public not to smoke B.C.C. cigarettes.

    英美烟草公司管理层于5月30日发布通知，告知“新”厂工人5月份应付工资将于5月31日、6月1日和2日发放。
    第五区卷烟业工会已通知操作工人在发薪期间保持严格秩序，并安排派遣宣传队在厂外维持秩序。
    5月30日，包括渔业同业公会在内的南市各同业公会发表联合宣言。宣言指出，第一厂的关闭并非由于生意萧条，而是为了规避支付奖金而辞退一批老工人。因此，英美烟草公司工人应团结一致，坚持与管理层的压迫作斗争。宣言进一步指出，有充分理由相信，其他外国企业可能会效仿英美烟草公司，从而导致失业人数增加，公众应对英美烟草公司工人给予正当援助，以达成纠纷的解决。
    5月30日，由罢工委员会组建的宣传队约20名成员在南市小东门附近开展活动，劝说公众不要吸食英美烟草公司的香烟。

B.C.C. Factories in Pootung - Situation

The strike situation in the B.C.C. "New" Factory,
Pootung, remains unchanged.

At 10 a.m. May 29, a meeting was convened under
the auspices of the Bureau of Social Affairs in the organ
at the New Civic Centre when representatives of the 5th
District Cigarette Workers' Union, the local Kuomintang
and the Bureau of Public Safety were present. Owing to
the absence of the delegates of the Management, no
definite result was reached. A letter was despatched
to the Bureau in question by the Management stating that
the details in connection with the closing down of the
No.1 Factory had been verbally reported to Wong Kong,
responsible for dealing with the dispute. Consequently
it was not necessary for the Management to send
representatives to attend the meeting.

In view of the attitude of the Management, the
Strike Committee has appealed for assistance by telegram
to the Central Kuomintang. A letter was also sent to
Tu Yueh-sung, soliciting his support in settling the dispute.

Between 3 p.m. and 5 p.m. May 29, some 28 Chinese
claiming to represent the Pootung Fellow Countrymen's
Association and public bodies in Pootung were entertained
by the Strike Committee in the Chinese Y.M.C.A., 123
Boulevard de Montigny. Chen Bei-teh, Chairman of the 5th
District Cigarette Workers' Union, presided and made a
report in connection with the closing down of the No.1 Factor,
which resulted in the present strike. The attendance

浦东英美烟公司工厂——局势

浦东英美烟公司“新”工厂的罢工局势保持不变。

5月29日上午10时，在社会局的主持下，于新市中心机关召开了一次会议，第五区卷烟业工会代表、当地国民党党部及公安局代表均出席。由于资方代表缺席，未达成任何确切结果。资方向该局致函称，关于第一工厂关闭的细节已口头向负责处理此纠纷的王刚（Wong Kong）报告。因此，资方认为无需派代表出席会议。

鉴于资方的态度，罢工委员会已致电国民党中央请求援助。另致函杜月笙，恳请其支持以解决此纠纷。

5月29日下午3时至5时之间，约28名自称代表浦东同乡会及浦东各公共团体的华人，在蒙太尼路（Boulevard de Montigny）123号中华基督教青年会接受罢工委员会的招待。第五区卷烟业工会主席陈北德（Chen Bei-teh）主持会议，并就导致此次罢工的第一工厂关闭一事作了报告。与会者

May 30, 1934. Afternoon Translation.

The following advertisement was inserted by the
Rickshaw Owners Association of the Special District
in the Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:-

"All owners of public rickshaws are hereby notified
that the date for the examination of registration
certificates issued by this office is extended until
June 5th. After the registration certificates have
been examined, new certificates to replace the old
ones will be issued.
"Those owners who have not yet received their
registration certificates are hereby requested to
register with this office. When new registration
certificates are issued, a report will be made to the
authorities and all old ones irrespective of whether or not
they have been examined will be declared null and void."

Min Pao and other local newspapers:

THE B. A. T. WORKERS

At 10 am yesterday, the Bureau of Social Affairs
held a meeting at which persons representing the
B.A.T. workers, the local Tangpu, the Bureau of Public
Safety and the Social Bureau were present. Wong Kong
(王 剛) of the Social Bureau presided. No result
was reached because no representatives from the
management were present. During the function represent-
atives of the workers denounced the management for having
violated the Law and paid no heed to the instructions
of the Social Bureau, and stated that the management
should bear the responsibility should other disputes
arise. The president accepted the opinion of the
workers, which will be considered by the Chief of the
Social Bureau. It is learned that the dispute will
be settled in accordance with the regulations governing
disputes between employers and employees.
At 3 p.m. yesterday the Strike Committee of the
B.A.T. workers gave a reception to the members of the
Managing and Supervisory Committees of the Pootung Fellow
Provincials Association on the 8th floor of the Chinese
Y.M.C.A. Building, French Concession. Some 40 persons
attended and it was decided that the Association should
hold a meeting without delay.
The 5th District Rolled Tobacco Workers Union
yesterday despatched telegrams to the People's Movement
Direction Committee of the Central Kuomintang Headquarters
and the Ministry of Industry requesting them to instruct
the management to reopen the factory.
Yesterday the Strike Committee wrote to Mr. Doo Yueh
Sun(杜月笙), Chairman of the Managing Committee of the
Pootung Fellow Provincials Association requesting him to
uphold justice and to mediate into the dispute.
The Pootung Fellow Provincials Association has decided
to hold a meeting of various public bodies to discuss
measures for the formation of a "Support Committee."

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

英美烟草公司工人

昨日上午10时，社会局召开会议，英美烟草公司工人代表、当地塘浦（Tangpu，音译）、公安局及社会局代表均出席。社会局王刚（Wong Kong）主持。因资方代表缺席，未达成结果。会上，工人代表谴责资方违法并无视社会局指令，并表示若发生其他纠纷，资方应承担责任。主席采纳了工人的意见，该意见将由社会局局长审议。据悉，纠纷将依照劳资纠纷处理法规予以解决。
昨日下午3时，英美烟草公司工人罢工委员会在法租界中华基督教青年会大楼八楼，招待浦东同乡会管理委员会委员及监察委员会委员。约40人出席，会议决定该会将立即召开会议。
第五区卷烟草业工会昨日致电国民党中央总部民众运动指导委员会及实业部，请求指令资方重新开工。
昨日，罢工委员会致函浦东同乡会管理委员会主席杜月笙先生，请求其主持公道并调解此纠纷。
浦东同乡会已决定召集各公共团体开会，讨论组建“后援会”的措施。

May 29,

Labour

B.C.C. Factories in Pootung - Situation

The strike situation in the B.C.C. "New" Factory,
Pootung, remains unchanged.

The Bureau of Social Affairs will conduct mediation
in its offices this morning, May 29. Notices have been
sent to the management and the 5th District Cigarette
Workers' Union to detail their representatives to attend
the conference.

Between 4 p.m. and 5.20 p.m. May 28, thirty-nine
members of the Strike Committee met in the office of the
Union in question, 78 Lan Nyi Doo Road, Pootung, and
passed the following decisions :-

1. That Chen Bei-teh and Lur Ching-kwan (楼景观) be
appointed as delegates of the strikers to attend the
conference to be convened by the Bureau of Social
Affairs.

2. That preparations be made to entertain the members of the
Pootung Fellow Countrymen's Association in the afternoon
of May 29 with a view to soliciting their assistance.

3. That all the workers be notified to keep strict order
until a settlement of the dispute is reached.

4. That the management be ordered during the mediation
conference to grant wages as usual to the workers
for the period of strike.

5. That endeavours be made to induce the workers of the
B.C.C. Thorburn Road Factory to join the strike should
the mediation by the Bureau of Social Affairs prove
a failure.

On May 28, members of the propaganda corps formed
by the strike committee carried out their activities in
persuading the public in Pootung not to smoke cigarettes
manufactured by the B.C.C.

1934年5月29日，

劳工

浦东英美烟公司工厂——局势

浦东英美烟公司“新”工厂的罢工局势保持不变。

社会局将于今日（5月29日）上午在其办公室进行调解。已向资方及第五区卷烟业工会发出通知，要求派遣代表出席会议。

5月28日下午4时至5时20分之间，罢工委员会三十九名成员在该工会办公室（浦东兰尼杜路78号）集会，并通过以下决议：

1. 指派陈北德（Chen Bei-teh）和楼景观（Lur Ching-kwan）为罢工者代表，出席由社会局召开的会议。

2. 筹备于5月29日下午招待浦东同乡会成员，以争取其援助。

3. 通知所有工人，在纠纷解决之前保持严格秩序。

4. 在调解会议期间，责令资方照常支付工人在罢工期间的工资。

5. 若社会局的调解失败，则设法促使英美烟公司索恩伯恩路（Thorburn Road）工厂的工人加入罢工。

5月28日，由罢工委员会组成的宣传队成员在浦东开展活动，劝说公众不要吸食英美烟公司制造的香烟。

Labour (2)

On the same morning, seven members of the Strike
Committee appealed for assistance to the local Kuomintang.
They were promised that efforts would be made to bring
about an amicable settlement.

In compliance with the notice of the Union, some
600 workers in the Tobacco Leaf Room of the B.C.C.
factories in Pootung have registered with the Union
Office.

In the afternoon of May 28, thirty Chinese claiming
to represent various labour unions in Pootung held a
joint meeting in the office of the 5th District Kuomintang
Branch, 215 Police Station Road, Pootung, when it was
decided that a "Support Committee" be formed with the
attendance as members. It was further resolved that
financial assistance be rendered to the strikers should
the mediation of the Bureau of Social Affairs fail to
bring the dispute to a conclusion. In addition, a
joint manifesto was issued, denouncing the oppressive
measure adopted by the management of B.C.C. Factories in
Pootung in closing down the No.1 concern resulting in the
workers being thrown out of employment. It further
states that the workers of respective trades would be
notified not to buy and transport B.C.C. products as long
as the factory remains closed.

劳工（续）

同日早晨，罢工委员会七名成员向当地国民党党部请求援助。对方承诺将努力促成和解。

根据工会的通知，浦东英美烟公司工厂烟叶房约600名工人已在工会办事处登记。

5月28日下午，三十名自称代表浦东各工会的华人在浦东警察站路215号第五区国民党党部办公室举行联席会议，决定成立“后援会”，与会者均为会员。会议进一步决议，若社会局的调解未能终结纠纷，则向罢工者提供财政援助。此外，还发表了一份联合宣言，谴责浦东英美烟公司资方采取压迫性措施关闭第一工厂，导致工人失业。宣言还指出，只要工厂继续关闭，将通知各行业工人不得购买和运输英美烟公司的产品。

May 29, 1934. Afternoon Translation.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

ENCOUNTER BETWEEN PIRATES AND PUBLIC SAFETY BUREAU
RIVER POLICE.

Shortly after 7 a.m. May 27, a number of pirate vessels were located outside Woosung about to pirate a fishing boat. A report was made to the officer-in-charge of the 3rd Division River Police of the Public Safety Bureau, who sent several patrol boats under the command of Ho Ting-fah ( 胡芝發 ), Chief of the 14th Squadron, to capture the pirates.
Serious fighting ensued and as a result, three pirate vessels were destroyed, a ringleader of the pirates named Vai Lou Der Ts ( 花老頭子 ) was shot dead, about 20 pirates were arrested and three kidnapped persons were rescued.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

CHINESE BUDDHIST REPRESENTATIVES TO ATTEND CONFERENCE
IN JAPAN.

With reference to the conference of various buddhist youths associations of countries bordering the Pacific Ocean to be held in Japan, a certain member of the buddhist organization stated that although Shan Sin ( 常惺 ) would be the leader of Chinese buddhist representatives attending the conference, the scheme had been promoted by Muh Shou ( 墨禪 ), another disciple of Abbot Tai Shu ( 太虛法師 ). Prior to the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese Hostilities in Shanghai, Muh Shou stayed in the house of Choh Yuan ( 覺園 ) in Shanghai and after the conflict, he proceeded to Japan. He is now sojourning at Fusho, Japan, and it is obvious that he has some connection with the Japanese Authorities. The departure of Shan Sin and others for Japan to participate in the conference was therefore instigated by Muh Shou.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :

B.A.T. WORKERS

With reference to the labour dispute in the B.A.T. Pootung Factories, the Social Bureau yesterday morning called representatives of the workers to a meeting. Zung Lei Teh ( 陳培德 ) and Lou Chin Kwan ( 樓景觀 ) representing the workers were present and were received by Hsu Yih Fu ( 許也夫 ), Chief of the 3rd Section of the Bureau.
During the function the two representatives requested the Bureau to instruct the management to reopen the factory. Mr. Hsu promised to do so after instructions to this effect have been received from the authorities.

1934年5月29日。下午译文。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

海盗与公安局水上警察遭遇战。

5月27日上午7时许，在吴淞外海发现数艘海盗船正欲劫掠一艘渔船。随即向公安局第三分区水上警察负责人报告，该负责人派遣由第十四队队长胡芝發（Ho Ting-fah）指挥的数艘巡逻艇前往缉捕海盗。
随后发生激烈战斗，结果击毁海盗船三艘，击毙海盗头目花老頭子（Vai Lou Der Ts），逮捕海盗约20名，并解救被绑架人员三名。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

中国佛教代表将赴日本参加会议。

关于将在日本举行的环太平洋各国佛教青年协会会议，某佛教组织成员称，虽然常惺（Shan Sin）将作为出席该会议的中国佛教代表团团长，但该计划是由太虛法師的另一位弟子墨禪（Muh Shou）推动的。在上海中日冲突爆发前，墨禪曾居住在上海的覺園（Choh Yuan），冲突发生后，他前往日本。目前他寄居在日本福寿（Fusho，音译），显然他与日本当局有一定联系。因此，常惺等人赴日参会是由墨禪唆使的。

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

英美烟草公司工人

关于英美烟草公司浦东工厂的劳资纠纷，社会局昨日上午召集工人代表开会。代表工人的陈培德（Zung Lei Teh）和楼景观（Lou Chin Kwan）出席，并由该局第三科科长许也夫（Hsu Yih Fu）接见。
会上，两位代表请求社会局指令资方重新开工。许科长承诺，在收到当局的相关指令后将照办。

May 29, 1934. Afternoon Translation.

At 8 a.m. yesterday Zung Bei Tuh and three others were detailed by the Strike Committee to make a further appeal to the local Tangpu. Woo Kai Sien (吴开先), a committee member of the Tangpu, entertained the callers who demanded the immediate reopening of the factory. The committee member promised to bring their request before the meeting to be held by the Social Bureau at 10 a.m. today. Both the management and the workers have been instructed to send delegates to attend the meeting.

Yesterday afternoon some 11 labour unions held a joint meeting at which it was resolved to issue a manifesto in support of the workers.

Following the declaration of the strike by the workers and Chinese staff members, over 100 White Russians have been engaged by the management. The daily wage of each Russian employee is $3 and food is also supplied by the management to these Russians. Thus the treatment accorded to the Russians is much better than that accorded to the Chinese. It is learned that these Russians who are now undergoing training, will be permanently engaged and more Russians will be employed.

The citizens at Pootung have refused to smoke cigarettes manufactured by the B.A.T. factories, and following the advice of the Propaganda Corps of the Strike Committee, the cigarette shops at Pootung have sealed up the products of the B.A.T. factories and withdrawn the advertisements for B.A.T. cigarettes. The Propaganda Corps of the Strike Committee intends to destroy the advertisement boards on the streets if such a course is considered necessary.

The Strike Committee will give a reception to the Pootung Fellow Provincials Association at 3 p.m. today and another to reporters of various foreign and Chinese newspapers and news agencies at 3 p.m. to-morrow, while other public bodies will be also entertained later.

At 5 p.m. yesterday the Strike Committee held a meeting at which it was resolved that Zung Bei Teh and Liu Tuh Hwa (刘得华) be elected to attend the meeting to be held by the Bureau of Social Affairs today.

China Evening News dated May 28 :

FOREIGN BANKS NOT TO ISSUE BANKNOTES

In order to enforce the paper money order, the special right granted to foreign banks to issue banknotes must be withdrawn. (Under the protection of the unequal treaties, the foreign banks issue notes.)

According to reliable information, the Ministry of Finance has requested the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to open negotiations with the foreign nations and to order foreign banks in China to observe Chinese law.

1934年5月29日。下午译件。

昨日上午8时，罢工委员会指派 Zung Bei Tuh（音译）等三人再次向当地党部提出呼吁。党部委员吴开先接待了来访者，后者要求立即复工。该委员承诺将把他们的请求提交给社会局于今日上午10时召开的会议审议。资方和工人都已接到指示，派遣代表出席会议。

昨日下午，约11个工会举行联席会议，决议发表宣言支持工人。

在工人和华籍职员宣布罢工后，资方雇佣了100多名白俄人。每名俄籍员工的日薪为3元，资方还向这些俄国人提供食物。因此，给予俄国人的待遇远优于华人。据悉，这些正在接受培训的俄国人将被长期雇佣，并将雇佣更多俄国人。

浦东市民拒绝吸食英美烟厂生产的香烟，并遵循罢工委员会宣传队的建议，浦东的香烟店已封存英美烟厂的产品，并撤下了英美牌香烟的广告。罢工委员会宣传队打算在认为有必要时，销毁街头的广告牌。

罢工委员会将于今日下午3时招待浦东同乡会，并于明日下午3时招待各中外报纸及通讯社记者，稍后还将招待其他公共团体。

昨日下午5时，罢工委员会举行会议，决议选举 Zung Bei Teh（音译）和刘得华出席社会局今日举行的会议。

5月28日《中国晚报》：

外商银行不再发行钞票

为执行法币命令，必须取消授予外商银行发行钞票的特权。（在不平等条约的保护下，外商银行发行钞票。）

据可靠消息，财政部已请求外交部与各国开启谈判，并命令在华外商银行遵守中国法律。

B.C.C. Factories in Pootung - Situation

The strike situation in the B.C.C. "New" Factory

浦东英美烟公司工厂 - 局势

Labour (5)

In the same morning, six members of the Propaganda
Corps appeared in the vicinity of the "New" Factory and
made an unsuccessful attempt to prevent the workers on the
steam launches from entering the factory to report for duty.

It is learned that some 50 Russians have now been
engaged by the Management in the Boiler Rooms and in
carrying out other duties.

Between 12 noon and 1 p.m. May 26 two delegates
of the strikers were interrogated at the Civic Centre by
officials of the City Government in connection with the
present dispute in the B.C.C. factories.

It is reported that the members of the Strike
Committee will appeal for assistance to the local Tangpu
this morning.

With a view to discussing measures to support
the strike, the 5th District Cotton Weaving Factory Workers'
Union, the Carpenters and Masons' Union, the Match Factory
Workers' Union, and the Cargo Transportation Coolies' Union
will hold a meeting to-day, May 28 in the 5th District
Kuomintang Branch Office, 215 Police Station Road, Pootung.

The City Government and the local Kuomintang have
received a telegram from General Chiang Kai-shek, stating
that the dispute existing in the B.C.C. should be settled
before the end of this month.

5月28日， / 4

劳工 (5)

同日早晨，六名宣传队成员出现在“新”厂附近，试图阻止乘坐蒸汽艇的工人进厂报到上班，但未成功。

据悉，资方已在锅炉房及其他岗位雇佣了约50名俄国人。

5月26日中午12时至下午1时之间，两名罢工代表在市中心被市政府官员就英美烟公司工厂目前的纠纷进行讯问。

据报道，罢工委员会成员将于今晨向当地党部寻求援助。

为讨论支持罢工的措施，第五区棉纺织厂工人工会、木工和泥瓦匠工会、火柴厂工人工会以及货物搬运苦力工会将于今日（5月28日）在浦东警察路215号国民党第五区党部办事处举行会议。

市政府和当地国民党收到蒋介石将军发来的电报，称英美烟公司的纠纷应在本月底前解决。

May 28, 4.

Labour (6)

Five committee members of the Shanghai Branch
of the Chung Hwa Seamen's General Labour Union held a
meeting in their office at 33 Oong Ka Ts Loong, City,
between 3.30 p.m. and 5 p.m. May 26 and passed the
following decisions :-

1. That in compliance with the request of the 5th District
Cigarette Workers' Union, the tallymen of the Indo-China
Steam Navigation Company, the China Navigation Company
and the China Merchants Steam Navigation Company, etc. be
notified to suspend transportation of B.C.C. products
with effect from June 1.

2. That the 5th District Cigarette Workers' Union be
informed of the decision.

3. That the Chung Hwa Seamen's General Labour Union be
requested to report the matter to the Central
Kuomintang.

It is learned that the strikers are endeavouring
to induce the workers of the B.C.C. Thorburn Road Factory
who are living in Footun to go on strike in support of
the former. There is a possibility that these workers
may fail to turn up for work as a result of intimidation.

5月28日，4.

劳工 (6)

中华海员总工会上海分会的五名委员于5月26日下午3时30分至5时，在市区翁家弄33号的办公室举行会议，并通过以下决定：-

1. 应第五区卷烟业工会的请求，通知印度支那轮船公司、中国航运公司和招商局轮船公司等公司的理货员，自6月1日起停止运输英美烟公司的产品。

2. 将此决定通知第五区卷烟业工会。

May 28, 1934. Afternoon Translation.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :

B.A.T. WORKERS

With reference to the strike of workers in the
B.A.T. New Factory, the local Tangpu apart from petitioning
the Central Authorities and the Shanghai City Government to
settle the dispute at an early date, sent Woo Kai Sien (吴开先),
a member of the Supervisory Committee of the Tangpu, to the
Central Authorities at Nanking requesting them to devise
measures for the settlement of the dispute. The delegate is
due to return here this morning.
In view of the obstinate attitude of the management
of the factory, the Strike Committee has decided to send Zung
Bei Teh (张北德) and 38 others to make a further appeal to the
local Tangpu at 10 a.m. to-day.
In a reply to the Strike Committee, the Shanghai
Branch of the China Seamen's Union stated that the Union would
instruct all the tallymen not to transport products of the
B.A.T. factories. Information secured by a reporter of the
Dah Kung News Agency from the Seamen's Union, revealed that
members of the Union would refuse to transport productions
of the B.A.T. factories with effect from June 1.
It is learned that yesterday the local Tangpu
and the Shanghai City Government received telegrams from
General Chiang Kai Shek instructing them to settle the
dispute before the end of this month.
Yesterday the Bureau of Social Affairs issued
notices to the management and the workers to the effect that a
meeting would be convened at 10 a.m. May 29 and requesting
that two responsible persons from each party be detailed to
attend the meeting.
The Shanghai General Labour Union has submitted
petitions to the local Tangpu and other political organs urging
an early settlement of the dispute. The Pootung Fellow
Provincials Associations and various labour unions will call
meetings to discuss relief measures for the workers.
The 5th District Rolled Tobacco Workers Union
will give a reception in honour of the members of the
Executive Committee of the Pootung Fellow Provincials
Association at 3 p.m. to-morrow and another to the reporters
of various newspapers and news agencies in the afternoon of
May 30 as well as owners of Chinese cigarette factories.
All the parties will be requested to render assistance.

Min Pao and other local newspapers (Nanking Telegram) :

CONVICT LABOUR FOR HIGHWAYS

The Ministry of Justice on May 27 instructed the
High Courts in various provinces to impose upon prisoners
the task of constructing highways. Any prisoner who does not
carry out the work in a diligent manner, is to be returned
to the prison whence he came to complete his original
sentence.

1934年5月28日。下午译件。

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

英美烟公司工人

关于英美烟公司新厂工人罢工一事，当地党部除 petitioning（原文如此，意为请愿）中央当局和上海市政府早日解决纠纷外，还派遣党部监察委员会委员吴开先前往南京中央当局，请求他们制定解决纠纷的措施。该代表预计将于今晨返回此地。
鉴于工厂资方的顽固态度，罢工委员会决定派遣张北德等38人于今日上午10时再次向当地党部提出呼吁。
中国海员工会上海分会在回复罢工委员会时表示，该会将指示所有理货员不运输英美烟厂的产品。大公通讯社记者从海员工会获得的消息显示，工会成员将自6月1日起拒绝运输英美烟厂的产品。
据悉，昨日当地党部和上海市政府收到蒋介石将军的电报，指示他们在本月底前解决纠纷。
昨日，社会局向资方和工人发出通知，称将于5月29日上午10时召开会议，并要求双方各派两名负责人出席会议。
上海总工会已向当地党部及其他政治机关提交请愿书，敦促早日解决纠纷。浦东同乡会及各工会将召开会议，讨论对工人的救济措施。
第五区卷烟草工人工会将于明日下午3时设宴招待浦东同乡会执行委员会委员，并于5月30日下午招待各报社及通讯社记者以及华商烟厂厂主。
将请求各方提供援助。

司法部于5月27日指令各省高等法院安排囚犯承担修筑公路的任务。任何不勤勉工作的囚犯，将被送回原监狱服完原判刑期。

May 27, 1934. Morning Translation.

Min Pao and other local newspapers:

B.A.T. WORKERS.

With reference to the strike of workers in the British-American Tobacco New Factory, about 40 more White Russians were engaged yesterday to carry on operations.
The Central People's Movement Committee and the Ministry of Industry yesterday despatched replies to the Workers Union stating that instructions had been given to the Shanghai City Government and the Shanghai District Tangpu to co-operate in dealing with the dispute.
Mr. O.K. Yue, Chief Secretary of the Shanghai City Government, yesterday had a conversation with Chen Bei-teh ( 陳倍德 ) and Lou Ching-kwan ( 樓景冠 ), representatives of the workers. The Mediation Section of the Social Bureau will hold a meeting on May 30.
To prevent reactionary elements from creating disturbances, the Strike Committee has issued a circular notice calling for registration of workers of various departments of both the new and old factories to be carried out commencing from May 28.
At a meeting held at 3 p.m. yesterday by the Strike Committee, the following resolutions were passed:-
1. That public bodies be entertained and asked for assistance.
2. That a telegram be despatched to General Chiang Kai-shek, Chief of the Military Affairs Commission, requesting him to order the B.A.T. Company to re-open the No. 1 Factory.
The telegram referred to above was sent yesterday to the General by the Strike Committee.
The Committee will entertain the committeemen of the Footung Fellow Countrymen's Association at 3 p.m. May 29 and the reporters of various local Chinese and foreign newspapers and news agencies at 3 p.m. May 30.
With a view to giving the public a real understanding of the circumstances surrounding the strike, the Committee has formed Propaganda Groups to function in various places in Shanghai.
In a press interview, Chen Bei-teh, an official of the Strike Committee, stated that the 6,000 workers of the 3rd Factory have become very enraged over the high-handed action of the Company and are desirous of joining the strike movement. At the request of the Company, armed police have been posted within and without the 3rd Factory to take precautionary measures. The official added that in an emergency, these workers would participate in the movement without considering what might happen to them.
The Shanghai Branch of the Seamen's Union yesterday sent a letter to the Workers Union emphasizing its support.

英美烟公司工人。

关于英美烟公司新厂工人罢工一事，昨日又雇佣了约40名白俄人以维持运营。
中央民众运动指导委员会和实业部昨日回复工会，称已指示上海市政府和上海区党部合作处理此纠纷。
上海市政府秘书长岳先生（O.K. Yue，音译）昨日与工人代表陈倍德和楼景冠进行了谈话。社会局调解科将于5月30日举行会议。
为防止反动分子制造骚乱，罢工委员会发布通告，要求新旧两厂各部门工人自5月28日起进行登记。
在昨日下午3时举行的罢工委员会会议上，通过了以下决议：-
1. 招待公共团体并请求援助。
2. 向军事委员会委员长蒋介石将军发电报，请求他命令英美烟公司重新开放第一厂。
上述电报已由罢工委员会于昨日发给蒋将军。
委员会将于5月29日下午3时招待 Footung（音译）同乡会委员，并于5月30日下午3时招待各本地中外报纸及通讯社记者。
为使公众真正了解罢工周围的情况，委员会成立了宣传组，在上海各地开展活动。
罢工委员会官员陈倍德在接受记者采访时称，第三厂的6000名工人对公司的强硬行动感到非常愤怒，并希望加入罢工运动。应公司要求，武装警察已被部署在第三厂内外，以采取预防措施。该官员补充说，在紧急情况下，这些工人将不计后果地参与运动。
海员工会上海分会昨日致信工人工会，强调其支持。

May 26, 1934. Morning Translation.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :

B.A.T. WORKERS

All the workers and Chinese staff members in
the B.A.T. New Factory on the morning of May 24 declared
a strike in support of the workers of the B.A.T. Old
Factory. The strike continued yesterday.
Yesterday the factory engaged 65 White Russians,
30 of them to operate the engines and the rest to work in
other departments of the factory. The Russians are
unexperienced and explosions are liable to occur.
It is learned that the Strike Committee will devise measures
to deal with the employment of White Russians, and the
pilots and workers on B.A.T. steamers have been requested
to join the strike.
At 4 p.m. yesterday the Strike Committee held
a meeting at which 39 persons were present and Zung Bei Tuh
(陳培德) presided. The following resolutions were
passed :-
1) That the pilots on B.A.T. steamers and cabin
boys be requested to join the strike.
2) That measures to deal with the employment of
White Russians be devised.
3) That the Maintenance Group of the Strike Committee
detail members to keep good order outside the factory.
4) That the "Female Propaganda Group" detail
members to propagate the strike in various districts.
5) That the Pootung Fellow Provincials Association and
various labour unions be requested to render assistance to
the Strike Committee.
Yesterday the Bureau of Social Affairs issued an
instruction to the 5th District Rolled Tobacco Workers Union
stating that an order has been received from the City
Government to the effect that the Social Bureau persuade
the management to reopen the Old Factory.
In response to the petition of the 5th Rolled
Tobacco Workers Union, the City Government has decided to
call the responsible persons of the Union to a meeting to be
held at 10 a.m. today, and instructed the Social Bureau to
mediate between the management and the workers. It is
learned that the Bureau will convene a meeting of representatives
of the management and the workers on May 29 and has requested
the local Tangpu to detail representatives to attend the
meeting.
It is further learned that General Chiang Kai
Shek yesterday sent a telegram to the local Tangpu and the
City Government instructing them to settle the dispute.
The 5th Rolled Tobacco Workers Union yesterday
issued copies of a letter to the Pootung Fellow Provincials
Association, various labour unions and public bodies urging
them to uphold justice and to render assistance.
The Strike Committee has organized a "Workers
Maintenance Group" with a view to preventing reactionary
elements from taking advantage of the strike to create
disturbances.

1934年5月26日。晨间译件。

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

英美烟草公司工人

5月24日上午，英美烟草公司新厂全体工人及中国职员宣布罢工，以支持英美烟草公司老厂工人。罢工于昨日持续进行。
昨日，该厂雇佣了65名白俄，其中30人操作引擎，其余人在工厂其他部门工作。这些俄国人缺乏经验，容易发生爆炸事故。
据悉，罢工委员会将制定措施以应对雇佣白俄一事，并已要求英美烟草公司轮船上的引水员和工人加入罢工。
昨日下午4时，罢工委员会举行会议，出席者39人，由张培德（音译，原文 Zung Bei Tuh，注：括号内中文名依常见对应推测，若不确定则保留音译，此处根据后文陈培德对应关系，暂按原文音译处理或参照后文统一，后文出现陈培德，此处Zung Bei Tuh极可能为同一人，但拼写差异大，依指令不确定保留原文加音译，但后文明确给出陈培德，故此处需仔细甄别。查看后文p145明确写出 Zung Pei Tuh (陈培德)。p140写的是 Zung Bei Tuh (陳培德)。看来是同一人，只是OCR或原文拼写波动。依指令“能确定的用当时通行的中文”，此处括号已给中文，故译为陈培德）主持。通过以下决议：
1) 要求英美烟草公司轮船上的引水员和侍应生加入罢工。
2) 制定措施以应对雇佣白俄之事。
3) 由罢工委员会维持组指派成员在厂外维持秩序。
4) 由“女子宣传队”指派成员在各区进行罢工宣传。
5) 请求浦东同乡会及各工会协助罢工委员会。
昨日，社会局向第五区卷烟业工会发出指示，称已收到市政府命令，要求社会局劝告资方重新开放老厂。
应第五区卷烟业工会之请，市政府决定于今日上午10时召集工会负责人开会，并指示社会局在资方与工人之间进行调解。据悉，社会局将于5月29日召开资方与工人代表会议，并已请求当地党部指派代表出席会议。
另悉，蒋介石将军昨日致电当地党部和市政府，指示他们解决此纠纷。
第五区卷烟业工会昨日向浦东同乡会、各工会及公共团体分发信函副本，呼吁他们主持正义并提供援助。
罢工委员会已组织“工人维持队”，旨在防止反动分子利用罢工制造骚乱。

Labour

B.C.C. Factories in Pootung - strike situation in "New"
Factory

The strike situation in the B.C.C. "New" Factory,
Pootung, remains unchanged this morning.

Thirty-nine members of the Strike Committee met in
the 5th District Cigarette Workers' Union, 78 Lan Nyi Doo
Road, Pootung, between 4 p.m. and 6 p.m. May 25, when
the following decisions were discussed and passed :-

1. That the workers on the steam launches be urged to
join the strike.

2. That endeavours be made to persuade the White Russians
in the employ of the Company to cease work, and that
should these efforts prove abortive, force be used
against them.

3. That the strike maintenance corps be notified to carry
out their activities in the vicinity of the factory to
prevent workers from operating in secret.

4. That the female propaganda corps be detailed to
commence functioning in Pootung.

5. That the Pootung Fellow Countrymen's Association and
the local labour unions be requested to render assistance
to the strikers.

It is learned that the City Government received
instructions from General Chiang Kai-shek on May 25, urging
the authorities to bring about an early settlement of the
dispute existing in the company. The Bureau of Social
Affairs, on the instructions of the City Government, has
arranged to summon the representatives of the strikers to
the Bureau to-day, May 26, for interrogation, and to
conduct mediation on May 29.

浦东英美烟草公司工厂——“新”厂罢工情况

May 25, 1934. Afternoon Translation.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :

B.A.T. WORKERS

The 4,000 workers in the B.A.T. New Factory declared a "go-slow" strike on May 17. As the management of the factory does not intend to reopen the Old Factory, at a meeting held on May 23 it was resolved that the "Committee to Demand the Reopening of the Factory" be reorganized into a "Strike Committee" and that a general strike be declared from yesterday morning.

Fearing that trouble might occur, the Workers Union detailed members of the propaganda and maintenance groups to maintain order outside the factory.

Upon learning that the workers had commenced a general strike, the management closed the factory gates. The workers remained at their homes pending a settlement of the dispute.

At the request of the 5th District Rolled Tobacco Workers Union, yesterday morning over 300 Chinese staff members of various departments in the Factory joined the strike.

In connection with the strike, the local Tangpu has sent a telegram to the Central Kuomintang Headquarters and discussed with the City Government. Yesterday the local Tangpu sent a member to Pootung to prevent reactionary elements from taking advantage of the strike to create disturbances.

Yesterday the 5th District Rolled Tobacco Workers Union sent copies of a letter to the China Seamen's Special Tangpu, the Shanghai-Nanking & Shanghai-Hangchow-Ningpo Railway Special Tangpu, the Seamen's Union, etc. requesting them to instruct their members not to smoke cigarettes manufactured by the B.A.T. Factories until the dispute has been settled.

Commencing from May 28 the "B.A.T. Factory Strike Committee" has decided to give receptions to the Pootung Fellow Provincials Association, the Rolled Tobacco Merchants Association, the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, the Chinese Ratepayers Association and the Chinese Councillors of the S.M.C.

China Times and other local newspapers:

A REFORMED COMMUNIST

An announcement is published by a Communist named Lu Yi Ya (盧綺霞), severing his connection with the Communist Party.

Lu Yi Ya is a native of Kwangtung. He graduated in 1929 from the Waseda University in Japan, and through the introduction of one named Hwa Ti (華蒂) became a member of the Communist Party in February 1933. In July of the same year, he was appointed a member of the Publication Committee of the Communist Party.

英美烟草公司工人

英美烟草公司新厂的4000名工人于5月17日宣布“怠工”罢工。由于厂方无意重新开放老厂，在5月23日举行的会议上，决议将“要求复工委员会”改组为“罢工委员会”，并从昨日上午起宣布总罢工。

因担心发生骚乱，工会指派宣传和维持组成员在厂外维持秩序。

昨日，第五区卷烟业工会向中国海员特别党部、京沪与沪杭甬铁路特别党部、海员工会等发送信函副本，要求其指示成员在纠纷解决之前不要吸食英美烟草公司工厂生产的香烟。

卢绮霞是广东人。他于1929年毕业于日本早稻田大学，并经名为华蒂（音译）的人介绍，于1933年2月成为共产党党员。同年7月，他被任命为共产党出版委员会委员。

May 24, 1934. Afternoon Translation.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :

B.A.T. WORKERS

At 5 p.m. yesterday the 5th District Rolled Tobacco Workers Union called some 100 representatives of the workers in the B.A.T. Old and New Factories to a meeting. Zung Pei Tuh (陈培德) presided and made a report on the appeal to the local Tangpu and other political organs. The following resolutions were passed :-
1) That the "Factory Reopening Movement Committee" be called the "Strike Committee."
2) That the "Strike Committee" be registered at the superior organs.
3) That all the workers of the New Factory be notified to declare a strike from May 24.
4) That a manifesto addressed to various public bodies be issued.
5) That the rules governing the strike be approved.
6) That persons be elected to serve on the "Strike Committee."
7) That a "Strike Maintenance Corps" be formed.
The "Strike Committee" last night issued two notices to the workers, one instructing the workers of the New Factory to declare a strike this morning in support of the workers in the Old Factory and the other warning the strikers that the following persons will be punished:-
1) Persons who violate the instructions of the "Strike Committee."
2) Persons who disobey the advice of the members of the "Strike Committee."
3) Persons who surreptitiously enter the factory for work.
4) Persons who stay in the factory and conspire to create disturbances.
5) Persons who damage the property of the factory.
6) Persons who assault foreign members of the staff.
7) Persons who spread rumours and incite the strikers to create disorder.
8) Persons who do not keep good order.
9) Persons who privately convene meetings and hinder the work of the "Strike Committee."
10) No workers of other factories are allowed to work at the factory.
In a reply to the 5th Rolled Tobacco Workers Union, the China Branch of the International Labour Bureau stated that a report bearing on the dispute has already been forwarded to the Bureau by the Branch.
The "Strike Committee" yesterday issued a manifesto to various public bodies stating that the management of the factory should bear the responsibility of the dispute and that the activities of the Committee would be continued until the Old Factory is reopened.

英美烟草公司工人

昨日下午5时，第五区卷烟业工会召集英美烟草公司老厂和新厂工人代表约100人开会。张培德（陈培德）主持并报告了向当地党部及其他政治机关呼吁的情况。通过以下决议：
1) 将“工厂复工运动委员会”更名为“罢工委员会”。
2) 向上级机关登记“罢工委员会”。
3) 通知新厂所有工人从5月24日起宣布罢工。
4) 发布致各公共团体的宣言。
5) 批准罢工规章。
6) 选举人员担任“罢工委员会”委员。
7) 组建“罢工维持队”。
“罢工委员会”昨晚向工人发布了两份通告，一份指示新厂工人于今晨宣布罢工以支持老厂工人，另一份警告罢工者，以下人员将受到惩罚：
1) 违反“罢工委员会”指示者。
2) 不服从“罢工委员会”成员劝告者。
3) 偷偷进厂工作者。
4) 留在厂内阴谋制造骚乱者。
5) 损坏工厂财产者。
6) 袭击外籍职员者。
7) 散布谣言并煽动罢工者制造混乱者。
8) 不维持良好秩序者。
9) 私自召开会议并阻碍“罢工委员会”工作者。
10) 不允许其他工厂的工人来本厂工作。
国际劳工局中国分局在回复第五区卷烟业工会时表示，有关此纠纷的报告已由该分局报送至总局。
“罢工委员会”昨日向各公共团体发表宣言，称厂方应对纠纷负责，并表示在老厂重新开放之前，委员会的活动将持续进行。

Labour (3)

B.C.C. Factories in Pootung - Strike in "New" Factory

The "tai-kung" strike declared by the workers in
the B.C.C. "New" Factory on May 21 in support of the
ex-workers of the No.1 Factory culminated in a strike
this morning, May 24.

Some 70 delegates of the workers held a meeting
in the 5th District Cigarette Workers' Union, 78 Lan Nyi
Doo Road, Pootung, between 5 p.m. and 6 p.m. May 23 when
it was decided that the "Committee to Demand the Resumption
of Operation of the Factory" be reorganized into a "Strike
Committee" and that propaganda groups be detailed to
prevent the operatives from entering the factory during
the strike. Consequently four propaganda groups of six
members each appeared outside the "New" factory this morning.

Copies of two notices purporting to emanate from
the Strike Committee have been posted outside the B.C.C.
factories in Pootung. The first notice informs the
workers of the commencement of the strike on May 24 and
urges them to refrain from acting in violation of the
decision of the Committee pending a settlement. The second
one contains ten points as strike discipline for
information of the workers. Any operatives who are found
guilty of breaking these rules will be severely dealt with.
1. Disobeying the instructions of the Strike Committee.
2. Disobeying the advice of the Committee.
3. Working in secret in the factory.
4. Staying in the factory and planning to break the strike.

约70名工人代表于5月23日下午5时至6时，在浦东兰尼杜路78号第五区卷烟业工会举行会议，决定将“要求复工委员会”改组为“罢工委员会”，并指派宣传小组防止工人在罢工期间进入工厂。因此，今晨有四个各由六人组成的宣传小组出现在“新”厂外。

据称发自罢工委员会的两份通告副本已张贴在浦东英美烟公司工厂外。第一份通告告知工人罢工于5月24日开始，并敦促他们在问题解决之前不要采取违反委员会决定的行动。第二份通告列出了十条罢工纪律供工人知晓。任何被发现违反这些规则的工人将受到严厉处置。

2. 不服从委员会的建议。
3. 在厂内秘密工作。

GENERAL "TAI-KUNG" STRIKE AT THE B.A.T. NEW FACTORY

May 23, 1934. Afternoon Translation.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers :

B.A.T. WORKERS

With reference to the dispute over the suspension of operations of the B.A.T. Old Factory, at 9 a.m. yesterday the 5th District Rolled Tobacco Workers Union sent 39 representatives to submit petitions to the local Tangpu and other political organs. The callers were received by Mr. O.K. Yue, Chief Secretary of the Shanghai City Government, Secretary Li of the Bureau of Social Affairs and Woo Lai Sien, a member of the Executive Committee of the local Tangpu, who promised to mediate in the dispute and advised the workers to keep good order.

With a view to demanding the reopening of the Old Factory, a meeting of workers representatives was held the other day at which it was resolved that, should no satisfactory reply be secured from the management before Thursday, a "Strike Committee" be formed.

The 5th District Rolled Tobacco Workers Union has decided to convene a meeting of workers representatives at 5 p.m. today at its premises at Lai Nee Doo, Pootung, to discuss the organization of a "Strike Committee."

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :

EXPLANATION REGARDING JAPANESE NEGOTIATIONS

Dong Yu Jen, Vice-Minister of Foreign Affairs, is now in Shanghai.

Approached by reporters of the Sing Sing News Agency, the Minister stated that China would not open direct negotiations with Japan about the North Eastern question. As to other questions, either direct or indirect negotiations will never be countenanced. Wong Yi Fong proceeded to Japan of his own accord. The Government did not instruct him to perform any mission.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers (Tientsin Telegram) :

ATTEMPT TO SNATCH PISTOL FROM A CHINESE POLICEMAN

At 11 p.m. May 21, a Chinese policeman of the Tientsin French Concession was approached by three gangsters from the Japanese Concession. These three men looked like the people of a certain country, and attempted to seize the pistol of the policeman. The latter pulled out his pistol and fired at them. The three gangsters then drew their pistols and fled after firing several shots.

英美烟公司工人

关于英美烟公司旧厂停工引发的纠纷，第五区卷烟业工会于昨日上午9时派出39名代表向当地党部及其他政治机构提交请愿书。来访者受到上海市政府秘书长岳开先（O.K. Yue）先生、社会局李秘书以及当地党部执行委员吴来仙（Woo Lai Sien）（音译）的接见，他们承诺调解此纠纷，并建议工人保持良好秩序。

第五区卷烟业工会已决定于今日下午5时在其位于浦东莱尼杜（Lai Nee Doo）（音译）的会所召开工人代表会议，讨论组织“罢工委员会”事宜。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

关于对日谈判的说明

外交部次长董愈仁（Dong Yu Jen）（音译）目前在上海。

在接受星星新闻社记者采访时，该部长表示，中国不会就东北问题与日本开启直接谈判。至于其他问题，无论是直接还是间接谈判，均不予容忍。黄郛（Wong Yi Fong）是自行前往日本的。政府并未指示他执行任何任务。

《申报》及其他本地报纸（天津电报）：

企图抢夺中国警察手枪

5月21日晚11时，天津法租界的一名中国警察遭到三名来自日租界的流氓接近。这三名男子看似某国人士，试图夺取该警察的手枪。后者拔出手枪向他们射击。这三名流氓随后拔出手枪，在开了几枪后逃窜。

B.C.C. Factories in Pootung - "Tai-kung" strike

The 5th District Cigarette Factory Workers' Union
submitted on May 19 a petition to the local Kuomintang
Headquarters requesting it to instruct transportation
and shipping concerns, seamen's unions and wharf coolies
to refrain from transporting cigarettes manufactured by
the B.C.C. pending a settlement of the existing dispute
in the No.1 Factory of the concern. The petition also
asks the Tangpu in other localities to cooperate in
enforcing the above measure.

The 4,700 operatives in the B.C.C. "New" Factory,
Pootung declared a "tai-kung" strike on May 21, in support
of the ex-workers of the No.1 Factory, which continues
this morning.

Thirty-five members of the 5th District Cigarette
Workers' Union held a meeting in their office at 78 Lan
Nyi Doo Road, Pootung, between 5 p.m. and 6 p.m. May 21
when it was decided that twelve of the attendance be
detailed to appeal for assistance to the Chinese Authorities
on May 22.

Coloured handbills bearing the following slogans
purporting to emanate from the 5th District Cigarette
Workers' Union were found posted outside the B.C.C.
factories in Pootung on May 20 :-

1. Not to become reconciled and not to yield are the
principles of the whole body of workers.

2. To demand the resumption of operation of the factory
is our legal activity.

B.C.C. Factories in Footung - "tai-kung" strike
of "New" Factory Workers

As a result of intimidation by ex-workers of the
B.C.C. No.1 Factory, 600 employees and workers in the
Printing and Designing Room, the Tin Foil Room and the
godowns of the B.C.C. "New" Factory in Footung declared
a "tai-kung" strike at 7.30 a.m. May 18 which continues
this morning, May 19.

In the morning of May 18, the 5th District Cigarette
Workers' Union, 78 Len Nyi Doo Road, Footung, posted copies
of a notice outside the B.C.C. factories in Footung. It
states that in compliance with the decision reached at the
representative meeting held on May 17, all the staff
employees and workers should declare a "tai-kung" strike.
The workers of the No.1 Factory should not accept their
wages from the Management without the consent of the Union.

The "Committee to Demand the Resumption of Operation
of the Factory" was formally inaugurated in the afternoon of
May 18 in the office of the 5th District Cigarette Workers'
Union with 39 persons including Chan Pei-tch, Chairman of
the Union, as committee members. The Committee has
decided that should the Management fail to settle the
present dispute before May 24, all the workers be notified
to declare a strike, and that the body be reorganized as
a "Strike Committee".

At 3 p.m. the same day, a delegate of the local
Kuomintang visited the B.C.C. factories in Footung for
the purpose of investigating the dispute.
pages.zh:
5月19日，4时。

劳工（2）

浦东英美烟公司各厂——“新”厂工人“怠工”罢工

由于受到英美烟公司第一工厂前工人的恐吓，位于浦东的英美烟公司“新”厂印刷设计部、锡箔部及仓库的600名职员和工人于5月18日上午7时30分宣布实行“怠工”罢工，该罢工持续至今晨（5月19日）。

5月18日上午，位于浦东林尼杜路78号的第五区卷烟业工会在浦东英美烟公司各厂门外张贴了通知副本。通知称，根据5月17日举行的代表会议所达成的决定，全体职员和工人应宣布实行“怠工”罢工。第一工厂的工人在未经工会同意的情况下，不得从管理层领取工资。

5月18日下午，“要求复工委员会”在第五区卷烟业工会办公室正式成立，委员会成员包括工会主席陈培之（Chan Pei-tch，音译）等39人。委员会决定，如果管理层在5月24日前未能解决当前纠纷，将通知所有工人宣布罢工，并将该机构改组为“罢工委员会”。

同日下午3时，当地国民党代表前往浦东英美烟公司各厂，旨在调查此次纠纷。

pages.en:
May 19, 1934.
Morning Translation.

Ta Mei Wan Pao dated May 18:

"TAI-KUNG" STRIKE AT THE B.A.T. NEW FACTORY.

The British-American Tobacco Old Factory at
Pootung has been closed down for five days. At a meeting
held at 5 p.m. yesterday by the 5th District Rolled Tobacco
Trade Workers Union, several hundred persons were present,
including representatives of the workers, the local Tangpu
and the Social Bureau.
The following resolutions were passed:-
1. That a warning be issued to the Board of Directors
of the B.A.T. Company.
2. That a "Factory Re-opening Demand Movement Committee"
be formed.
3. That a petition be submitted to the Central Tangpu,
the Chinese National Government, the local Tangpu and the
Shanghai City Government.
4. That the workers of the B.A.T. New Factory declare
a "tai-kung" strike.
5. That a telegram be despatched to the B.A.T. workers
throughout the country asking for assistance.
About 5,000 workers of the New Factory went on a
"tai-kung" strike this morning. No untoward incident
occurred. Order at the Factory was maintained by officers
of the 3rd Division Police of the Public Safety Bureau and
the Police Squadron at Pootung.
After the declaration of the "tai-kung" strike, it
was resolved that should the management still maintain its
stubborn attitude, a strike would be commenced from Sunday
next.
At 10 a.m. to-day, officials of the Social Bureau
and the local Tangpu made an inspection at both the new and
old factories of the B.A.T. Co. Besides submitting a report
to the Shanghai City Government, measures will be devised to
settle the dispute.
It is reported that the B.A.T. Co. held a meeting
at 11 a.m. to-day at which measures to be adopted were
discussed.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

PANCHEN LAMA COMING TO SHANGHAI.

Panchen Lama will leave Hangchow on May 20. He has
despatched a telegraphic reply to Mayor Wu Te-chen accepting
the invitation to come to Shanghai.
The Shanghai City Government at first planned to
entertain Panchen Lama at the Hardoon Residence in the
International Settlement, but owing to the fact that he is
not willing to sojourn in the Settlement, the Government
Authorities are trying to secure a suitable residence in
Chinese controlled territory to house Panchen Lama when he
arrives at Shanghai.
Another report shows that Panchen Lama will probably
leave Hangchow to-day. While in Shanghai he will reside
in the house of Choh Yuan (觉园), Avenue Road. A
welcome will be extended by the Buddhist Society.
pages.zh:
1934年5月19日。
晨间译文。

5月18日《大美晚报》：

英美烟公司新厂发生“怠工”罢工。

浦东英美烟公司老厂已关闭五天。昨日（17日）下午5时，第五区卷烟草业工人工会举行会议，数百人出席，其中包括工人代表、当地党部和社会局代表。
会议通过以下决议：
1. 向英美烟公司董事会发出警告。
2. 成立“要求复工运动委员会”。
3. 向中央党部、中国政府、当地党部及上海市政府提交请愿书。
4. 英美烟公司新厂工人宣布实行“怠工”罢工。
5. 致电全国各地的英美烟公司工人请求援助。
今晨，新厂约5000名工人实行“怠工”罢工。未发生不幸事件。公安局第三分局警官及浦东警察队维持了工厂秩序。
宣布“怠工”罢工后，会议决定，如果资方仍坚持其顽固态度，则将于下周日开始罢工。
今日上午10时，社会局官员和当地党部人员视察了英美烟公司的新厂和老厂。除向上海市政府提交报告外，还将制定措施以解决纠纷。
据悉，英美烟公司于今日上午11时举行会议，讨论拟采取的措施。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

班禅喇嘛即将抵沪。

班禅喇嘛将于5月20日离开杭州。他已发电报回复吴铁城市长，接受邀请前来上海。
上海市政府原计划在国际公共租界的哈同花园招待班禅喇嘛，但鉴于他不愿在租界逗留，政府当局正试图在华界争取一处合适的住所，以便班禅喇嘛抵达上海时居住。
另有消息称，班禅喇嘛可能于今日离开杭州。他在上海期间将居住在觉园（Choh Yuan），位于爱文义路（Avenue Road）。佛教会将举行欢迎仪式。

pages.en:
August 9, 1937.

Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company (British) - Unrest among workers

The workers of the Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company -
Thorburn Road Factory - requested the management to allow
the workers to draw on their provident fund in order that
they proceed to their native places. Two brass smiths
No. P.D.198 and 284 were delegated to interview the
management, but the proposal was turned down. This unrest
is believed to be caused by the present unsettled conditions
locally. As a concession the management have promised
the workers that they will distribute the wages due on
August 9 instead of August 15.

It is the intention of the management to increase
the daily working period by one hour with effect from
August 9 and opposition to this has been voiced by the
workers because of the hot weather.

The factory employs approximately 2,700 workers.

A similar demand was put forward by the 4,000 workers
of the Pootung Factory of the Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company,
and the management has decided to follow the example of the
Thorburn Road Factory and pay the workers wages on Aug. 9.
pages.zh:
1937年8月9日。

怡中烟草公司（英商）——工人骚动

怡中烟草公司韬朋路工厂的工人要求管理层允许工人提取公积金，以便他们返回原籍。两名铜匠（编号P.D.198和284）被委派去与管理层面谈，但该提议被拒绝。据信，此次骚动是由当地目前的不安定局势引起的。作为让步，管理层已向工人承诺，将于8月9日而非8月15日发放到期工资。

管理层打算从8月9日起将每日工作时间增加一小时，工人们因天气炎热对此表示反对。

该工厂雇佣工人约2700名。

怡中烟草公司浦东工厂的4000名工人也提出了类似要求，管理层已决定效仿韬朋路工厂的做法，于8月9日向工人发放工资。

4th District Cigarette Factory Workers' Union
- Annual Meeting

One hundred and forth members of the Shanghai

August 30, 1936.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. E. REGISTRY.
No. D 5894
Date 30 / 8 / 36.
Morning Translation.

Ta Kung Pao and other local newspapers:

THE STRIKE IN THE B.A.T. NO. 3 FACTORY

In connection with the "go-slow" strike of workers
of the British-American Tobacco No.3 Factory on Thorburn Road,
the management yesterday morning posted up at the entrance
to the factory a notice in Chinese and English, stating that
further negotiations over their demands would be considered
if the strikers resumed work immediately. The notice
orders all strikers to call at the factory on August 31 to
receive their pay and that no pay will be given for the period
of the strike.
The strikers became anxious when they heard
that the management was going to take on new hands. At
4 p.m. yesterday about 60 representatives of the workers of the
various departments held a meeting at which the following
eight demands to be submitted to the management were drawn
up and passed:-
1) That a worker's application for leave of absence be not
referred to Wei Ts Zi (魏子潜), the Chinese manager of
the factory; that such applications be dealt with by the
departments concerned.
2) That no entry be made in the books when a worker suspends
work for three days only.
3) That the book in which the demerits of workers are entered
be destroyed after it has been in use for one year.
4) That no dismissal of workers be made in connection with the
"go-slow" strike.
5) That the increase of pay of a worker be not held back
because of some trivial fault committed by the worker.
6) That the workers be given a chance to explain when they
are dismissed or marked with a demerit.
7) That workers be not transferred without reason.
8) That the wages of workers for the period of the "go-slow"
strike be paid.

Ta Kung Pao and other local newspapers:

TROUBLE AT THREE SILK WEAVING FACTORIES SETTLED

In connection with the labour dispute in the
Han Foong (恒丰), the Yeu Foong (友丰) and the Dah Hsin
(大新) Silk Weaving Factories, the Bureau of Social Affairs
held a mediation meeting at 9 a.m. yesterday when the
following measures to bring about a settlement of the dispute
were drawn up and agreed to:-
1) That the discharged hands be reinstated.
2) That the scale of payment for every metre of woven silk
be increased by $0.006.
3) That 10 rolls of silk woven be reckoned as 43 yards of
silk.
4) That no workers be dismissed without cause.

In connection with the strike of workers of the
Mayar No.2 Silk Mill, Chapei, an official of the Bureau of
Social Affairs accompanied by a representative of the local
Tangpu called at the Mill to mediate yesterday morning.
On the advice of the officials, the strikers will
resume work first and await a settlement of the dispute
by the authorities.

《大公报》及其他本地报纸：

英美烟公司第三工厂罢工

针对韬朋路英美烟公司第三工厂工人的“怠工”罢工，管理层于昨日上午在工厂入口处张贴了中英文告示，声明如果罢工者立即复工，将考虑就其诉求进行进一步谈判。告示命令所有罢工者于8月31日到工厂领取薪水，并声明罢工期间不予发薪。
当罢工者听说管理层打算招募新员工时，变得焦虑起来。昨日下午4时，各部门约60名工人代表举行会议，拟定并通过了将向管理层提交的以下八项要求：
1) 工人请假申请不再交由工厂华经理魏子潜（Wei Ts Zi）处理；此类申请由相关部门处理。
2) 工人仅停工三天者，不在记录簿上登记。
3) 记录工人过失的簿册在使用一年后予以销毁。
4) 不因“怠工”罢工而解雇工人。
5) 不因工人犯有轻微过错而扣留其加薪。
6) 工人在被解雇或被记过时，应给予解释机会。
7) 不得无故调动工人。
8) 支付工人“怠工”罢工期间的工资。

《大公报》及其他本地报纸：

三家丝织厂纠纷已解决

针对恒丰（Han Foong）、友丰（Yeu Foong）和大新（Dah Hsin）丝织厂的劳资纠纷，社会局于昨日上午9时举行调解会议，拟定并同意了以下解决纠纷的措施：
1) 复职被解雇的工人。
2) 每米织绸的工资标准增加0.006元。
3) 10卷织绸折算为43码丝绸。
4) 不得无故解雇工人。

针对闸北美亚第二丝厂工人的罢工，社会局一名官员在当地党部代表的陪同下，于昨日上午前往该厂进行调解。
在官员的建议下，罢工者将先复工，等待当局解决纠纷。

September 10, 1936.    Afternoon Translation.
（印：SECRETARY GENERAL'S OFFICE 165/0759 (CRIME COUNCIL)）

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers :-

STRIKE OF THE B.A.T. NO. 3 FACTORY

On the advice of the General Labour Union,
the strikers of the British-American Tobacco No. 3 Factory
resumed work at 5.30 a.m. yesterday.
Direct negotiations over the eight demands
submitted by the workers were opened at 3 p.m. yesterday
by the representatives of workers with Westbrook, the
British manager of the factory. The workers made concessions
regarding their demand concerning Wei Ts Zi (魏子潛), while
the management agreed to allow the dismissed female worker
to resume work. As for the question of procedure when
applying for leave of absence and the demand for payment of
wages during the period of the strike, the management promised
to discuss them later.

A Correction

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers
publish the following letter from the Bureau of Social Affairs:-
Certain parts of the report published by
your paper on September 9 regarding the strikers of the
B.A.T. No. 3 Factory are not correct.
Chow Hsueh Siang, representative of the
General Labour Union, called at the Shanghai City Government
on September 8 and O. K. Yue, Chief Secretary of the
City Government, gave him certain verbal instructions. This
is the reason why the strikers will resume work, but your
paper failed to mention it.
The report that the Tangpu and other political
organs would hold a second mediation meeting at 9 a.m.
September 9 is groundless. The Commissioner of the Bureau
had instructed Chow Hsueh Siang to call at the Bureau on the
morning of September 9 in order to advise him to persuade the
strikers to resume work first pending a settlement. The
Bureau did not hold a second mediation meeting on September 9.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

LOCAL AUTHORITIES AND LABOUR DISPUTES

With a view to bringing about mutual
understanding between employers and employees, the Bureau of
Social Affairs, in co-operation with the local Tangpu and
the Bureau of Public Safety, will call an informal meeting
of owners of silk filatures, cotton mills, rolled tobacco
factories and other concerns at its auditorium in the Civic
Centre at 2 p.m. September 11 when measures to improve mutual
understanding between employers and employees and to reduce
labour troubles will be discussed.
The General Labour Union will convene also
an informal meeting of members of the Executive and Supervisory
Committees of various labour unions at its premises in Mei Ka
Loong, Small South Gate, Nantao, at 2 p.m. to-day, to discuss
ways and means to suppress labour troubles and to bring about
cooperation between employers and employees.

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

英美烟公司第三工厂罢工

在总工会的建议下，英美烟公司第三工厂的罢工者于昨日上午5时30分复工。
昨日下午3时，工人代表与工厂英籍经理韦斯特布鲁克（Westbrook）就工人提出的八项要求开始了直接谈判。工人在关于魏子潜（Wei Ts Zi）的要求上作出了让步，而管理层同意让被解雇的女工复职。至于请假程序以及支付罢工期间工资的要求，管理层承诺稍后讨论。

更正

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸刊登了社会局的如下信函：
贵报9月9日发表的关于英美烟公司第三工厂罢工者的报道中，某些部分不正确。
总工会代表周学湘于9月8日拜访上海市政府，市政府秘书长岳开先（O. K. Yue，音译）向他作了口头指示。这就是罢工者将复工的原因，但贵报未提及此事。
关于党部及其他政治机构将于9月9日上午9时举行第二次调解会议的说法毫无根据。社会局局长已指示周学湘于9月9日上午前往该局，以便建议他劝说罢工者先复工，以待解决。社会局并未于9月9日举行第二次调解会议。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

地方当局与劳资纠纷

为了促进雇主与雇员之间的相互理解，社会局将与当地党部和公安局合作，于9月11日下午2时在大上海市中心的社会局礼堂召开缫丝厂、棉纺厂、卷烟厂及其他企业业主的非正式会议，讨论改善雇主与雇员之间相互理解以及减少劳资纠纷的措施。
总工会也将于今日下午2时在其位于南市小南门梅家弄（Mei Ka Loong，音译）的办公地点，召开各工会执行委员会和监察委员会成员的非正式会议，讨论压制劳资纠纷以及促进雇主与雇员合作的方法手段。

August 29, 1936.

-2-

Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company - strike situation in
the Thorburn Road Factory

The strike situation in the Thorburn Road Factory
of the Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company remains unchanged
except that thirty mechanics and coolies reported for
work this morning, August 29.

A notice was posted by the Management this morning
outside the gate of the factory, Ward Road. The translation
reads as follows :-

"The workers have been on strike since August 18
"in order to enforce a demand for the reinstatement of
"a female dismissed from the Packing Department. This
"demand has now been accepted by the management, so
"there is no reason for the workers to continue on strike.
"In connection with the demand of the workers that
"applications for leave of absence should be referred
"to the foreign overseers instead of the Chinese Factory
"Superintendent, the management has already promised to
"consider this demand. It is understood that the majority
"of the workers are willing to resume operations, but are
"unable to return to work owing to the activities of
"agitators. The factory is open every day, and the
"workers may return to their respective departments.
"The wages due to the workers will be issued on August 31,
"and you are expected to resume operations on that date.
"If you ignore this advice, the management will devise
"new measures to cope with the situation."

1936年8月29日。

-2-

颐中烟草公司——韬朋路工厂罢工情况

颐中烟草公司韬朋路工厂的罢工情况除今晨（8月29日）有三十名机修工和苦力报到上班外，其余均无变化。

资方今晨在华德路工厂大门外张贴了一则告示。译文如下：

“工人们自8月18日起罢工，
“以强制要求复职一名被包装部解雇的女工。
“此项要求现已为资方所接受，故
“工人继续罢工已无理由。
“关于工人提出请假申请应提交给外籍监工
“而非华籍工厂主管的要求，资方已承诺
“考虑此项要求。据悉，大多数
“工人愿意复工，但由于
“煽动者的活动而无法返岗。工厂每日开放，
“工人可返回各自部门。
“应付工人的工资将于8月31日发放，
“望你们于该日恢复工作。
“若无视此劝告，资方将制定
“新措施以应对局势。”

September 2, 1936.    Morning Transla... (印：CRIME BRANCH)

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

THE STRIKE OF B.A.T. WORKERS

In connection with the labour trouble in the British-American Tobacco No. 3 Factory on Thorburn Road, five representatives of the strikers made appeals to the local Tangpu, the Bureau of Social Affairs and the General Labour Union at 10 a.m. yesterday. The callers were told that the authorities would mediate to bring about an early settlement of the dispute.
At 3 p.m. yesterday an official of the Mediation Section of the Bureau called at the factory to make an investigation into the strike, but the management refused to admit him into the factory.
The local Tangpu and other government organs will notify both the management and the strikers to attend an interrogation which will take place in a few days. After the interrogation, a Mediation Committee will be formed to settle the dispute.

Ta Kung Pao and other local newspapers:

THE AFFAIRS OF THE RICSHA PULLERS' MUTUAL AID ASSOCIATION

Recently Mr. Massey, Chairman of the Board of Management of the Ricsha Pullers' Mutual Aid Association, referred the third year's budget to the Board of Trustees for consideration without first securing the approval of the Board of Management.
As this procedure is irregular, the Board held a meeting on August 28 at which protests were made by a majority of the members. However, as Mr. Massey was stubborn and stood by his action, the meeting had no result.
It is said that the members of the Board of Management have devised effective ways and means to deal with the matter. Yesterday the Special District Office of the Ricsha Owners' Association sent letters to the Chinese members of the S.M.C. suggesting that the Council re-organize the Mutual Aid Association.

Ta Kung Pao and other local newspapers:

NEW CHIEF OF DETECTIVE CORPS OF PUBLIC SAFETY BUREAU

Owing to sickness, Chang Dah Dong (張大同), Chief of the Detective Corps of the Public Safety Bureau, recently submitted his resignation.
General Tsai Ching Chun, Commissioner of the Public Safety Bureau, has accepted the resignation and has appointed Lieu Haei (刘槐), Chief of the Special Section, to succeed him.
Lieu Huei will assume his new post at 9 a.m. to-day.

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

英美烟草公司工人罢工

就韬朋路英美烟草第三厂的劳资纠纷一事，五名罢工代表于昨日上午10时向当地塘沽办事处、社会局及总工会提出申诉。接待人员告知，当局将进行调解，以促成纠纷早日解决。
昨日下午3时，社会局调解科的一名官员前往工厂调查罢工情况，但资方拒绝其进入工厂。
当地塘沽办事处及其他政府机关将通知资方和罢工者在数日后参加讯问。讯问结束后，将成立调解委员会以解决纠纷。

《大公报》及其他本地报纸：

人力车夫互助会事宜

近日，人力车夫互助会管理委员会主席马西先生（Mr. Massey）在未先取得管理委员会批准的情况下，将第三年度预算提交董事会审议。
由于此程序不合常规，董事会于8月28日召开会议，多数成员对此提出抗议。然而，由于马西先生态度固执，坚持其行为，会议未获结果。
据悉，管理委员会成员已想出有效办法处理此事。昨日，车主协会特区办事处致函工部局华董，建议公董局重组互助会。

《大公报》及其他本地报纸：

公安局侦探总队新任总队长

因患病，公安局侦探总队总队长张大同近期提交辞呈。
公安局局长蔡劲军将军已接受辞呈，并任命特务处处长刘槐继任。
刘槐将于今日上午9时就任新职。

August 29, 1936.    Morning

Ta Kung Pao and other local newspapers:

THE STRIKE OF B.A.T. WORKERS

In connection with the "go-slow" strike of workers
of the British-American Tobacco No.3 Factory on Thorburn Road,
enquiries made by our reporter yesterday revealed that only
30 hands of the Brass-smiths Department are at work. The
strike is due to the following grounds:-
1) The management had failed to accept a demand that the loss
incurred by the workers during the period of the strike
be made good by the management.
2) The management had ignored the demand for the dismissal
of Wei Ts Zi (魏子潛), the Chinese manager of the factory.
Fearing that the strike may affect the workers of
the British-American Tobacco New Factory at Pootung, the
management has requested the Bureau of Public Safety to detail
30 policemen for duty inside the Pootung factory.
The local Tangpu and other government organs
yesterday despatched officials to make an investigation. They
will mediate in order to prevent the trouble from spreading.

Ta Kung Pao and other local newspapers:

THE STRIKE OF MAYAR SILK MILL WORKERS

In connection with the strike of workers of the
Mayar No.2 Silk Mill, Chiaotung Road, Chapei, direct
negotiations have been started between the labour contractors
and the strikers. The hands are insisting on their
demand for the abolition of the grading system and for better
treatment, while the labour contractors are opposing the
demand because it would cause them to incur a heavy loss.
The Bureau of Social Affairs will hold a mediation
meeting at 9 a.m. to-day.

Trouble in Five Other Silk Weaving Factories Settled

On the advice of the Bureau of Social Affairs,
the workers of the Pao Hwa (寶華 ), the Yu Chung (裕村 )
and three other silk weaving factories on Brenan Road,
Western District, will resume operations this morning.

Ta Kung Pao and other local newspapers:

THE BOY SERVANTS OF THE CUSTOM HOUSE

Recently, the entire body of boy servants at the
Custom House became restless because six of them had been
discharged and replaced by new hands.
The boy servants have appealed to the Customs
authorities not to discharge them, but so far the authorities
have not given them any reply.

《大公报》及其他本地报纸：

英美烟草公司工人罢工

就韬朋路英美烟草第三厂工人的“怠工”罢工一事，本报记者昨日调查发现，仅铜匠部有30名工人在岗。罢工原因如下：
1) 资方未能接受由资方补偿工人在罢工期间所受损失的要求。
2) 资方忽视了解雇该厂华籍经理魏子潜的要求。
因担心罢工可能影响浦东英美烟草新厂的工人，资方已请求公安局派遣30名警员在浦东厂内执勤。
当地塘沽办事处及其他政府机关昨日派员进行调查。他们将进行调解，以防止事态蔓延。

《大公报》及其他本地报纸：

美亚丝绸二厂工人罢工

就闸北胶州路美亚第二丝绸厂工人罢工一事，包工头与罢工者之间已开始直接谈判。工人们坚持要求废除分级制度并改善待遇，而包工头则反对该要求，称这将导致他们遭受重大损失。
社会局将于今日上午9时举行调解会议。

其他五家丝织厂纠纷已解决

在社会局的建议下，西区布伦南路（Brenan Road）的宝华、裕村及其他三家丝织厂的工人将于今晨复工。

《大公报》及其他本地报纸：

海关童仆

近日，海关全体童仆因六人被解雇并由新人取代而变得动荡不安。
童仆们已向海关当局上诉，请求不要解雇他们，但截至目前，当局尚未给予任何答复。

Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company - strike situation in the
Thorburn Road Factory

The strike situation in the Thorburn Road Factory of
the Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company remains unchanged this
morning, September 2.

At 1 p.m. September 1 a Chinese claiming a represent
the strikers submitted a petition for assistance to the
Bureau of Social Affairs. He was promised that an
investigation would be made into the strike.

Thirteen members of the 5th District Cigarette Workers'
Union held a meeting in their office at 78 Lan Kyi Doo,
Pootung, at 5 p.m. September 11, 1936, and discussed the
strike of workers of the Thorburn Road Branch of the Yee
Tsoong Tobacco Factory.

During the meeting, it was suggested that the workers
of the Pootung Factory should follow a policy of non-
interference on the ground that the workers of the Thorburn
Road Factory refused to render assistance when the Pootung
Factory workers were on strike in 1933.

颐中烟草公司——韬朋路工厂罢工情况

今晨（9月2日），颐中烟草公司韬朋路工厂的罢工情况仍无变化。

1936年9月1日下午1时，一名自称代表罢工者的华人向社会局提交了一份求助请愿书。当局承诺将对罢工情况进行调查。

1936年9月11日下午5时，第五区卷烟业工会十三名成员在浦东兰吉杜路78号办公室举行会议，讨论颐中烟草厂韬朋路分厂工人的罢工问题。

会议期间，有人建议浦东工厂的工人应采取不干涉政策，理由是1933年浦东工厂工人罢工时，韬朋路工厂的工人曾拒绝提供援助。

pages.en:
September 8, 1936.

-2-

At 9 a.m. September 7, 1936, the Bureau of Social
Affairs convened a meeting in the Bureau with a view to
settling the strike in t.. Thorburn Road Factory of the
Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company. Four representatives of the
strikers were present, but no discussion took place owing
to the failure of the management of the factory to send
a representative.

At 9.45 a.m. September 7, some fifty clerks and
shroffs called on the management and asked that some minor
concessions be granted to them so that they might resume
work forthwith.

Some thirty workers claiming to represent one third
of the strikers called on the management of the factory
at 9 a.m. September 8, 1936, and expressed willingness
to resume work unconditionally on the morning of September 9
requesting that the siren be sounded as usual and that
protection be afforded to them against intimidation.
Their requests were accepted. Before departing, the
callers stated that owing to the strike the workers would
not receive sufficient money on pay day, September 15, and
suggested that a loan be granted to them. It is reported
that the management promised to consider this request.

Pao Loong Silk Weaving Factory - transient strike

Between 1 p.m. and 3 p.m. September 7, three hundred workers
of the Pao Loong Silk Weaving Factory, 535 Tan Ka Jao, off
Poo Zoen Road, Chapei, went on strike in order to enforce
a demand for an increase in wages. The strikers later
resumed work as a result of the management promising to
grant them an increase of $0.003 per foot of silk woven.
