1936年9月8日。

-2-

1936年9月7日上午9时，社会局在局内召开会议，旨在解决颐中烟草公司韬朋路工厂的罢工问题。四名罢工代表出席，但因工厂资方未派代表出席，故未进行讨论。

1936年9月7日上午9时45分，约五十名职员和出纳员拜访资方，要求给予一些微小的让步，以便他们能立即复工。

1936年9月8日上午9时，约三十名自称代表三分之一罢工者的工人拜访工厂资方，表示愿意于9月9日上午无条件复工，要求照常鸣放汽笛，并为他们提供保护以防恐吓。
他们的要求被接受。离开前，来访者表示，由于罢工，工人们在9月15日发薪日将无法领到足够的钱款，并建议向他们提供贷款。据报道，资方承诺考虑此请求。

宝隆丝织厂——短暂罢工

1936年9月7日下午1时至3时间，位于闸北蒲淞路旁谭家桥535号的宝隆丝织厂三百名工人举行罢工，以强制要求增加工资。后因资方承诺每织一英尺丝绸加薪0.003元，罢工者随后复工。

THE STRIKE OF B.A.T. WORKERS

In connection with the strile of more than
2,600 workers and employees of the British-American Tobacco
Company No. 3 Factory on Thorburn Road, the local Tangpu
and other government organs yesterday morning held a meeting

《大公报》及其他本地报纸：-

英美烟厂工人罢工

就韬朋路英美烟三厂2,600余名工人及职员罢工一事，当地塘浦及其他政府机关于昨日上午在社会局举行会议，制定了防止罢工蔓延的措施。

总工会于昨日下午2时在其办事处举行会议，指派朱學範（Chu Hsueh Fan）、周學湘（Chow Hsueh Siang）及其他7名委员，与当地塘浦及其他政府机关合作进行调解。

pages.en:
September 5, 1936.

Lih Pao and other local newspapers:

THE STRIKE OF B.A.T. WORKERS

According to a departmental chief of the Bureau
of Social Affairs, the following measures have been drawn up
by the Bureau to deal with the strike of workers of the
British-American Tobacco No.3 Factory on Thorburn Road:-
1) That the Mediation Committee hold a meeting at 10 a.m.
September 7 to mediate in accordance with the revised
measures dealing with disputes between employers and
employees.
2) That measures against an extension of the labour trouble
of the British-American Tobacco No.3 Factory be discussed
with the local Tangpu and the Bureau of Public Safety on
the morning of September 5.
3) That if the efforts of the Mediation Committee prove
unsuccessful, a petition be submitted to the Shanghai City
Government requesting it to refer the matter to the
Arbitration Committee.

Yesterday the 2,600 hands of the British-American
Tobacco No.3 Factory appointed representatives to approach
the various local organs, public bodies and labour unions to
ask for relief.

The Silk Weaving Factories in the Western District

The strikers of the Pao Hwa (宝華), the Yih Yeu
(益友), the Yui Chung (裕村), the Tien Zung (天成) and the
Yung Foong (永丰) Silk Weaving Factories in the Western
District, who went on strike recently to support their demand
for an increase of wages, have resumed work on the advice
of officials of the local Tangpu and other government organs.
On September 3, the Bureau of Social Affairs
held a mediation meeting at which an agreement was reached
between the employers and employees of the Yih Yeu and two
other silk weaving factories. The workers of the Pao
Hwa and the Yui Chung Silk Weaving Factories went on a
"go-slow" strike again yesterday. The Bureau will hold
a further mediation meeting on September 7.

The Han Foong Silk Weaving Factory

A further dispute between the management of the
Han Foong (恒丰) Silk Weaving Factory and its workers arose
yesterday because the management had failed to enforce the
system that each roll of silk woven be reckoned as 43 yards
of silk woven. The workers lodged a protest and went on
strike for two hours. Later the strikers resumed work
after the dispute was mediated.

The labour troubles in the Sin Sun (新生) and
other silk weaving factories in Yangtszepoo District will be
settled in a few days.

Strike of Workers of Pao Loong Factory in Chapel

To support their demand for an increase of wages,
the workers of the Pao Loong Factory (宝隆厂 otherwise known
as the Yuan Tung Factory 源通) at Tan Ka Jao, Pu Shou Road,
Chapel, went on strike yesterday.
pages.zh:
1936年9月5日。

《立报》及其他本地报纸：

英美烟厂工人罢工

据社会局一科长称，该局已制定以下措施以应对韬朋路英美烟三厂工人罢工：-
1) 调解委员会将于9月7日上午10时举行会议，依据修订后的劳资纠纷处理办法进行调解。
2) 于9月5日上午与当地塘浦及公安局讨论防止英美烟三厂劳资纠纷扩大的措施。
3) 若调解委员会的努力未果，则向上海市政府提交请愿书，请求将该案移交仲裁委员会。

昨日，英美烟三厂的2,600名工人指派代表接触当地各机关、公共团体及工会，寻求救济。

西区丝织厂

西区宝華（Pao Hwa）、益友（Yih Yeu）、裕村（Yui Chung）、天成（Tien Zung）及永丰（Yung Foong）丝织厂近期为支持增加工资的要求而罢工的工人，在当地塘浦官员及其他政府机关的建议下已复工。9月3日，社会局举行调解会议，益友及另外两家丝织厂的劳资双方达成协议。宝華及裕村丝织厂的工人昨日再次实行“怠工”罢工。社会局将于9月7日举行进一步调解会议。

恒丰丝织厂

恒丰（Han Foong）丝织厂管理层与其工人之间昨日发生新的纠纷，原因是管理层未能执行每卷丝绸按43码计算的规定。工人提出抗议并罢工两小时。后经调解，罢工者恢复工作。

Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company -- strike situation in the
Thorburn Road Factory

Some 2,000 out of 2,700 strikers of the Yee Tsoong
Tobacco Factory, 674 Thorburn Road, proceeded to the
Factory at 7 a.m. to-day, August 31, but did not resume
duty. At 7.30 a.m. these strikers submitted the following
demands to the management :-

1) That workers be permitted to submit leave applications
to the foreign members of the management instead of to
the Chinese Superintendent.

2) That should a worker be absent for three days, no
demerit should be recorded until investigations regarding
the cause of his absence have been made.

3) That a demerit recorded against a worker should be
cancelled provided he does not commit another offence
for one year.

4) That no worker be dismissed for participating in the
strike movement.

5) That no worker be deprived of receiving the increases
due to him for making slight mistakes.

6) That any worker dismissed or otherwise punished be given
an opportunity to submit an explanation or request that
his case be investigated.

7) That no worker be transferred without reason.

8) That full pay should be granted to the workers for the
period of "go-slow" and "walk-out" strikes.

The management has made the following concessions :-

Re Demand No.1 : Workers be permitted to submit their
applications for leave to the foreign overseers, if
these applications have first been rejected by the
Chinese Superintendent.

Re Demand No.2 : Rejected.

Re Demand Nos.3,
4, 5, and 6 : Accepted.

Re Demand Nos.
7 and 8 : Rejected.

Ta Kung Pao and other local newspapers:

THE STRIKE OF B.A.T. WORKERS

In connection with the "go-slow" strike of workers of the British-American Tobacco No.3 Factory on Thorburn Road, the management recently decided to employ new hands. Upon learning of this, the strikers formed a corps to secure information and to keep a watch on the new hands entering the factory.

In a notice issued by the management, the strikers were told to call on August 30 for the pay due to them. None of the strikers have called for their pay. At 10 a.m. to-day the strikers will make appeals to the local Tangpu, the Bureau of Social Affairs and the General Labour Union. They will negotiate directly with "Westbrook", the British General Manager, over the eight demands passed at their meeting the other day.

The strikers resumed work at 6.30 a.m. yesterday.

LABOUR TROUBLE AT THE MAYAR NO.2 SILK MILL SETTLED

To support their demand for the abolition of the grading system and for an increase of wages, the workers of the Mayar No.2 Silk Mill, Chapei, went on strike recently.

On the evening of August 29 negotiations were opened between the labour contractors and the strikers, as a result of which the contractors have agreed to abolish the grading system while the strikers voluntarily abandoned the demand for an increase of wages.

The strikers resumed work on the evening of August 29.

OVER 80 LABOUR UNIONS ENTERTAIN CHINESE LABOUR REPRESENTATIVE

At noon yesterday, more than 80 local labour unions entertained Tsu Hsueh Van ( 朱学范 ), Chinese labour representative to the International Labour Conference at the Da Sie Yang Restaurant ( 大西洋 ). Officials of the local Tangpu and the Social Bureau were present.

Tsu Hsueh Van made a report on labour conditions in Italy and Germany.

September 1, 1936.    Morning Translation.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

THE STRIKE OF B.A.T. WORKERS

The entire body of workers of the British-American Tobacco No.3 Factory on Thorburn Road called at the factory at 8 a.m. yesterday to receive their pay for August. At 2 p.m. the representatives of workers of various departments opened negotiations with "Westbrook", the British manager of the factory, over the eight demands passed at a meeting of workers the other day. As these demands were rejected, the negotiations had no result.

The gate of the factory was closed at 4 p.m. A large number of Chinese and foreign detectives and uniformed men from Yulin Road Police Station have been detailed to maintain peace and order.

In the evening the strikers held a further meeting at which measures to deal with the situation were discussed.

It was originally planned to send representatives of the workers to make appeals to the local Tangpu and other government organs at 2 p.m. August 31, but this was not done because of the direct negotiations with the management. The representatives will make the appeal this morning.

The petition to be submitted to the local Tangpu and the Bureau of Social Affairs reads as follows:-

"Owing to the unreasonable dismissal of a female worker by 'Westbrook', the foreign Manager, on the afternoon of August 18, the workers of the various departments of the British-American Tobacco No.3 Factory requested the Chinese manager Wei Ts Zi (魏子潛) to ask the foreign manager not to discharge her. Instead of granting our request, the Chinese manager used abusive language towards the workers, and this led to a strike.

"The Chinese manager has always been oppressing workers since his appointment; some 400 persons have either been forced to resign or discharged. Four of the workers committed suicide owing to financial difficulties after they were dismissed.

"Later, the workers submitted the following demands:-
1) That the dismissed female worker be reinstated.
2) That all applications for leave of absence on proper grounds be not rejected.
3) That the Chinese manager Wei Ts Zi be dismissed.
4) That in future all matters be dealt with according to the system prevailing prior to the appointment of Wei Ts Zi as Chinese manager.

"The four demands were rejected by the management. Recently, the management announced that it would take on new hands and ordered the strikers to resume work unconditionally.

"We hereby request you to detail officials to mediate so as to put an end to the dispute at an early date."

英美烟厂工人罢工

韬朋路英美烟三厂的全体工人于昨日上午8时到厂领取8月份工资。下午2时，各部门工人代表就日前工人会议通过的八项要求，与该厂英籍经理“韦斯特布鲁克”（Westbrook）进行谈判。由于这些要求被拒绝，谈判没有结果。

工厂大门于下午4时关闭。榆林路警察署派遣了大量中外探员和制服警员维持治安秩序。

晚间，罢工者举行了进一步会议，讨论应对局势的措施。

原计划于8月31日下午2时派工人代表向当地区公所及其他政府机关提出申诉，但因与管理层直接谈判而未实行。代表们将于今天上午提出申诉。

拟提交给当地区公所和社会局的请愿书内容如下：

“由于外籍经理‘韦斯特布鲁克’于8月18日下午无理开除一名女工，英美烟三厂各部门工人请求华籍经理魏子潜 (Wei Ts Zi) 要求外籍经理不要将其解雇。华籍经理不仅未答应我们的请求，反而辱骂工人，从而导致罢工。

“华籍经理自任职以来一直压迫工人；约有400人被迫辞职或被解雇。四名工人被解雇后因经济困难自杀。

“随后，工人提出以下要求：
1) 复职被解雇的女工。
2) 不得拒绝有正当理由的请假申请。
3) 撤换华籍经理魏子潜。
4) 今后所有事务均按魏子潜担任华籍经理之前的现行制度处理。

“这四项要求被资方拒绝。最近，资方宣布将雇用新工人，并命令罢工者无条件复工。

“特此请求贵方派遣官员进行调解，以便早日结束争端。”

Labour

Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company - "tai-kung" strike of workers
of the Thorburn Road Factory

The "tai-kung" strike of the workers of the Thorburn
Road Factory of the Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company continues
this morning, August 20.

On August 19, the workers submitted the following
demands to the management :-

1) That the dismissed female worker be reinstated.
2) That workers who report late for duty are not entered
in the defaulters book.
3) That the workers be permitted to submit leave applications
to the foreign members of the Management instead of
the Chinese Superintendent. (It is known that the
workers submitted this demand with the intention of
urging the management to dismiss the Chinese Superinten-
dent).

With reference to the first demand, the management
promised to suspend the female worker for a period of two
weeks instead of dismissal. Demands 2 and 3 were not
accepted, consequently the workers walked out at 3 p.m.
August 19. The majority of the workers returned to the
factory this morning and are continuing negotiations with
the management.

August 20 resumed the loading and unloading of "Kao-liang"
wine, which was suspended on August 18 as a protest against
the detention of wine by inspectors of the Kiangsu-Chekiang-
Anhwei Consolidated Tax Bureau (vide I.R. 18/8/36).

颐中烟草公司韬朋路工厂工人的“太公”罢工于8月20日今晨继续。

8月19日，工人向管理层提出以下要求：

1) 复职被解雇的女工。
2) 上班迟到的工人不记入缺勤簿。
3) 允许工人向管理层外籍成员而非华籍总监提交请假申请。（据悉，工人提出此要求的目的是敦促管理层撤换华籍总监）。

关于第一项要求，管理层承诺将该女工停职两周而非解雇。第二和第三项要求未被接受，因此工人于8月19日下午3时离厂。大多数工人于今晨返回工厂，并继续与管理层谈判。

THE YEE TSOONG TOBACCO COMPANY
The Thorburn Road Factory of the Yee Tsoong (颐中)
Tobacco Company, a British concern, at No.674 Thorburn Road
(premises of the former B.A.T. 3rd. Factory), employs about

Five committee members of the Federation of Anti-Smuggling Committees of Various Places in China held a meeting in the Chamber of Commerce Building, North Soochow Road, between 3.40 p.m. and 4.14 p.m. August 21 and discussed measures to carry out the anti-smuggling movement. Wong Shiao-lai presided at the function.

Chinese Chamber of Commerce - meeting

Fourteen committee members of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce held a meeting in their office on North Soochow Road, between 4 p.m. and 4.30 p.m. August 21 with Wong Shiao-lai (王曉籟) presiding. During the proceedings, Loh Tsing-hwa (駱清華) was appointed to appeal to the Legislative Yuan and the Ministry of Industry, Nanking, for amendments of the regulations governing Chambers of Commerce and Trade Associations.

Labour

Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company - strike of workers in the Thorburn Road Factory

The situation in the Yee Tsoong Tobacco Factory, 674 Thorburn Road, remains unchanged this morning, August 22.

Ten Chinese claiming to be representatives of the strikers held a meeting in the 4th District Tobacco Workers' Union, Lane 376, No.42 Wayside Road, at 10 a.m. August 21. Hu Meng Ling (胡夢麟), committee member of the Union, informed those present that the management of the Factory had refused to make any concessions other than the following:-

1) That the female worker, Ah-ng be suspended from duty for two weeks.

2) That any worker desiring leave of absence apply to the Chinese factory superintendent, but should he wish to dispute the superintendent's decision, he will be permitted to appeal to a member of the foreign staff.

After some discussion, it was agreed to accept the concessions and advise all workers to resume work on August 24. The majority of the workers appear to be satisfied with the concession.

华人总商会十四名委员于8月21日下午4时至4时30分在北苏州路会所举行会议，由王晓籟（王曉籟）主持。会议期间，任命骆清华（Loh Tsing-hua，駱清華）向南京立法院和实业部呼吁，修改关于商会和同业公会的法规。

颐中烟草公司——韬宾路工厂工人罢工

截至8月22日上午，韬宾路674号颐中烟草工厂的局势保持不变。

十名自称是罢工代表的华人在8月21日上午10时于威赛德路（Wayside Road）42号376弄第四区烟草工会举行会议。工会委员胡梦麟（Hu Meng Ling，胡夢麟）告知与会者，工厂资方拒绝做出除以下条款外的任何让步：-

1) 女工阿英（Ah-ng）停职两周。

2) 任何希望请假的工人应向工厂华籍总监申请，但如果他希望争议总监的决定，允许其向外籍职员中的一员上诉。

经过讨论，各方同意接受上述让步，并建议所有工人于8月24日复工。大多数工人似乎对让步表示满意。

Miscellaneous (5)

Local Tobacco Leaf Dealers' Association - opposition to
the Hsuchang Tobacco Company in Honan

On October 11, the local Tobacco Leaf Dealers'
Association, 7 Yuan Loong Li, New North Gate, wrote
to the Ministry of Industry, the Chinese Chamber of
Commerce and the Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's Association
requesting assistance in suppressing the Hsuchang Tobacco
Company at Hsuchang, Honan, which is attempting to create
a monopoly of the tobacco leaf trade in that Province,
thus affecting the business of other tobacco leaf merchants.
It is alleged that the Hsuchang Company, although ostensibly
a Chinese concern, is capitalized by the Yee Tsong Tobacco
Company.

On October 13, Yu Yah-ching, in the name of the local
Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's Association, addressed a letter
to General Chiang Kai-shek, informing him that certain
Chinese, in collaboration with foreign merchants, and in
the name of the Hsuchang Company, had subscribed heavily
to obtain the monopoly of the tobacco leaf trade in Honan.

Shanghai Silk Weaving Factory - Unrest

Owing to trade depression, the management of the
Shanghai Silk Weaving Factory, Lane 424, No. 19/33 Baikal Road,
recently reduced the wages of the workers by 30% and shortened
the working period by two hours a day. At 10 a.m. July 4,
four workers acting as representatives of their colleagues
requested their foreman to negotiate with the management for
the cancellation of the reductions. As the foreman refused
to comply with their request, he was assaulted by the four
representatives. The foreman and the workers were escorted
to Yulin Road Police Station where they were cautioned and
released.

The four representatives and nine female workers
were later dismissed by the management for conducting
agitation.

颐中（Yee Tsong）烟草公司的韬宾路工厂和浦东（Poolung）工厂自6月3日起，开始每周运营五天，而非之前的六天。这两家工厂共雇佣工人6,700名。

March 28, 1935.
Labour (3)

D5894
Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company - Situation in factories
in Settlement and Footung

With effect from March 25, the workers of the
Thorburn Road Factory of the Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company
commenced operating eleven hours per day, instead of twelve
hours, from Monday to Friday (6 a.m. to 12 noon, and 1 p.m.
to 6 p.m.) and ten hours on Saturday. There are at present
some 2,700 hands in the employ of this plant.

With effect from March 25, workers of the Footung
Factory commenced operating ten hours per day and six days
per week, i.e. 7 a.m. to 12 noon and 1 p.m. to 6 p.m. instead
of twelve hours per day. About 3,250 hands are affected.
Workers of the Printing Department, numbering some 500,
continue to work twelve hours per day (7 a.m. to 12 noon and
1 p.m. to 8 p.m.) while workers of the Tin Foil Department,
numbering some 150, are working nine hours per day and five
days per week.

Sung Teh Lace Weaving Factory - Weaving Department
resumes operation

The Weaving Department of the Sung Teh Lace Weaving
Factory, 471 Ferry Road, which closed in January, 1935,
recently resumed operations. Of the sixty-six male and
thirty female hands formerly in the employ of the Department
of the factory, only thirteen males have been re-engaged.

Endeavours are being made by the remainder to solicit
the assistance of the Bureau of Social Affairs in obtaining
employment. It will be recalled that the male and female
employees were paid gratuities of $51.00 and $7.00
respectively, following the suspension of operations in

D5894
颐中烟草公司——租界内及浦东（Footung）工厂的情况

自3月25日起，颐中烟草公司韬宾路工厂的工人开始实行周一至周五每天工作十一小时（上午6时至中午12时，下午1时至6时），周六工作十小时，取代此前的每天十二小时工作制。目前该厂雇佣工人约2,700名。

自3月25日起，浦东（Footung）工厂的工人开始实行每天工作十小时、每周工作六天的制度，即上午7时至中午12时，下午1时至6时，取代此前的每天十二小时工作制。受影响工人约3,250名。印刷部工人约500名，继续每天工作十二小时（上午7时至中午12时，下午1时至8时），而锡纸部工人约150名，实行每天工作九小时、每周工作五天的制度。

宋德蕾丝织造厂——织造部恢复运营

位于斐伦路（Ferry Road）471号的宋德蕾丝织造厂织造部曾于1935年1月关闭，近期已恢复运营。在该部原先雇佣的66名男工和30名女工中，仅重新雇佣了13名男工。
其余人员正努力寻求社会局的协助以获得就业。回想此前，在停工后，男女雇员分别获得了51.00美元和7.00美元的遣散费。

The representatives of the management, however, turned
down the above demands but stated that the management
would take the average of the wages for May, June and July
as the basis for the retiring gratuity and that the sum
would be $15.00 or thereabouts. This action on the
part of the management dissatisfied the ex-workers, who
adopted a threatening attitude towards the delegates.
Trouble, however, was averted by the arrival of a party
of Chinese Police summoned to the scene by Li Mong Nan
(李夢南).

D5894

5th District Cigarette Factory Workers' Union - re-election
of committees - Chen Bei Tuh loses his seat

Under the auspices of the local Kuomintang, the
annual election of members for the executive and supervisory
committees of the 5th District Cigarette Workers' Union
was held in the Tangpu Headquarters, Fong Ling Chiao, off
Route Ghisi, between 9 a.m. and 11.45 a.m. Dec. 16.
As a result of this election Chen Bei Tuh, who has
controlled this Union since 1927, lost his seat while
only three of his supporters obtained positions on the
committees. Chen's attempt to oust Chu Hsuch Fan from the
General Labour Union is believed to have brought about
his downfall as Chu's influence with the local Tangpu
is very strong.

It will be recalled that a previous re-election of
committees held in the offices of the Union in question
was declared illegal by the Kuomintang (Vide I.R. 3/11/34)
On this occasion Chen and his supporters gained an
overwhelming success.

D5894

第五区卷烟厂工人联合会——委员会改选——陈北土（Chen Bei Tuh，音译）落选

在当地国民党的主持下，第五区卷烟工人联合会执行委员会和监察委员会成员的年度选举于12月16日上午9时至11时45分在极司菲尔路（Route Ghisi）旁丰林桥（Fong Ling Chiao，音译）的汤浦（Tangpu，音译）总部举行。选举结果是，自1927年以来一直控制该联合会的陈北土（Chen Bei Tuh，音译）失去了席位，而其支持者中仅有三人获得了委员会的职位。据信，陈试图将朱学范（Chu Hsuch Fan）从总工会中排挤出去，导致了其垮台，因为朱在当地汤浦（Tangpu，音译）势力非常强大。

回想此前在该联合会办公室举行的委员会改选被国民党宣布为非法（参见 I.R. 1934年11月3日）。在那次事件中，陈及其支持者取得了压倒性的胜利。

Miscellaneous (3)

Famine Relief - 5th District Cigarette Factory Workers'
Union to raise fund

Eleven committee members of the 5th District
Cigarette Factory Workers' Union, at a meeting held in
their office, 78 Len Myi Loo, Footung, on January 5,
decided to detail Tung Ng-c-sung (董敖生) and Li Yuch-foh
(李元福), two committee members, to solicit contributions
from workers of the Yee Tsoong Tobacco Factory towards
the fund raised by the Shanghai Committee for Urgent
Famine Relief work.

Tungchow Road Market - Stallkeepers on strike

Some 300 stall-keepers of the Tungchow Road Market,
declared a strike at 7 a.m. January 7 as a protest against the
presence of vegetable and other hawkers on streets adjoining
the market. These stall-keepers declare that the presence
of such hawkers affects their business and ask for the
removal of these competitors. It is learned that
the proprietor of the Hsin Yih Da (新益大) Pork Shop, 7
Tungchow Road, nicknamed Siao Kiangpeh, who also owns a
pork stall in the market is the ringleader of this
agitation.

Bureau of Education establishes temporary office in the
Settlement to deal with the joint examination of middle
school graduates

The Bureau of Education of the Shanghai City Government has
established a temporary office in the Huchow Club, 263 Kwei-
chow Road, to deal with the joint examination of graduates of
local senior and junior middle schools which will take place
in several schools in Nantao on January 7, 8 and 9. This
temporary office will start functioning on Jan. 7 and, it is
expected, will close after ten days when matters in connection
with the examination are completed.

赈灾——第五区卷烟厂工人联合会筹款

1月5日，第五区卷烟厂工人联合会的11名委员在其位于浦东伦明路（Len Myi Loo，音译）78号的办公室举行会议，决定指派两名委员董敖生（Tung Ng-c-sung）和李元福（Li Yuch-foh）向颐中烟草公司（Yee Tsoong Tobacco Factory）的工人募集捐款，以支援上海紧急救灾委员会设立的基金。

通州路市场——摊贩罢工

1月7日上午7时，通州路市场的约300名摊贩宣布罢工，抗议在市场邻近街道上出现的蔬菜及其他小贩。这些摊贩声称，此类小贩的存在影响了他们的生意，并要求清除这些竞争对手。据悉，通州路7号“新益大”肉铺老板，绰号“小江北”（Siao Kiangpeh，音译），他在市场内也拥有一个猪肉摊位，是此次煽动活动的头目。

教育局在租界设立临时办事处以处理中学毕业生联合考试事宜

上海市政府教育局已在贵州路263号湖州会馆设立临时办事处，以处理本地高中及初中毕业生的联合考试事宜，该考试将于1月7日、8日和9日在南市的多所学校举行。该临时办事处将于1月7日开始运作，预计在与考试相关的事务完成后，即十天后关闭。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, SATURDAY, JULY 28, 1934 No. D
Date 30 / 7 /

Total Number Re-employed
In B.C.C. Factory Increases

Labour Situation Is Greatly Relieved But Trouble
Still Hovers In The Air; Tramway Workers
Are Unsatisfied With Present Condition

Another 1,740 workers of the B.C.C. New Factory at Pootung resumed work yesterday morning thereby bringing the total number of workers now employed up to 3,900 hands. Although most of the former difficulties have been ironed out at the present time, fear of a new strike outbreak was evidenced on Friday morning when some 800 workers of the Old Factory went to the New Factory to receive their retiring gratuities, deposit and annual bonus. They were informed that in computing retiring gratuities the company had only counted each month as 26 days, allowing for four Sundays. Upon hearing this the workers raised an immediate protest and an attempt was made to prevent the operatives of the New Factory from carrying on their labours. The members of the Chinese police however, dissuaded them from taking this action and soon succeeded in dispersing them. At 11 a.m. the company published an announcement stating their agreement to the demands and a total of some 300 workers received their money in the afternoon without any further incident.

The local Kuomintang Headquarters issued a notice on Thursday that in compliance with one of the measures settling the strike in the New Factory, the workers in question would be paid an advance of $6 as relief for the period of the strike in Yang Ching Temple on Station Road, Pootung.

On July 26, 12 members of the Hisshin Kisen Kaisha Tallymen's Club held a meeting and decided to ask for an increase in wages of $12 per month.

The General Labour Union has arranged to give free medical attention to labourers in the office of the Union, 117 Foh Yeu Road, beginning from July 26.

The Dah Chung Hwa Rubber factory has suspended operation due to trade depression and a total of 1,040 are out of work as a consequence.

Electric Workers' Inquiry

Acting upon a rumour to the effect that owing to the trade depression, the management of the French Tramway Company would reduce wages of all employees by $9 per month, would abolish the system of compensation to all retiring and dismissed employees and would dismiss all those over the age of 60 years, two representatives of the Second District Water and Electricity Workers' Union called upon the management on July 24 and received a flat denial of the report. He did intimate however, that if business did not improve, all aged employees might be dismissed.

Yesterday some 12 committee members of the Union resolved that the Compagnie Francaise de Tramways et d'Eclairage Electriques in Shanghai be requested to extend the date of retirement of those who had been asked by the company to resign by August. Arrangements were also made to prevent certain ex-workers from stirring up agitations.

英美烟厂复雇
总人数增加

劳工局势大为缓解，但麻烦仍悬而未决；电车工人对现状不满

昨天上午，浦东英美烟公司（B.C.C.）新厂的另外1,740名工人复工，从而使目前受雇工人总数达到3,900人。尽管目前大多数先前的困难已得到解决，但在周五上午，当旧厂的约800名工人前往新厂领取退休酬金、存款和年终奖金时，人们对新一轮罢工爆发的担忧显露无遗。他们被告知，公司在计算退休酬金时，每月仅按26天计算，扣除了四个星期日。听到这一消息后，工人们立即提出抗议，并试图阻止新厂工人继续工作。然而，华警成员劝阻了他们采取这一行动，并很快成功将他们驱散。上午11时，公司发布公告，表示同意他们的要求，下午共有约300名工人领到了钱款，未发生进一步事件。

当地国民党总部周四发布通知称，作为解决新厂罢工的措施之一，有关工人将在浦东车站路杨清寺（Yang Ching Temple，音译）领取6元预付款，作为罢工期间的救济金。

7月26日，日清汽船株式会社（Hisshin Kisen Kaisha）理货员俱乐部的12名成员举行会议，决定要求每月增加工资12元。

总工会已安排从7月26日起，在佛佑路（Foh Yeu Road，音译）117号的工会办公室为劳工提供免费医疗服务。

大中华橡胶厂因贸易萧条暂停运营，导致共计1,040人失业。

电力工人查询

针对有谣言称，由于贸易萧条，法商电车公司管理层将把所有员工的月薪减少9元，废除对所有退休和被解雇员工的补偿制度，并解雇所有60岁以上的人员，第二区水电工人联合会的两名代表于7月24日拜访了管理层，并得到了对该报道的断然否认。然而，他暗示如果业务没有改善，所有年老员工可能会被解雇。

昨天，该联合会的约12名委员决议，请求上海法商电车电灯公司（Compagnie Francaise de Tramways et d'Eclairage Electriques in Shanghai）将公司要求辞职人员的退休日期延长至八月。还作出了安排，以防止某些前工人煽动动乱。

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Monday, July 23, 1934

B.C.C. Strike Is Ended
Two Months After Start

The two-month strike at the "New" Factory of the British Cigarette Company, Pootung, was concluded this morning.

With officers from the Third Branch Public Safety Bureau and the Third Company of the Reserve Squad of the Bureau standing by, some 400 stokers, operatives of the godowns, crews of the tugboats and lighters and other workers in quiet and orderly fashion entered the plant at 7 o'clock this morning to pave the way for complete resumption of work.

The remaining 4300 workers of the various departments of the factory will resume between tomorrow and Saturday. The delay is necessitated as operation in several departments must await of the complete resumption of others.

The strike was called to an end following the acceptance by the Strike Committee of a set of measures issued on July 20 by the City Government of Greater Shanghai and the City Kuomintang Headquarters. The measures provide that the discharged workers of the "Old" Factory be given three month wages, bonuses and gratuities, that the strikers be given $3 during the period of the strike and that the "Old" factory employees be given preference when the plant reopens.

Following announcement of the settlement of the strike, the "Committee of Shanghai Various Circles To Support the Labor Friends of the B.C.C. Factories," organized June 27, decided to wind up its affairs within five days.

It was two months ago that the "New" Factory workers walked out in a sympathy strike for the closure of the "Old" Factory by the management. They demanded its reopening. During the strike, the workers formed picket groups and stationed themselves near the plant. They clashed with the strike-breakers.

《上海晚邮与信使报》，1934年7月23日，星期一

英美烟厂罢工
在开始两个月后结束

浦东英美烟公司（British Cigarette Company）“新”厂为期两个月的罢工于今晨结束。

在公安局第三分局警官和该局后备队第三中队队员的戒备下，约400名司炉工、仓库操作员、拖船和驳船船员以及其他工人于今晨7时安静有序地进入工厂，为全面复工铺平道路。

工厂各部门剩余的4,300名工人将在明天至周六期间陆续复工。由于几个部门的运营必须等待其他部门完全恢复，因此延迟是必要的。

罢工委员会接受了大上海市政府和市国民党总部于7月20日发布的一系列措施后，罢工宣告结束。这些措施规定，“旧”厂被解雇的工人将获得三个月的工资、奖金和酬金，罢工者在罢工期间将获得3元补助，并且在工厂重新开放时，“旧”厂员工享有优先录用权。

在宣布罢工解决后，于6月27日成立的“上海各界支援英美烟厂劳工朋友委员会”决定在五天内结束其事务。

两个月前，“新”厂工人因管理层关闭“旧”厂而举行同情性罢工。他们要求重新开放“旧”厂。在罢工期间，工人们组成了纠察队，驻扎在工厂附近。他们与破坏罢工者发生了冲突。

THE SHANGHAI SUNDAY TIMES, JULY 22, 1934
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5894
Date 23 / 7 / 34

B.C.C. Pootung Strike May
Be Ended To-morrow

Shanghai City Government Hands Down Orders To
3,000 Employees After Its Successful Efforts
For Mediation; Meeting To-day

The walkout of the 3,000 work-
ers of the B.C.C. Pootung "New"
factory, which began more than
two months ago, is expected to end
to-morrow, it was learnt yester-
day.
The Shanghai City Government
was reported yesterday to have
been successful in its mediation
efforts and to have issued instruc-
tions to the strikers. The instruc-
tions contain terms for ending the
strike and the executive committee
of the strikers is to meet to-day
to discuss them prior to formal
acceptance. Meanwhile it was
said yesterday that the workers
were preparing to resume their
jobs to-morrow.
The six points in the Shanghai
City Government's instructions
were as follows:
Proposed Terms
1.—That the service of the opera-
tives of the "Old" factory be dis-
pensed with and that the B.C.C. issue
three months wages to them as re-
tiring gratuities in addition to the
deposits and bonuses of the workers.
2.—That the City Government be
held responsible to pay an advance
of $6 each to the workers of the
"New" factory within one week after
works starts.
3.—That workers of the "Old"
factory be given preference of employ-
ment at their former pay rate should
the old plant be re-opened.
4.—That no workers of the "New"
factory be dismissed after work is
resumed.
5.—That the question of the con-
tinuation of the labour agreement
concluded by the employees and em-
ployers be dealt with separately by
the City Government.
6.—That the picketing corps formed
by the strikers be dissolved immediate-
ly.
The strike involved the attention
of the local and national Chinese
authorities during its active period,
but was marked by but one or two
cases of violence. It began when
the B.C.C. announced that its No.
1 or "Old" Pootung factory would
be closed indefinitely, and the
workers of the No. 2 or "New"
factory struck in sympathy for
their colleagues thus rendered un-
employed.
Other Labour Troubles
The formation of unions is held
responsible for cases of unrest at
two factories reported yesterday.
At 10 a.m. on Friday a quartette
of representatives from the work-
ers of the Sing Yah chemical
works, 1095 Sinza Road, called at
the local Kuomintang and request-
ed assistance in opposing the
management which they alleged to
be ill-treating the employees. They
also asked permission to form a
union and called at the General
Labour Union in that regard. At
both the General Labour Union
and the Kuomintang the four dele-
gates were promised that an
investigation would be made.
The Chinese authorities were
responsible for a meeting on
Friday at which the workers and
management of the Song Lung
tooth brush factory, Hwei Ning
Road, Nantao, came to an under-
standing about their dispute which
started when the employees joined
the 1st district Union. The man-
agement agreed to allow the work-
ers to join the union and to re-
cognize the union, but referred to
court a demand that medical ex-
penses be paid one employee al-
legedly assaulted at the instiga-
tion of the management.

Demand Of Tallymen
A flat increase of $8 per month
for tallymen of the China Mer-
chants S.N. Company is being
demanded by the Tallymen's Guild
and on Friday a representative of
the Guild, accompanied by an
official of the General Labour
Union, interviewed the manage-
ment of the C.M.S.N. Company
and presented the demands. The
pair were told that the demands
would be referred to the com-
pradores for comment.
Some trouble occurred on Friday
at the Vung San Wharf, Pootung,
when 50 unemployed coolie appear-
ed and demanded work, also
attempting to prevent 40 other
coolies from unloading machinery.
Chinese police prevented a brawl
and stood by while the job was
completed.

《上海星期时报》，1934年7月22日
上海公共租界工部局警务处
S. B. 登记处。
编号 D 5894
日期 34年7月23日

英商中国烟草公司浦东罢工
可能于明日结束

上海市政府在成功调解后向
3,000名雇员下达指令；今日开会

据悉，英商中国烟草公司（B.C.C.）浦东“新”厂3,000名工人的罢工行动始于两个多月前，预计将于明日结束。
据报道，上海市政府昨日的调解工作取得成功，并向罢工者发布了指示。该指示包含结束罢工的条款，罢工者执行委员会将于今日开会讨论这些条款，然后再正式接受。与此同时，昨日有消息称，工人们正准备于明日复工。
上海市政府指示中的六点内容如下：
提议条款
1.—解雇“老”厂的操作工，英商中国烟草公司除支付工人的存款和奖金外，另发给三个月工资作为退休酬金。
2.—市政府负责在开工后一周内，向“新”厂工人每人预付6美元。
3.—如果老厂重新开工，“老”厂工人应按原工资率优先受雇。
4.—复工后不得解雇“新”厂的任何工人。
5.—关于雇员与雇主签订的劳工协议是否继续有效的问题，由市政府另行处理。
6.—立即解散由罢工者组成的纠察队。
此次罢工在活跃期间引起了中国地方和国家当局的关注，但仅发生了一两起暴力事件。罢工的起因是英商中国烟草公司宣布其第一号或浦东“老”厂将无限期关闭，第二号或“新”厂的工人为了声援因此失业的同事而举行罢工。
其他劳资纠纷
据昨日报道，两家工厂发生动荡事件，归咎于工会的成立。
周五上午10时，新闸路1095号信亚化学厂（Sing Yah chemical works）的四名工人代表前往当地国民党部，请求协助反对资方，他们指控资方虐待员工。他们还请求允许成立工会，并就此事宜拜访了总工会。在总工会和国民党部，这四名代表都得到承诺，将对此事进行调查。
中国当局促成了一次会议，周五，南市汇宁路松龙牙刷厂（Song Lung tooth brush factory）的工人和资方就纠纷达成了谅解，该纠纷始于员工加入第一区工会。资方同意允许工人加入工会并承认工会，但对于一名据称在资方唆使下遭到殴打的员工要求支付医疗费用的诉求，则提交法院处理。

理货员的要求
理货员公会正在要求招商局轮船公司（China Merchants S.N. Company）的理货员每月统一加薪8美元，周五，公会代表陪同总工会的一名官员会见了招商局轮船公司管理层，并提出了上述要求。两人被告知，这些要求将转交买办征求意见。
周五，浦东公三码头（Vung San Wharf）发生了一些骚乱，当时50名失业苦力出现并要求工作，还试图阻止另外40名苦力卸载机器。中国警察防止了斗殴的发生，并在一旁守候直至工作完成。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, THURSDAY, JULY 19, 1934
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY. No. D 5894 Date 20 / 7 / 34 8846）

CITY GOV'T. WANTS
STRIKE ENDED

Advances Suggestions To
End B.C.C. Trouble;
Workers Unagreed

With trouble at the B.C.C. Pootung factories apparently no nearer solution than in the beginning, several months ago when the "Old" Factory was closed because of insubordination of employees, the Shanghai City Government with aid from the Tangpu has drawn up a list of suggestions toward settlement of the strike. They are as follow:
1.—That the operatives in the "New" Factory resume work first.
2.—That the strikers maintenance corps be dissolved.
3.—That in addition to one month's wages and deposits, as well as annual bonus which the management has promised, each worker in the "Old" Factory be given a gratuity equal to two months' wages.
4.—That preference be given to former hands of the "Old" Factory when it reopens.
5.—That no workers in the "New" Factory be dismissed after resumption of work.
To these suggestions the strikers failed to give their approval at a meeting held on Tuesday in the workers' union headquarters. They decided to ask the City Government for better measures. Among other things, they resolved to continue striking until the "Old" Factory resumes operation. They refused to consider dissolving their maintenance corps, because, they said, it was formed to protect foreign employees and property of the company and to maintain order among workers.
Other news in labour circles was an attempt by some 40 coolies of the Heng Chong Machine Works, Pootung, to interfere with the unloading of machinery yesterday. Chinese police arrested two of the malcontents.

（批：Jul 12）

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 S. B. 登记处。编号 D 5894 日期 34年7月20日 8846）

市政府希望
结束罢工

提出建议以解决
英商中国烟草公司纠纷；
工人未同意

由于英商中国烟草公司浦东工厂的麻烦似乎并不比几个月前刚开始时更接近解决——当时“老”厂因员工不服从而关闭——上海市政府在塘浦（Tangpu）的协助下，制定了一份解决罢工的建議清单。内容如下：
1.—“新”厂的操作工首先复工。
2.—解散罢工者的维持队。
3.—除资方已承诺的一个月工资、存款以及年终奖金外，“老”厂的每名工人还应获得相当于两个月工资的酬金。
4.—老厂重新开工时，优先录用“老”厂的前员工。
5.—复工后不得解雇“新”厂的任何工人。
在周二于工人工会总部举行的会议上，罢工者未能批准这些建议。他们决定要求市政府采取更好的措施。除其他事项外，他们决议继续罢工，直到“老”厂恢复运营。他们拒绝考虑解散其维持队，因为他们称，该队是为了保护公司的外籍员工和财产，并维持工人之间的秩序而成立的。
劳工界的另一则新闻是，昨日浦东恒昌机器厂（Heng Chong Machine Works）约40名苦力试图干扰机器卸载。中国警察逮捕了两名闹事者。

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE B. REGISTRY. No. D 5894 Date 20 / 7 / 34）

STRIKE SITUATION IS
UNCHANGED

Committee Requests
Local Tangpu To
Lend Aid

The strike conditions in the
B.C.C. New Factory at Pootung
remain the same with the strike
committee still endeavouring to
legalize the existence of the
Maintenance Corps. On Wednes-
day the committee called upon
the local Tangpu and requested
the resumption of activities at
the "old factory" with the en-
gagement of unemployed hands
and the distribution of compensa-
tion. They were interviewed by
Doong Ying-pah who promised
to discuss the dispute with the
Bureau of Social Affairs. The
committee also appealed to the
City Government the same after-
noon.

Guild Meeting
The Cabin Boys' Guild, which
met at number 26 Jeu Kao Zang
Ka, on Wednesday, resolved that
all members be requested to re-
gister with the Guild before the
end of September and to forward
the list of names to the Seamen's
General Labour Union. They
also decided to try and prevent
number one cabin boys from
making a deduction from tips
received by the members of the
guild.

A slight dispute is reported as
having occurred in the Jansen
Leather Factory on July 15 when
a worker quarrelled with a fore-
man and two fellow workers.

The former drew a knife but in
the melee which ensued he was
injured by his own weapon.
The injured man is in the
Sacred Heart Hospital and the
other two men are being held by
the authorities.

A new Chinese printing and
dyeing factory, known as the Wu
Foong Printing and Dyeing
Factory, opened yesterday morn-
ing at 700 Holung Road with a
staff of 40 men.

罢工局势
未有变化

委员会请求
当地塘浦
提供援助

浦东英商中国烟草公司新厂的罢工状况依旧，罢工委员会仍在努力使维持队的存在合法化。周三，委员会拜访了当地塘浦，请求恢复“老厂”的活动，雇佣失业工人并发放补偿金。董英柏（Doong Ying-pah，音译）接见了他们，并承诺与社会局讨论此纠纷。同日下午，委员会也向市政府提出了呼吁。

公会会议
周三，舱面水手公会（Cabin Boys' Guild）在九江路26号开会，决议要求所有成员在九月底前向公会注册，并将名单报送海员总工会。他们还决定设法防止头等舱面水手从公会成员收到的小费中抽取扣款。

据报道，7月15日詹森皮革厂（Jansen Leather Factory）发生了一起轻微纠纷，当时一名工人与一名领班及两名同事发生争吵。
前者拔刀相向，但在随后的混战中，他被自己的武器所伤。
伤者目前在圣心医院，另外两人正被当局拘留。

一家名为五丰印染厂（Wu Foong Printing and Dyeing Factory）的新华资印染厂，昨日上午在霍龙路700号开业，拥有员工40人。

City Government Order
Continuing their defiance against orders issued by the City Government of Greater Shanghai, the "Maintenance Corps" and the "Propaganda Corps" of the Strike Committee of the workers of the B.C.C. "New" Factory continued to function with banners in the vicinity of the Pootung plant.

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, TUESDAY, JULY 10, 1934

B. C. C. DISPUTE IS
STILL DRAGGING

Various Firms Suspend
Or Cut Work Hours;
Dull Business

With the summer doldrums
upon Shanghai business several
firms, among them cotton mills
and a large egg plant, have either
cut working hours or suspended
operations temporarily. Mean-
while, the B.C.C. Pootung dispute
drags on with strikers still ap-
pealing to the National Govern-
ment for assistance.
The Shanghai General Labour
Union met on Saturday to pass
petitions in connection with
labour difficulties in several plants.
With regard to the B.C.C. they
decided to ask the City Govern-
ment to negotiate with British
authorities for cancellation of the
decision to land marines in Poo-
tung, and to rescind an order for
dissolution of the strikers' mainte-
nance corps.
The Sun Sing cotton mills Nos.
1, 2 and 8 will work from Sunday
only six days and six nights per
week, a reduction of one night
per week, owing to depression.
The Behr and Mathews Egg
Factory, British-owned, located
in 1267 Yangtzepoo Road and
employing 400 workers, has sus-
pended business temporarily
owing to hot weather and the
lack of eggs.

英商中国烟草公司纠纷
仍在拖延

多家公司停工
或缩短工时；
生意清淡

随着夏季萧条笼罩上海商界，包括棉纺厂和一家大型蛋品厂在内的几家公司要么缩短了工作时间，要么暂时停止运营。与此同时，英商中国烟草公司浦东纠纷仍在拖延，罢工者仍在向国民政府求助。
上海总工会周六开会，通过了有关几家工厂劳工困难的请愿书。关于英商中国烟草公司一事，他们决定请求市政府与英国当局谈判，取消在浦东登陆海军陆战队的决定，并撤销解散罢工者维持队的命令。
由于不景气，申新一、二、八厂从周日起每周只工作六天六夜，每周减少一个夜班。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, WEDNESDAY,

Tobacco Strikers Oppose
Dissolution Order

Agree To Use Different Name But Refuse To Obey
Instructions Coming From Executive Yuan
And Mayor Wu Regarding Watchers

The striking workmen of the Pootung B.C.C. No. 2 factory now claim that the order instructing them to dissolve their maintenance corps and their propaganda groups came from the Executive Yuan, and on Monday the strikers' executive committee sent a telegram to the Executive Yuan questioning the order and explaining the purpose of the bodies. Meanwhile the two continue to solution.

The order came from the Shanghai City Government and instructed that the bodies be dissolved by Sunday noon, July 1. The order was not obeyed. On Monday a delegate from the Bureau of Social Affairs, in company with members of the 3rd division of the Bureau of Public Safety, called on the strikers' committee, Pootung, and stated that Mayor Wu had instructed the dissolution.

Use Different Name

The committee, however, was unwilling to follow the order on the grounds that the bodies had been formed with the approval of the local Tangpu and were organized with a view to keeping peace and rendering protection to the factory from reactionary elements. To satisfy the authorities, however, the committee decided that the name of the 5th district Cigar-ette Workers Union would be used instead of "strike committee" in all dealings with outsiders.

At 10 a.m. on Monday the Committee of public bodies delegates supporting the strikers held a meeting on Chunghwa Road and passed a number of resolutions calling on Chinese to support the walkout by not transporting or using products of the B.C.C. The General Labour Union, also interested, sent four delegates on Monday morning to the local Tangpu and appealed for an early settlement of the trouble.

Agitation At Nanyang Co.

The Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory also is having trouble with its workers. Thirty-five of the employees' delegates called on the director of the factory on Monday and presented a number of demands including: that full day operation be resumed, that wages be paid in full even if the hours are reduced, and that wages be paid for holidays. The director promised to refer the requests to the general manager.

The Doong Shing dried goods shop, Nantao, closed on June 16 because of the depression. The assistants are now agitating for wages said to be owing for two months, and for the issue of retiring gratuities. They called at the General Labour Union on Monday and appealed for help.

日期 1934年7月4日

《字林西报》，星期三，

烟草罢工者反对
解散令

同意改用不同名称，但拒绝服从
行政院和吴市长关于纠察队的指示

浦东英美烟公司第二工厂的罢工工人现在声称，命令他们解散其维持队和宣传组的指令来自行政院，周一，罢工执行委员会向行政院发送了一份电报，质疑该命令并解释这些团体的目的。与此同时，双方继续寻求解决方案。

该命令来自上海市政府，指示这些团体必须在7月1日星期日中午前解散。该命令未被遵守。周一，社会局的一名代表在公安局第三分局成员的陪同下，拜访了浦东的罢工委员会，并表示吴市长已指示解散。

改用不同名称

然而，委员会不愿服从该命令，理由是这些团体是在当地塘浦批准下成立的，其组织目的是为了维持治安并保护工厂免受反动分子的侵害。为了满足当局的要求，委员会决定在与外界的所有交往中，使用“第五区卷烟业工会”的名称，代替“罢工委员会”。

周一上午10时，支持罢工者的各公共团体代表委员会在中华路举行会议，并通过多项决议，呼吁中国人通过不运输或使用英美烟公司的产品来支持罢工。同样关注此事的上海总工会于周一上午派出四名代表前往当地塘浦，呼吁早日解决纠纷。

南洋公司的骚动

南洋兄弟烟草厂也与其工人发生纠纷。35名员工代表于周一拜访了厂长，并提出了一系列要求，包括：恢复全天运营，即使工时减少也要全额支付工资，以及支付节假日工资。厂长承诺将这些请求转呈总经理。

南市的董兴百货店因经济萧条于6月16日停业。店员们目前正在为据说拖欠两个月的工资以及发放退休酬金而进行抗争。他们于周一拜访了上海总工会，请求援助。

档案
办

THE SHANGHAI TIMES. TUESDAY, JULY 3, 1934
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
D 5894
Date 4 / 7 / 34

“WARNING” TO B. C. C.
MANAGEMENT

Business Men’s Group
Demands Resumption
Of Work In Week

The support committee recently organized by local Chinese business leaders at the request of the B.C.C. strikers decided yesterday at a meeting to send a “warning” to the management of the B.C.C. asking them to allow all workers to return to work within one week’s time.

The original motion was “that a warning be sent to the B.C.C. management asking them to bring all strikers and jobless workers back to work within one week’s time, otherwise Chinese business men will run the company’s plants in Pootung with Chinese capital in order to settle the serious unemployment problem.” The last part of the motion was approved of as being a logical step but when the motion was passed it was left out from the chairman’s declaration

The strike committee yesterday petitioned Mr. Wang Ching-wei asking him to rescind his order for dispersing the “maintenance corps” organized by the B.C.C. strikers.

Factory Watched

An order of the Shanghai City Government had been issued on Saturday instructing the strikers to withdraw their maintenance corps and propaganda groups from the vicinity of the factory premises, but the watch was maintained yesterday, although the corps flags were not used nor was the vigilance open.

A meeting of the Public Bodies Support Committee, which was scheduled to take place on Sunday afternoon, failed in its programme, only a few members appearing on the scene. However, the strikers held a meeting on Sunday afternoon and passed numerous resolutions dealing mainly with requests to the Shanghai City Government and the Chinese authorities for assistance and negotiation. The General Labour Union also held a meeting on Sunday and passed resolutions that the Central authorities take a hand in the mediation and endeavour to end the dispute.

Garage Strike Ended

Sunday was notable, however, as being the day when the first of the Chinese chauffeurs of the Taylor Garage hire cars resumed work after a dispute which lasted more than a month and which was cleared up only late last week. Twelve of the chauffeurs took out cars on Sunday, but an attempt to celebrate by the firing of fire-crackers was stopped by the management.

S. B. 登记处。

日期 1934年7月4日

给英美烟公司
管理层的“警告”

商界团体
要求在一周内
复工

由当地中国商界领袖应英美烟公司罢工者请求最近组建的支持委员会，在昨日的会议上决定向英美烟公司管理层发出“警告”，要求他们允许所有工人在一周内返回工作岗位。

最初的动议是“向英美烟公司管理层发出警告，要求他们在一周内让所有罢工者和失业工人复工，否则中国商人将用中国资本接管该公司在浦东的工厂，以解决严重的失业问题。”动议的最后部分被认为是一个合乎逻辑的步骤而获得认可，但在通过动议时，主席的声明中省略了这部分内容

罢工委员会昨日向汪精卫先生请愿，请求他撤销解散由英美烟公司罢工者组织的“维持队”的命令。

工厂受到监视

上海市政府已于周六发布命令，指示罢工者将其维持队和宣传组从工厂附近撤出，但昨天仍保持了监视，尽管未使用纠察队旗帜，警戒活动也未公开进行。

原定于周日下午举行的公共团体支持委员会会议未能按计划进行，只有少数成员到场。然而，罢工者于周日下午举行会议，通过了多项决议，主要涉及请求上海市政府和中国当局提供协助并进行谈判。上海总工会也于周日举行会议，并通过决议，要求中央当局介入调解，努力结束争端。

车库罢工结束

然而，周日值得注意的一点是，泰勒汽车行（Taylor Garage）的中国司机在持续了一个多月、直到上周晚些时候才解决的纠纷后，首批恢复了工作。周日有12名司机出车，但管理层制止了他们燃放鞭炮庆祝的企图。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, MONDAY, JULY 2, 1934
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. M. R. GENDRY. No. D 5890 Date 4 / 7 / 34）

MAYOR WU AROUSES
B. C. C. STRIKERS

City Gives Orders For
Maintenance Corps
To Be Withdrawn

Striking workers of the Poo-
tung B.C.C. No. 2 factory waxed
indignant over the week-end and
held several meetings as a result
of being informed that Mayor
Wu Teh-chen, of the Shanghai
City Government, had issued in-
structions for the strikers' main-
tenance corps around the factory
premises to be withdrawn by noon
yesterday, the vernacular press
said yesterday.

The strikers learnt of the in-
structions during a meeting called
at 1 p.m. on Saturday by Mr. Chen
Bei-yeh, chief of the Third Branch
of the Pootung Public Safety
Bureau, and then immediately pro-
ceeded to the Shanghai City Gov-
ernment offices, where they asked
for an explanation and pointed out
that the corps was not to take ac-
tion, but was for the purpose of
propaganda and watching. They
were told then that the City Gov-
ernment would not intervene un-
lawfully.

The support committee formed
by members of various public
bodies was reported yesterday to
be aroused by the City Govern-
ment's instructions and to be
planning to hold an important
meeting in the near future.

With the strike of 200 coolies
at the Texaco Company's Pootung
plant continuing but without any
violence, the remainder of the
Shanghai industrial front was
quiet yesterday.

吴市长激起
英美烟公司
罢工者怒火

市政府下令
撤回维持队

据昨日中文报纸报道，浦东英美烟公司第二工厂的罢工工人在周末得知上海市政府市长吴铁城已发出指示，要求工厂周围的罢工者维持队在昨天中午前撤出后，感到愤怒，并举行了几次会议。

罢工者是在周六下午1点由浦东公安局第三分局局长陈贝叶（音译）先生召集的会议上得知这一指示的，随后立即前往上海市政府办公室，要求解释，并指出维持队并非为了采取行动，而是为了宣传和监视。他们当时被告知，市政府不会非法干预。

据报道，由各公共团体成员组成的支持委员会对市政府的指示感到愤慨，并计划近期举行一次重要会议。

随着德士古公司浦东工厂200名苦力的罢工仍在继续但未发生任何暴力事件，上海工业战线的其余部分昨日保持平静。

（批：1/2 2w）

THE SHANGHAI SUNDAY TIMES, JULY 1, 1934
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / S. B. REG: I.Y. / No. D 5894 / Date 2 1 7 1934）

Labour Dispute Conditions
Still Remain Unsettled

Bureau Of Public Safety Intimates That City
Government Is Urging The Abandonment
Of Strikers Maintenance Corps

No change in strike conditions at the Pootung Factory of the L.C.C. is reported, although on Thursday morning the officer-in-charge, third Division Police Station, received an order from the chief of the Bureau of Public Safety intimating that, on instructions of the City Government, the Maintenance Corps, formed by the Strike Committee, should be ordered to dissolve before noon yesterday.

Acting on these instructions, the two leaders of the strikers were summoned to the division office and were informed of the ultimatum, with the result that an urgent meeting of the Strike Committee was held in the Fifth District Cigarette Workers' Union. The outcome of the meeting was a decision to appeal to the City Government to permit the existence of the Corps, and in compliance with the wish of their fellow workers some 39 of the Strike Commmittee members proceeded to the Civic Centre at three o'clock, hoping to interview Mayor Wu.

Owing to the Mayor's absence the callers were received by the Chief of the Second Department who promised to refer their request to Mr. Wu. Dissatisfied with this reply the delegates demanded an immediate answer and the Mayor was subsequently communicated with, with the result that the Corps is to be allowed to function for the time being.

Pickets numbering more than 400 have been preventing the company from employing new workers and transporting raw materials and at one time they clashed with the police when the latter tried to intervene.

Texaco Trouble

The 200 workers of the Texas Oil Company Installation Plant at Pootung, who struck work on June 28, were still out yesterday morning. It will be recalled that this strike arose as the outcome of the dismissal of one of the workers, who, having been found guilty of a breach of regulations was suspended for three days, only to be discharged upon his returning to work.

The Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory announces that, since last Thursday, they have ceased operation in the afternoon and will continue to do so during the hot weather. This factory employs some 2,500 men and usually operates six full days per week.

With the completion of the repairs to machinery in the weaving room of the Sung Sing Cotton Mill on Seoul Road, operations have been fully resumed. Work started again at 6 p.m. Thursday.

Resume Regular Work

The China Import and Export Lumber Company re-commenced normal operations yesterday. Prior to this period the Company employees had been working five days a week since June 23, instead of the customary six.

Denouncing the committee for having apparently deceived them, some 30 ex-chauffeurs of the Taylor Garage strongly voiced their disapproval when they discovered, on Thursday morning that only 10 former employees were to be reinstated by July 1. They left after they had been promised further arrangements would be made and later the same day a number of drivers met in the Hire Car Chauffeurs Union and passed the following resolutions: (1) That the ten chauffeurs to resume duty on July 1, be selected by ballot. (2) That those who are not to resume be given relief money in the sum of $5.00 each per month from the Union for two months, during which period efforts will be made to secure employment for them.

（批：FILE / 32）

《字林西报》星期日版，1934年7月1日
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / S. B. 登记处: I.Y. / 编号 D 5894 / 日期 1934年7月21日）

劳资纠纷状况
仍未解决

公安局暗示市政府
正敦促放弃罢工者维持队

据报道，浦东英美烟公司工厂的罢工状况没有变化，尽管周四上午，第三分局警察局的负责警官收到公安局局长的一项命令，暗示根据市政府的指示，应命令由罢工委员会成立的维持队在昨天中午前解散。

根据这些指示，两名罢工领导人被传唤至分局办公室，并被告知最后通牒，结果是罢工委员会在第五区卷烟业工会举行了紧急会议。会议的结果是决定向市政府上诉，请求允许维持队存在，并顺应工友的愿望，约39名罢工委员会成员于三点钟前往市中心，希望会见吴市长。

由于市长不在，来访者由第二处处长接待，他承诺将他们的请求转呈吴先生。代表们对此答复不满意，要求立即答复，随后与市长取得了联系，结果是维持队暂时被允许继续运作。

人数超过400人的纠察队员一直阻止公司雇佣新工人和运输原材料，当警方试图干预时，他们曾一度与警方发生冲突。

德士古公司的麻烦

6月28日罢工的浦东德士古石油公司安装厂的200名工人，昨天上午仍未复工。回想起来，这次罢工是由于一名工人被解雇引起的，该工人因违反规定被判有罪并被停职三天，但在返岗后即被开除。

南洋兄弟烟草厂宣布，自上周四以来，他们已停止下午的生产，并将在炎热天气期间继续这样做。该厂雇用约2,500人，通常每周全职工作六天。

随着首尔路（Seoul Road）松盛棉纺厂织布间机器维修工作的完成，生产已全面恢复。工作于周四下午6点重新开始。

恢复常规工作

中国进出口木材公司昨日重新开始正常运营。在此之前，自6月23日以来，该公司员工每周工作五天，而不是惯例的六天。

一些泰勒汽车行的前司机谴责委员会显然欺骗了他们，当他们在周四早上发现到7月1日只有10名前员工将被复职时，强烈表达了不满。在得到承诺将做出进一步安排后，他们离开了，当天晚些时候，一些司机在汽车出租司机工会开会，并通过了以下决议：(1) 7月1日复工的十名司机将通过投票选出。(2) 那些不复职的人将从工会获得每月5美元的救济金，为期两个月，在此期间将努力为他们寻找工作。

（批：档案 / 32）

S. B. P. C. N. Y.

te 27 / 6 /

Four 'Don'ts' Embody
Doctrine Of Strikers
At B. I. T. Factory

"Four-Don't-Ism" is the latest doctrine adopted by the strikers of the B. O. G. "New" Factory in Pootung to force their demands for the re-opening of the "Old" Factory, closure of which has for the past month caused labor trouble that has defied the numerous mediation efforts by Chinese authorities.

"Don't buy, don't sell, don't work for and don't transport B. C. C. products" is the theme of the new doctrine which the strikers urge Chinese to observe in their third manifesto issued since the walk-out. The circular was issued following a meeting of the Strike Committee yesterday afternoon.

The Strike Committee is entertaining leaders of various walks of life this evening. Only those armed with invitations are to be admitted. The place of the "reception," however, is not announced in their "bulletins" to the press to eliminate persons whose attendance they consider undesirable.

S. B. P. C. N. Y.
D 58911

四项“不”体现
B. I. T. 工厂
罢工者的信条

“四不主义”是浦东 B. O. G. “新”工厂罢工者采用的最新信条，旨在迫使人们接受重新开放“旧”工厂的要求，该厂过去一个月的关闭引发了劳资纠纷，中国当局的多次调解努力均告失败。

“不买、不卖、不为英美烟公司工作、不运输英美烟公司产品”是新信条的主题，罢工者在罢工以来发布的第三份宣言中敦促中国人遵守。这份传单是在昨天下午罢工委员会会议之后发布的。

罢工委员会今晚正在招待各界领袖。只有持有邀请函的人方可入场。然而，他们在给新闻界的“公报”中并未公布“招待会”的地点，以排除他们认为不受欢迎的人员出席。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, THURSDAY, JUNE 28, 1934

POLICE BAN B. C. C.
STRIKERS' MEET
Public "Rally" To Have
Been Held In Chinese
Y.M.C.A. Stopped

The meeting which was to have been held yesterday by the strike committee of the B. C. C. workers for the purpose of rallying Chinese public bodies to its support was banned by the French police.
Preparations for holding the meeting had been under way for nearly two weeks, but yesterday when representatives from the various public bodies and newspapermen went to the Chinese Y.M.C.A. in the Concession where the meeting was to have taken place, they found police officers stopping people from attending the meeting.
Representatives were sent by the strikers to the Lu Ka Wei Police Station to petition for the opening of the meeting but their efforts proved futile.
Industrial Reports
A go-slow strike took place for a brief period at the Union Brewery, 1,420 Gordon Road, on Tuesday, it was reported yesterday. Some 200 workers declared the strike because of an alleged assault on one of them by a foreman. After the management had agreed to suspend the foreman, work was resumed.
At 4 p.m. on Tuesday six delegates from the Shanghai Postal Workers Union left Shanghai by train for Nanking and Tsinan. The annual conference of the postal workers representatives is to take place at Tsinan on July 1.
The eight hour day is being advocated by the 70 workers of the Pao San paper mill, Heng Pang Road, Chapei, who claim that their present 12-hour shifts are contrary to the Labour Law. More unrest has been reported from the China Kung Saung rubber factory, 530 Brenan Road, which suspended operations yesterday because of the depression. The 60 workers of the concern are demanding meals and half pay until the re-opening of the factory.
pages.zh:
《字林西报》，1934年6月28日，星期四

警方禁止英美烟公司罢工者集会
原定于在华青年会举行的公开“集会”被叫停

英美烟公司（B. C. C.）工人罢工委员会原定于昨日举行会议，旨在争取中国公共团体的支持，但该会议被法租界警方禁止。
筹备该会议的工作已进行了近两周，但昨日，当各公共团体的代表和新闻记者前往位于租界内、原定举行会议的中华基督教青年会（Chinese Y.M.C.A.）时，发现警察正在阻止人们参加会议。
罢工者派代表前往卢家湾警察局请愿，要求允许召开会议，但其努力证明是徒劳的。

工业报告
据昨日报道，周二在高登路1420号的联合啤酒厂（Union Brewery）发生了短暂的怠工罢工。约200名工人因一名工头涉嫌殴打其中一名工人而宣布罢工。在管理层同意暂停该工头职务后，工作得以恢复。
周二下午4时，上海邮务工会的六名代表乘火车离开上海，前往南京和济南。邮政工人代表年会将于7月1日在济南举行。
闸北恒丰路宝三纸厂的70名工人正在倡导实行八小时工作制，他们声称目前的12小时轮班制违反《劳动法》。据报道，位于布伦南路530号的中国公胜橡胶厂因不景气而于昨日停工，该厂局势更加动荡。该公司的60名工人要求在工厂重新开工前提供膳食并支付半薪。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, TUESDAY, JUNE 26, 1934

SHANGHAI MUN. COUNCIL
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5894
Date 27/6/34

B.C.C. Factory Has Been
Closed For One Month

Strikers Issue Manifesto Alleging Injustices By
Management; Maintenance Corps Guards
Against Reported Opening Of Factory

With the B. C. C. Old factory closed for more than one month and work at the New factory suspended for nearly that time because of sympathy action by workers, the strike committee continues its efforts at obtaining public support. They aim at forcing the re-opening of the Old factory, although the management, because of continual agitation among the workers, announced that it would remain closed indefinitely.

On Saturday the strike committee appealed to yet another possible source of support in Messrs. Doo Yeh-sen and Wang Ching-yung, asking them to render relief.

In addition, the committee issued a long manifesto containing various allegations of injustices on the part of the management. They alleged that, despite attempted mediation by Chinese authority, the management had employed Russians in the place of Chinese hands. Furthermore, they stated that the management had refused to distribute wages due to the workers of the Old factory between May 12 and June 5, thereby causing considerable suffering.

Chinese authorities, states the manifesto, have been repeatedly implored to negotiate with the management to demand resumption of operations, distribution of wages, and the issue of medical grants to injured labourers, but to no avail.

Receiving a report that the New factory would soon reopen with new hands, the maintenance corps, some 400 men, are awaiting in the vicinity to prevent workers from transporting tin foil from the New factory to the Thorburn Road plant.

Signs Of Depression

Signs of business depression were seen in several instances where workers employed by Chinese-owned plants were agitating for the cancellation of wage cuts recently adopted. The Great Shanghai rubber factory in Nantao was one example, where workers have been cut to 75 per cent. of their former pay.

A foreign firm to cut down its working time was the China Import and Export Lumber Company, 1,426 Yangtzepoo Road. This factory will from June 23 operate five days per week instead of six. Six hundred hands are affected.

（批：拟办）

《字林西报》，1934年6月26日，星期二

上海工部局
特别支部登记处
编号 D 5894
日期 1934年6月27日

英美烟公司工厂已关闭一个月

罢工者发布宣言指控管理层不公；纠察队戒备以防工厂据传重新开工

随着英美烟公司老厂关闭已超过一个月，且由于工人的声援行动，新厂的工作也几乎在同一时间内停止，罢工委员会继续努力争取公众支持。他们的目标是迫使老厂重新开工，尽管管理层因工人持续的骚动而宣布将无限期关闭。

周六，罢工委员会向杜月笙和王清庸两位先生这一可能的支援来源发出呼吁，请求他们提供救济。

此外，委员会还发布了一份长篇宣言，列举了管理层的各种不公行为。他们指控称，尽管中国当局试图调解，但管理层仍雇佣俄国人取代中国工人。此外，他们指出，管理层拒绝发放5月12日至6月5日期间老厂工人应得的工资，从而造成了相当大的苦难。

宣言称，已多次恳请中国当局与管理层谈判，要求恢复生产、发放工资以及向受伤劳工发放医疗补助，但均无结果。

接到新厂即将雇佣新工人重新开工的报告后，约400人的纠察队在附近待命，以防止工人将锡箔从新厂运往韬朋路工厂。

萧条迹象

在一些由中国工厂雇佣的工人抗议最近实施的减薪并要求取消减薪的案例中，可以看到商业萧条的迹象。南市的上海大中华橡胶厂就是一个例子，该厂工人的工资已被削减至原来的75%。

一家缩短工作时间的外国公司是位于杨树浦路1426号的中国进出口木材公司（China Import and Export Lumber Company）。该厂将从6月23日起每周工作五天，而非六天。受影响工人达六百名。

（批：拟办）

S. S. REGISTRY.
No. D _________
Date ___ / ___ / ___

TOBACCO STRIKERS
READY TO FIGHT

Preparations To Resist
Are Resolved On And
One Assault Made

A resolve to prepare for resist-
ance, and an assault on a worker
were the items of interest report-
ed yesterday in connection with
the strike of the workers in the
B.C.C. No. 2 Pootung factory.

The resolution was one of three
passed at a meeting of the strike
committee and it stated that, in
connection with the report that
the No. 2 factory would resume
operation to-morrow, the mainten-
ance corps and the propaganda
groups of the strikers should
prevent any workers from re-
suming and should make pre-
parations for resistance should
the factory management call on
outside aid. The other two resolu-
tions dealt with appeals to the
Chinese authorities and with pro-
paganda.

The lone assault was on a work-
er named Yang Tu-keng, who had
formerly been employed in the
printing and designing rooms of
the No. 2 factory. Suspected by
the strikers of having worked in
secret at the Thorburn Road
B.C.C. factory, he was caught at 7
a.m. on Friday in an alley leading
to the Yung Shing Wharf and was
assaulted.

Also on Friday morning a por-
tion of the materials in the print-
ing and designing rooms of the
No. 2 factory were removed under
the protection of the Chinese police
to the No. 3 or Thorburn Road
factory.

《上海星期日报》，1934年6月24日

特别支部登记处
编号 D _________
日期 ___ / ___ / ___

烟草罢工者准备战斗

决心准备抵抗，并已发生一起袭击事件

昨日关于英美烟公司浦东第二厂工人罢工的报道中，引人注目的事项包括一项准备抵抗的决心以及对一名工人的袭击。

该决议是罢工委员会会议上通过的三项决议之一，决议指出，鉴于有关第二厂将于明日恢复生产的报告，罢工者的纠察队和宣传组应阻止任何工人复工，并应在管理层寻求外部援助时做好抵抗准备。另外两项决议涉及向中国当局呼吁以及宣传工作。

单独的一起袭击针对一名名为杨土根（Yang Tu-keng，音译）的工人，他此前受雇于第二厂的印刷和设计部门。罢工者怀疑他在韬朋路英美烟公司工厂秘密工作，周五上午7时，他在通往永兴码头的一条小巷中被抓获并遭到殴打。

同样在周五上午，第二厂印刷和设计部门的部分材料在中国警察的保护下被运往第三厂，即韬朋路工厂。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, WEDNESDAY, JUNE 20, 1934
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY. No. D 519 Date / / ）

Strike Assistance Groups
To Persuade Public

Will Urge Against Smoking B.C.C. Products And Try
To Suspend Transportation; Trouble Brews
In Chinese-Owned Factories

General indications of dissatisfaction among workers in various Chinese industrial concerns were reported yesterday together with news that the B. C. C. dispute was still deadlocked.
Members of the strike committee met on Monday afternoon to receive word from the delegates sent to Nanking to appeal for assistance. The Central authorities, it was said, promised to give their requests consideration. Meanwhile, pickets of the strike Committee continue on guard in the vicinity of the Pootung "New" Factory to prevent workers from entering the premises.
Further movements toward propaganda which would cripple transportation of Company products were seen in the organization of 15 "Calling For Help" groups which will solicit assistance from the public. They will urge the public not to smoke B. C. C. products, and will carry out activities particularly in the wharf districts with a view to preventing handling of B. C. C. cargo.

Depression—Agitaton
Depression was mainly at the bottom of troubles reported in various Chinese-owned factories, with unexplained agitation also playing its customary important part. At the Sung Sing No. 1 cotton mill, 32 workers were dismissed on Monday, ten of them for being agitators in a recent go-slow strike and the others because of slow business. The local Tangpu has been notified and negotiations have thus far failed to produce equable results.
At a Mayar mill in Route de Siccawei, recently the scene of violent strike demonstrations, the night shift has been abolished upon instructions of French authorities. Residents complained strongly of the noise caused by night work.
The Dragon Boat Festival celebration's brought an aftermath of complaints from workers who were not given a holiday with pay, or who were dismissed upon that occasion. At the Shing Nyi tile company the workers were given Saturday off, but were asked to work Sunday, usually a holiday. Those who failed to work Sunday were fined 10 cents. In protest the workers framed a demand that double wages be granted should workers operate on Sundays and holidays.

The Soy Shop Workers Union and the Dyeing Trade Union have also presented demands upon the Employer's associations concerned for reinstatement of workers dismissed on Dragon Boat Festival.

（批：6/26）

《字林西报》，1934年6月20日，星期三
（印：上海工部局警务处 特别支部登记处。编号 D 519 日期 / / ）

罢工援助团体
旨在说服公众

将敦促公众不要吸食英美烟公司产品，并试图阻断运输；华资工厂酝酿风波

昨日据报道，各家中国工业企业中工人普遍存在不满情绪，同时消息显示英美烟公司的纠纷仍处于僵局。
罢工委员会成员周一下午开会，听取派往南京请求援助的代表传来的消息。据说，中央当局承诺会考虑他们的请求。与此同时，罢工委员会的纠察员继续在浦东“新”厂附近警戒，防止工人进入厂区。
在宣传方面出现了进一步举措，旨在瘫痪公司产品的运输，具体表现为组织了15个“求援”小组，向公众寻求帮助。他们将敦促公众不要吸食英美烟公司的产品，并将在码头区特别开展活动，以阻止装卸英美烟公司的货物。

萧条—煽动

据报道，各家华资工厂的麻烦主要源于经济萧条，不明原因的煽动也发挥了其惯常的重要作用。在唐山路申新第一棉纺厂，周一有32名工人被解雇，其中10人因在最近的一次怠工罢工中进行煽动，其余人则因业务清淡。当地塘沽路警局已获通知，但谈判迄今未能产生公平的结果。
在霞飞路的一家Mayar工厂（近期曾发生激烈的罢工示威），根据法国当局的指示，夜班已被取消。居民强烈抱怨夜间工作造成的噪音。
端午节庆祝活动结束后，引发了工人的投诉，因为他们未获得带薪假期，或在此 occasion 被解雇。在兴义瓷砖公司，工人周六放假，但被要求在通常是假日的周日工作。未在周日工作的人被罚款10分。作为抗议，工人们提出了一项要求，如果工人在周日和节假日工作，应给予双倍工资。

酱油店员工会和染业工会也已向相关的雇主协会提出诉求，要求复职在端午节期间被解雇的工人。

（批：6/26）

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, WEDNESDAY, JUNE 20, 1934.
No. D

NANKING DISCUSSES
B.C.C. STRIKE

Three Principles Decided on
at Meeting

Three principles dealing with the
B.C.C. strike were decided upon at
a meeting called by the Executive
Yuan in Nanking on Monday, ac-
cording to a Chinese message re-
ceived here yesterday. They are:
the B.C.C. authorities should be
asked to re-open the No. 1 Factory;
in the event that the re-opening is
utterly impossible, the management
then should be asked to reinstate the
unemployed workers in other factor-
ies; and gratuities should be paid
to the remnants of the unemployed
workers after reinstatement.
The meeting was attended by
Messrs. M. K. Tuan, councillor of the
Executive Yuan, Hsu Wen-tien,
Chief of the Labour Department of
the Central People's Movement Com-
mittee, Tong Chi-fei,-Chief of the
Labour Department of the Ministry
of Industry, Wu Chi-ting, represent-
ing the Ministry of Finance, and Mr.
Kuo Yi, secretary of the Shanghai
City Government. During the meet-
ing, the participants all agreed that
the first of the three items outlined
above should be held as the main
principle.
In Pootung, about 30 pickets of
the Strike Committee continued to
wait in the vicinity of the No. 2
Factory yesterday morning to pre-
vent workers from entering the
premises. Four delegates of the
Committee called at the Shanghai
District Kuomintang on Monday,
asking for assistance in settling the
dispute and reporting the details in
connection with the appeal made to
the Government authorities. The
callers further requested that im-
mediate relief be rendered to the
workers.

《华北每日新闻》，1934年6月20日，星期三
编号 D
日期 / /

南京讨论英美烟公司罢工

会议确定三项原则

据昨日收到的一则中文消息，行政院周一在南京召开的会议上确定了处理英美烟公司罢工的三项原则。这三项原则是：应要求英美烟公司当局重新开放第一厂；如果重新开放完全不可能，则应要求管理层在其他工厂安置失业工人；在安置之后，应向剩余的失业工人支付遣散费。
出席会议的有行政院顾问段茂坤（M. K. Tuan，音译）、中央民众运动指导委员会劳工部部长徐文典（Hsu Wen-tien，音译）、实业部劳工部部长童季斐（Tong Chi-fei，音译）、代表财政部的吴纪定（Wu Chi-ting，音译）以及上海市政府秘书郭仪（Kuo Yi，音译）。会议期间，与会者一致同意，上述三项中的第一项应作为主要原则。
在浦东，约30名罢工委员会的纠察员昨日上午继续在第一厂附近等待，以防止工人进入厂区。委员会的四名代表周一拜访了上海地区国民党党部，请求协助解决纠纷，并汇报了向政府当局提出呼吁的相关细节。来访者还请求立即向工人提供救济。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, TUESDAY, JUNE 19, 1934
（印：SHANGHAI S. B. R. C. Y. No. D Date / / ）

B.C.C. Strike Corps Arms
To Prevent Reopening

Rumour Of Activity At “New” Factory Brings Out
Squad; Delegates Leave For Nanking To Ask
Assistance; Shipping Dispute

Responding to a rumour that the B.C.C. “New” Factory at Pootung was to resume operations with new hands, some 400 members of the strikers maintenance corps yesterday surrounded the outside premises, armed with swords, iron bars and wooden poles to prevent new men from entering.

At the same time three of the most active members in the strike movement had gone to Nanking appealing for assistance from the Government. They left Shanghai on Friday and returned on Sunday with the word that favourable consideration had been promised their request. The influence of strikers in Chapei was noted in the discovery of various communistic handbills bearing on the B.C.C. trouble.

Fearing entry of radical elements and resulting violent disturbances, the Bureau of Social Affairs has instructed the strike committee that they will be held responsible for attempts of communistic elements trying to utilize the strike. The Nantao Shipbuilding Workers’ Union is reported to have issued a manifesto supporting the strikers.

China Merchants’ Dispute

The question of distribution of tips aboard the China Merchants’ s.s. Poo An brought 40 cabin boys to agitate for an increase in their percentage. Three were dismissed as ringleaders in the movement and mediation was finally conducted in the office of the Seamen’s Union on Friday. It was agreed that in the future 55 per cent. of tips would be given the cabin boys and 45 per cent. retained by the steward. It was also agreed that the steward supply cleaning materials. The dismissed men were not reinstated pending further investigation.

Depression in the cotton business was further reported with the decision of the Sung Sing Cotton Mill No. 6 and No. 7 to operate six days and five nights per week instead of six days and seven nights as before.

（批：拟）
（批：抄发）

《字林西报》，1934年6月19日，星期二
（印：上海特别支部登记处。编号 D 日期 / / ）

英美烟公司罢工纠察队武装起来以防止重新开工

“新”厂活动的传闻引来队伍；代表赴南京请求援助；航运纠纷

针对有关浦东英美烟公司“新”厂将雇佣新工人恢复生产的传闻，约400名罢工者纠察队成员昨日包围了厂区外围，手持刀剑、铁棍和木棒，以防止新人进入。

与此同时，罢工运动中最活跃的三名成员已前往南京，向政府请求援助。他们于周五离开上海，周日返回，带回消息称他们的请求已获允诺予以有利考虑。在闸北发现了各种涉及英美烟公司纠纷的共产主义传单，显示出罢工者的影响力。

社会局担心激进分子介入并导致暴力骚乱，已指示罢工委员会，他们将对其试图利用罢工的共产主义分子的企图负责。据报道，南市造船工人工会已发布宣言支持罢工者。

招商局纠纷

招商局轮船“普安”号上小费分配的问题导致40名舱面服务员（cabin boys）进行煽动，要求增加他们的分成比例。三人作为运动的头目被解雇，调解最终于周五在海员工会办公室进行。双方达成协议，今后小费的55%归舱面服务员，45%由管事保留。还同意由管事提供清洁材料。被解雇的人员在进一步调查之前不予复职。

棉花行业的萧条情况进一步加剧，申新第六和第七棉纺厂决定每周工作六天五夜，而不是之前的六天七夜。

（批：拟）
（批：抄发）

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, FRIDAY, JUNE 15, 1934
8616
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D
Date / /

Mediation Fails In Strike
Of B.C.C. Employees

Dr. H. H. Kung, Finance Minister, And Mr. O. K.
Yui, Of Shanghai City Government, Attempt In
Vain To Bring Opposing Side Together

With the Central and Shanghai City authorities represented respectively by Dr. H. H. Kung, Finance Minister, and Mr. O. K. Yui, Secretary-General, a meeting was held yesterday between representatives of the workers and management of the Pootung B.C.C. factory in an endeavour to settle the strike there which has been continuing for a month. It was reported, however, that no headway was achieved, as both parties stuck to their views determinedly.

Further mediatory efforts may be made to-day or to-morrow by Chinese authorities. Three delegates selected by the strikers will go to Nanking on Monday to petition General Chiang Kai-shek and other high officials there to settle their dispute. The three delegates are Messrs. Chen Pei-deh, Shiao Kan-sen and Tang Ou-sen.

Yui Is Chairman

Mr. O. K. Yui, Secretary-General of the Shanghai City Government and chairman of the meeting yesterday, had a hard time in persuading both parties to the dispute to come to terms. Two B.C.C. representatives and two representatives from the strikers met at the meeting and, after a long discussion, neither of them showed signs of giving in.

The dispute was centred around the re-opening of the "old" plant of the Company in Pootung which was recently closed, throwing about 3,000 workers out of work. Mr. Chen Pei-deh, a delegate of the strikers, stated at the meeting that if the Company were willing to re-open the "old" plant, everything would be settled without any difficulty. Officers of the Company said that the plant was closed because it had lost money. The strikers contended that it had not lost money and that, on the contrary, it had realized a great profit which, in turn enabled the opening of the "new" plant.

Kung's Influence Futile

Dr. H. H. Kung, Minister of Finance, attended the meeting personally representing the National Government, and, despite his influence, no agreement could be reached.

Meanwhile several public bodies in Pootung issued a statement yesterday supporting the strikers. Jardine, Matheson and Co.'s wharf coolies, who had promised the B.C.C. strikers to stop transporting the Company's products, did not keep their promise yesterday in view of the fact that the foreign management of their Company opposed it.

（批：Note end m... to file.）
（批：18/6/34）

上海公共租界工部局
特别分部登记处。
D号
日期 / /

英美烟公司雇员罢工调解失败

财政部长孔祥熙博士与上海市政府俞鸿钧先生试图促成双方和解但未果

昨日，在分别代表中央政府和上海市政府的财政部长孔祥熙博士和秘书长俞鸿钧先生的主持下，浦东英美烟公司（B.C.C.）工厂的劳资双方代表举行会议，试图解决已持续一个月的罢工事件。然而据报道，由于双方均坚持己见，谈判未取得任何进展。

中国当局可能在今日或明日进行进一步的调解努力。罢工工人选出的三名代表将于周一前往南京，向蒋介石将军及其他高官请愿，以解决他们的纠纷。这三名代表是陈培德（Chen Pei-deh）、萧根生（Shiao Kan-sen）和唐欧生（Tang Ou-sen）。

俞鸿钧担任主席

上海市政府秘书长兼昨日会议主席俞鸿钧先生在劝说争端双方达成妥协方面颇费周折。两名英美烟公司代表和两名罢工工人代表出席了会议，经过长时间讨论，双方均未表现出让步的迹象。

争端的核心在于重新开放该公司位于浦东、近期关闭的“老”厂，此举导致约3000名工人失业。罢工代表陈培德先生在会议上表示，如果公司愿意重新开放“老”厂，一切问题将不难解决。公司官员称，该厂因亏损而关闭。罢工工人则辩称该厂并未亏损，相反，它实现了巨额利润，而这笔利润使得开设“新”厂成为可能。

孔祥熙的影响力无济于事

财政部长孔祥熙博士亲自代表国民政府出席会议，尽管他颇具影响力，但仍未能达成协议。

与此同时，浦东的几个公共团体昨日发表声明支持罢工工人。怡和洋行（Jardine, Matheson and Co.）的码头苦力曾承诺英美烟公司罢工者停止运输该公司的产品，但鉴于其公司的外籍管理层反对这一做法，他们昨日并未信守承诺。

（批：注：结尾部分...归档。）
（批：1934年6月18日）

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, THURSDAY, JUNE 14, 1934
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL S. B. REGI... No. D... Date .../.../...）

Mayor Wu Offers To Mediate
In The B.C.C. Dispute

Delegates From Company And Striking Workers
Invited To Round-Table Conference At City
Government Headquarters To-day

Invitations to send delegates to a round-table conference under the chairmanship of Mayor Wu Teh-chen, at the City Government's headquarters this morning, were reported to have been issued to the British American Tobacco Company and its striking workers by Mr. O. K. Yui, City Government General Secretary, last night.

The dispute, which involves approximately 5,000 workers formerly employed at the B.C.C. "Old" and "New" factories, is now in its fourth week. The trouble began when the B.C.C. found it necessary to close the "Old" factory, and workers at the "New" factory went on strike in protest.

The Shen Sing News Agency reported last night that the wharf coolies of the Jardine and Matheson Company had officially notified the B. A. T. Strike Committee through their labour union that they would stop transporting the company's products should no settlement be reached within a week.

Dr. Kung Named

Another Chinese report said that Dr. H. H. Kung, Minister of Finance who is now in Nanking, had been ordered by the National Government to do this best to settle the dispute.

The appointment was announced by several Chinese newspapers who stated that Dr. Kung had agreed to accept the mission. The strikers' committee held a meeting on Tuesday afternoon and passed several resolutions concerning the requesting of aid from a number of official bodies. For the same purpose, two of the strikers are planning to go to Nanking tomorrow to register an appeal before General Chiang Kai-shek.

吴铁城市长提议调解英美烟公司纠纷

邀请公司与罢工工人代表今日赴市政府总部参加圆桌会议

据报道，上海市政府秘书长俞鸿钧先生昨晚已向英美烟草公司（British American Tobacco Company）及其罢工工人发出邀请，请他们派遣代表参加由吴铁城市长主持、于今晨在市政府总部举行的圆桌会议。

此次纠纷涉及此前受雇于英美烟公司“老”厂和“新”厂的约5000名工人，目前已进入第四周。事端起因于英美烟公司认为有必要关闭“老”厂，随后“新”厂工人举行罢工以示抗议。

申星通讯社昨晚报道，怡和洋行的码头苦力已通过其工会正式通知英美烟草公司罢工委员会，如果一周内未能达成和解，他们将停止运输该公司的产品。

孔祥熙获任命

另一则中文报道称，目前在南京的财政部长孔祥熙博士已奉国民政府之命，尽力解决此次纠纷。

多家中文报纸宣布了这一任命，并称孔博士已同意接受此使命。罢工委员会于周二下午举行会议，并通过了几项关于向若干官方机构请求援助的决议。出于同一目的，两名罢工者计划于明日前往南京，向蒋介石将军提出申诉。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D
Date / /

B.C.C. Strikers Continuing
Propaganda Activities

Six Strikers Assault Worker Who Denounces
Strike Committee; Manifesto Issued; Wage
And Working-Day Reductions

The distribution of propaganda and the issuing of a manifesto occupied the attention of the B.C.C. No. 2 Pootung factory strikers yesterday.
On Friday 40 members of the strike committee held a meeting at the 5th district Cigarette Workers Union, 78 Lan Nyi Doo Road, Pootung, and reached decisions that a manifesto be issued, that two delegates be appointed to go to Nanking and present the strikers' case to the authorities there, and that no Chinese be allowed in the factory for work of any kind.
The manifesto was issued yesterday and contained a history of the strike, which is now about a month old, relating all the measures undertaken by the strikers. The propaganda corps continued its activities yesterday, having 60 persons detailed in shifts so that all 24 hours are covered.
The only act of violence occurred on Friday when a worker named Kying Ts-fang was assaulted at 9 a.m. by six strikers at Yang Ka Fah, Pootung, for having denounced the inability of the strike committee to deal with the situation. All seven of the parties were taken to a nearby police station where they were cautioned and released.

Fight Among Coolies
Another disturbance reported as happening on Friday concerned coolies of the Pao Tai silk filature, Lunghwa, who were transporting coal from boats to the filature. Twenty other coolies attempted to interfere with the work and a fight ensued which was stopped by the arrival of a party of Merchant Volunteer Corps police. Two of the coolies were arrested. The cause of the trouble was that the contract for the unloading of the coal had been changed and thus rendered some of the coolies workless.
A change in working conditions has been announced at the Hwa Dah cigarette factory where a new agreement has been reached with the workers accepting half pay until business conditions improve.

Umbrella Makers' Inquiry
The use of foreign materials is going to be investigated by the Shanghai Municipality Umbrella Makers Union which held a meeting at their office in the New North Gate, on Friday, and passed resolutions that a "foreign goods investigation committee" be formed, that the local Kuomintang be informed, and that masters in the trade be warned against using foreign materials.
The working days of the Nanyang Brother tobacco factory have been reduced, according to a report yesterday. Starting from yesterday the factory, located at 789 Seward Road, is operating on a five-day-week basis instead of six. The new arrangement affects 3,000 workers.

Reduction Protest
A go-slow strike at the Sung Sing No. 1 cotton mill on Friday lasted but two hours. The strike started at the mill, 200 Brenan Road, at 9 a.m. as a protest against a reduction in hours and wages. However, on the advice of their Union, the 28 persons forming the striking group resumed work and allowed negotiations to be carried on by Union members and a delegate from the Kuomintang.
The Jing Kung iron works, 270 Tsitsihar Road, and the Nyi Sung rubber factory, 81 Penang Road, suspended operations on Friday because of bad business conditions, it was reported. The total hands affected are 300.

英美烟公司罢工者继续进行宣传活动

六名罢工者袭击一名谴责罢工委员会的工人；发布宣言；减薪及缩短工时

昨日，英美烟公司浦东二厂罢工者的注意力集中在分发宣传材料和发布宣言上。
周五，40名罢工委员会成员在浦东兰尼杜路78号第五区卷烟工人工会举行会议，并作出决定：发布一份宣言；指派两名代表前往南京向当局陈述罢工者的情况；以及不允许任何中国人进入工厂从事任何工作。
宣言于昨日发布，其中回顾了这场已持续约一个月的罢工的历史，详述了罢工者采取的所有措施。宣传队昨日继续开展活动，安排了60人轮班，以确保24小时全覆盖。
唯一的暴力行为发生在周五上午9点，一名名为Kying Ts-fang（音译）的工人在浦东杨家渡（Yang Ka Fah）遭到六名罢工者的袭击，原因是他谴责罢工委员会无力应对局势。所有七名当事人都被带到附近的警察局，在接受警告后被释放。

苦力之间的斗殴
另一起据报道发生在周五的骚乱涉及龙华宝泰丝厂的苦力，他们当时正将煤炭从船上运往丝厂。另外二十名苦力试图干扰工作，随即发生斗殴，直到商团警察赶到才制止。两名苦力被捕。骚乱的原因是卸煤合同发生变更，导致部分苦力失业。
华大香烟厂宣布改变工作条件，已与工人达成新协议，工人同意在经营状况改善之前只领取半薪。

雨伞制造商的调查
上海市雨伞业同业公会将在其位于新北门的办事处调查外国材料的使用情况，该公会于周五举行会议，并通过决议：成立“外货调查委员会”；通报当地国民党党部；并警告业内雇主不得使用外国材料。
据昨日报道，南洋兄弟烟草厂的工作日已减少。从昨日起，位于西华德路789号的该工厂实行每周五天工作制，而非原来的六天。新安排影响3000名工人。

抗议减薪
周五，胜新第一棉纺厂发生怠工罢工，仅持续两小时。罢工于上午9点在布伦南路200号的该厂开始，以抗议工时和工资的减少。然而，在工会的建议下，组成罢工群体的28人恢复了工作，并由工会成员和一名国民党代表进行谈判。
据报道，位于齐齐哈尔路270号的景公铁工厂和位于彭南路81号的义生橡胶厂因生意不佳，于周五暂停运营。受影响员工总数为300人。
