THE SHANGHAI TIMES, WEDNESDAY, JUNE 6, 1934

Strikers Watch B.A.T. New
Factory, Prevent Work

Authorities Seek For Mediation While Committee
Of Strikers Entertains Journalists In Try For
Support; Hire Car Drivers Back

With a state of approximate siege surrounding the B. A. T. New Factory at Pootung since the incident of Monday morning when strikers clashed with Russian workers and foreign employees on the factory wharf, yesterday brought no word of yielding on the part of the strike committee. Determined to prevent strike-breakers from entering the factory to work, some 1,000 strikers were on guard in the vicinity yesterday morning.

An improved situation at the Thorburn Road and Whashing Road departments is reported. Some 270 workers who failed to turn up on Monday resumed work yesterday.

The strike committee, heedless of settlement attempts by the Shanghai City Government and Mr. Tang Chien-fee, appointed by the Ministry of Industry to investigate the disturbance, continue their efforts to swing public opinion in their favour. At a tea on Monday for Chinese journalists, a Union representative reported that 10 strikers had been assaulted and injured by 50 foreign employees who were armed with wooden bars. To his audience were distributed handbills bearing on the strike and a list of the names of workers injured. Four foreign employees of the Company are also said to have been hurt.

A sharp finale to the strike of Johnson Garage chauffeurs was seen yesterday morning following instructions by the local Kuomintang to the workers who walked out on Sunday, persuaded others to join them, and by means of intimidation tied up the service for two days Their action in striking before presenting their demands to the management was said to be contrary to Chinese law. Consequently, upon order of the authorities, all chauffeurs were at their posts yesterday morning.

At the Taylor Garage no change was reported, the Russian drivers who were hired to supplant the strikers carrying on as usual.

《字林西报》，1934年6月6日，星期三

罢工者监视英美烟草公司新厂，阻止开工

当局寻求调解，而罢工委员会宴请记者以争取支持；雇佣汽车司机复工

自周一早晨罢工者在工厂码头与俄国工人及外籍雇员发生冲突以来，浦东英美烟草公司新厂周围一直处于近似围困的状态，昨日罢工委员会方面未传出任何妥协的消息。为了坚决防止破坏罢工者进入工厂工作，约1000名罢工者昨日早晨在附近警戒。

据报道，索伯恩路（Thorburn Road）和华盛路（Whashing Road）部门的情况有所改善。约270名周一未上班的工人于昨日复工。

罢工委员会无视上海市政府和工业部委派调查此次骚乱的唐剑飞（Tang Chien-fee，音译）先生的调解尝试，继续致力于扭转舆论以利于己方。在周一为中国记者举行的茶会上，一名工会代表报告称，10名罢工者被50名手持木棍的外籍雇员殴打致伤。向与会者分发了有关罢工的传单以及受伤工人名单。据说该公司还有四名外籍雇员受伤。

约翰逊车行（Johnson Garage）司机的罢工在昨日早晨急剧收场，此前当地国民党向周日罢工、并说服他人加入、通过恐吓手段使服务瘫痪两天的工人下达了指令。据悉，他们在向管理层提出诉求之前就采取罢工行动，这违反了中国法律。因此，根据当局命令，所有司机于昨日早晨回到岗位。

泰勒车行（Taylor Garage）方面据报道没有变化，受雇取代罢工者的俄国司机照常工作。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, THURSDAY, JUNE 7, 1934

Police Action Against The
B.C.C. Strikers

Two Pickets Arrested In Raid On Sampan Near
B.A.T. Wharf; Others Make Dive Into Water
For Escape; Search For New Workers

Police took action against the B.C.C. strikers for the first time yesterday, the 18th day of the strike, when they raided a sampan near the B.A.T. wharf and arrested two pickets. Two others escaped by diving into the water and swimming away.
The raid was carried out by the River Police in the early morning, and the men were taken by surprise. It was stated that they were leaders of the organization which is attempting to prevent new workers being taken to the affected plant.
According to Chinese reports last night, the Company is engaged in an attempt to recruit new workers from the city's un-
employed, as the situation, owing to the effect on the machinery of keeping the plant idle, is becoming serious.
Other reports state that the strikers are maintaining a force of more than 400 for the purpose of preventing new labour being taken to the factory.

Workers Ask For Aid
A delegation of six striking B.C.C. workers visited the offices of the Shanghai City Government yesterday to request again that aid be rendered.
Meanwhile 600 of the strikers were stationed near the premises of the B.C.C. Pootung No. 2 factory as guards against strike-breakers being employed.
The representative of the Central Authorities, Mr. Tang Chien-fee, who was sent here by the Ministry of Industry to investigate the labour troubles, finished his inquiries and returned to Nanking on Tuesday night to report.
Seventy members of the 5th district Cigarette Workers Union, Pootung, held a meeting at 2 p.m. on Tuesday and passed a number of resolutions after much discussion. The meeting was also in commemoration of the seventh anniversary of the founding of the union.

Boycott Urged
It was decided that representatives be sent to console the strikers injured in the fray of Monday, that delegates be detailed to report the recent events of the strike to the Chinese authorities, that pamphlets reproducing descriptions of the B.C.C. products be prepared for distribution to the public in order that the products may be boycotted, and that local cigarette shops be urged to boycott the B.C.C. products.
At 3 o'clock on Tuesday afternoon posters bearing slogans were found posted in the vicinity of the factory premises. The slogans urged that June 5 be the "memorial day for the emancipation of the B.C.C. workers."
Unrest is said to exist among the workers of the Loong Tsang paper mill, Lunghwa Road, Nantao, who are opposing the announcement of the factory management that no regulations are to be enforced. The new rules became effective on June 1 and the workers claim that they are unreasonable. They have solicited assistance from the Kuomintang and the Social Bureau in the affair.

Ex-Workers Injured
About 15 ex-workers of the Dah Chung rubber factory, 53 Singapore Road, appeared that the factory gates at 10 a.m. on Tuesday and attempted to force their way past the gates with a view to resuming work. They were prevented from entering by the watchman, however. Later in the day five of the former workers, claiming to have been injured by the watchman, appealed to the General Labour Union for assistance in demanding medical expenses, and then went to the Shanghai District Court, Nantao, to have their injuries examined and certified by the authorities.
Seven committee members of the 1st district Carpenters and Masons Union held a meeting on Tuesday night and decided to send a letter to the Association of Building Contractors urging it to give an immediate reply to the demands of workers for a supply of food to be issued while on the job.
The preparatory committee of the Shanghai Barber Shop Owners Association has decided to hold an inaugural meeting which will take place to-morrow at Barbers Guild, Zia Jao Nan Loong, West Gate. Executive and supervisory committees are to be chosen and important matters will be discussed.

8572
《字林西报》，1934年6月7日，星期四

警方对英美烟草公司罢工者采取行动

在英美烟草公司码头附近突袭舢板，两名纠察队员被捕；其他人跳水逃生；搜寻新工人

昨天是罢工的第18天，警方首次对英美烟草公司（B.C.C.）的罢工者采取行动，他们在英美烟草公司（B.A.T.）码头附近突袭了一艘舢板，逮捕了两名纠察队员。另外两人通过跳入水中游走而逃脱。
这次突袭是由水上警察在清晨执行的，这些人措手不及。据称，他们是该组织的领导人，该组织正试图阻止新工人被送往受影响的工厂。
据昨晚的中文报道，由于工厂闲置对机器造成的影响，局势日益严重，该公司正试图从城市失业人员中招募新工人。
其他报道称，罢工者维持着一支400多人的队伍，目的是防止新劳工被带入工厂。

工人请求援助
一个由六名英美烟草公司罢工工人组成的代表团昨天访问了上海市政府办公室，再次请求提供援助。
与此同时，600名罢工者驻扎在英美烟草公司浦东第二工厂附近，作为防范雇佣破坏罢工者的警卫。
由实业部派来调查劳资纠纷的中央当局代表唐剑飞（Tang Chien-fee，音译）先生结束了调查，于周二晚上返回南京汇报。
浦东第五区卷烟业工会的七十名成员于周二下午2点举行会议，经过长时间讨论后通过了一系列决议。此次会议也是为了纪念该工会成立七周年。

呼吁抵制
会议决定派遣代表慰问在周一冲突中受伤的罢工者，指派代表向中国政府报告最近的罢工事件，印制描述英美烟草公司产品的传单并向公众分发，以便抵制其产品，并敦促当地香烟店抵制英美烟草公司的产品。
周二下午3点，有人发现工厂附近张贴了带有标语的海报。标语呼吁将6月5日定为“英美烟草公司工人解放纪念日”。
据说，位于南市龙华路的龙昌造纸厂工人中存在不安情绪，他们反对厂方宣布不执行规章制度的公告。新规定于6月1日生效，工人们声称这些规定不合理。他们就此事向国民党和社会局寻求援助。

前工人受伤
周二上午10点左右，约15名前大中华橡胶厂（地址：新加坡路53号）工人出现在工厂门口，试图强行进入以恢复工作。然而，他们被看守阻止。当天晚些时候，五名前工人声称被看守打伤，向上海总工会求助，要求支付医疗费用，随后前往南市上海地方法院，由当局检查并认证其伤势。
第一区木匠泥瓦匠工会的七名委员于周二晚上举行会议，决定致函建筑承包商协会，敦促其立即答复工人关于在工作期间供应食物的要求。
上海理发店业主协会筹备委员会决定举行成立大会，将于明天在西门外霞乔南弄（Zia Jao Nan Loong，音译）理发公会举行。将选举执行委员会和监督委员会，并讨论重要事项。

THE CHINA PRESS, MONDAY, MAY 28, 1934

Chiang Orders
Cessation Of
B. C. C. Strike

The strike by workers of the British Cigarette Company must be ended before May 30, General Chiang Kai-shek, chairman of the Military Affairs Commission, advises in a telegram sent to the City Government of Greater Shanghai, it was learned from reliable sources yesterday.

The telegram from General Chiang was forwarded to the attention of the Bureau of Social Affairs which, in turn sent a communique to the Fifth District Tobacco Workers Trade Union calling for a conference of representatives of workers and the management of the B.C.C. to be held tomorrow morning while final efforts will be made for a settlement of the strike.

The strike was declared by workers of the B.C.C. several days ago in protest against the closing of the No. 1 Pootung factory by the management on the ground of alleged insubordination of the workers. The strikers are demanding the reopening of the old Pootung mill.

《大美晚报》，1934年5月28日，星期一

蒋介石命令
停止
英美烟草公司罢工

据可靠消息来源昨日获悉，军事委员会委员长蒋介石将军在向大上海市政府发送的电报中指出，英美烟草公司工人的罢工必须在5月30日前结束。

蒋介石将军的电报已转交社会局注意，社会局随即向第五区烟草业工会发出公函，要求工人代表与英美烟草公司管理层于明早举行会议，同时为解决罢工做出最后努力。

几天前，英美烟草公司工人宣布罢工，抗议管理层以工人 alleged insubordination（原文如此，意为涉嫌不服从管理）为由关闭浦东第一工厂。罢工者要求重新开放旧的浦东工厂。

REPORT
Date. September 4th 1939.

Subject (in full) Unrest amongst workers of Yee Tsoong Tobacco Factory,
733 Ward Road - subsides.

Made by D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken Forwarded by C. Crawford. J. I.

FILE

S.O. 'D'
Julin Rd

The labour unrest which hitherto existed
among the thirty two workers of the Packing Department
of the Yee Tsoong Tobacco Factory, 733 Ward Road, has
subsided. The workers who operate under a contractor
named Zung Zang-sung (陳長生) demanded the issue of a
monthly rice allowance of $7.50. The dispute has now
been settled, whereby with effect from August 18, the
workers will be paid by the contractor at the rate of
$0.02 instead of $0.01 for each box nailed, while the
management of the Yee Tsoong Factory will issue an
allowance equivalent to 30% of their monthly pay should
the amount reach the sum of $10.00.

With effect from August 15, the Yee Tsoong
Factory is operating three days a week, i.e. from
Monday to Wednesday, due to business depression. The
concern employs a complement of 1,600 hands.

Kao Yen-ken
D. S. I.

A. C. (Special Branch).

日期：1939年9月4日。

主题（全称）华德路733号颐中烟草厂工人骚动 - 已平息。

由特别处督察高恩肯（Kao Yen-ken，音译）撰写，由C. Crawford警司转发。J. I.

存档

S.O. 'D'
榆林路

此前存在于华德路733号颐中烟草厂包装部三十二名工人中的劳资骚动已平息。在一名名为陈长生（Zung Zang-sung）的包工头手下工作的工人要求每月发放7.50美元的米贴。争议现已解决，据此，自8月18日起，包工头将以每钉一个箱子0.02美元而非0.01美元的费率支付给工人，同时，如果金额达到10.00美元，颐中工厂管理层将发放相当于其月薪30%的津贴。

由于商业萧条，自8月15日起，颐中工厂每周运营三天，即周一至周三。该企业雇用员工1,600人。

Subject Tsing Zung Health Promotion Society - meeting.
Made by D.S. McKeown Forwarded by C. Crawford D.S.

Twenty members of the Tsing Zung Health Promotion
Society held a meeting (postponed from July 3) in their office,
Lane 575, 4 Thorburn Road, between 5.10 p.m. and 6 p.m. July 10.
Tsiang Tsoong-heng (蒋中衡), an employee of the Tin Foil

Factory, presided and the following resolutions were passed:-

for the establishment of a school to be known as the "Tsing

form into booklet form, with effect from this month.

Society, commencing from August 1, for the convenience of
the members.

在由陈锦堂先生主持的活动期间，总工会代理主席周学相先生和据称为杨树浦路怡和蛋厂领班的白玉山先生发表了讲话。

Date October 23, 1936.

Subject Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company - Thorburn Road Factory.

Made by D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by [Signature]

At 9 a.m. October 22, the management of the Thorburn
Road Factory of the Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company, 674 Thorburn
Road, informed the foremen of the various departments of the
factory that in future workers were not to be allowed to
engage in money transactions within the factory premises,
including passing money between each other arising from
borrowing or refunding. The management further stated that
workers found doing so would be treated as defaulters.

At 8 p.m. the same day, the foremen of the various
departments of the factory held a meeting in the preparatory
office of their society, namely the Tsing Zung Health Promotion
Society (精誠健康社), 10 Tung Ming Li, Si Yao Ka Jao, off
Thorburn Road, O.O.L. and discussed these instructions
without reaching a decision.

Following a discussion on the removal of their office,
it was decided to remove to No.109 Yu Pang Li (友邦里), Ward
Road. The meeting which terminated at about 9 p.m. was
attended by some 80 persons, including the following :-
Tsiang Chung-ju (蔣宗衢), Packing Department.
Chow Yuin-zung (周云程), Box Making Department.
Chang Ching-yien (張清賢), Tin Department.
Au Pah-ling (夏柏林), Leaf Department.

The Tsing Zung Health Promotion Society, which was
formed at the beginning of the month by the workers of the
Thorburn Road Factory, claims to have a membership of some
500 persons.

Copy, own K. D.O. D. Sih Tse Liang

D.C. (Special Branch).

呈报人：督察员 薛子良（Sih Tse-liang） 转呈人：[签名]

10月22日上午9时，位于韬朋路674号的颐中烟草公司韬朋路工厂管理层通知该厂各部门领班，今后不得允许工人在厂区范围内进行金钱交易，包括因借贷或退款而在工人之间传递钱款。管理层进一步声明，发现此类行为的工人将被视为违约者。

同日晚上8时，该厂各部门领班在其社团即“精诚健康社”的筹备办公室举行会议，地址为老闸捕房辖区韬朋路旁四药卡桥（Si Yao Ka Jao）东明里10号，会上讨论了上述指示，但未达成决定。

经讨论搬迁其办事处事宜后，决定迁至华德路友邦里109号。会议于晚上9时许结束，约有80人出席，其中包括以下人员：
蒋宗衢（Tsiang Chung-ju），包装部。
周云程（Chow Yuin-zung），制盒部。
张清贤（Chang Ching-yien），锡箔部。
夏柏林（Au Pah-ling），烟叶部。

精诚健康社由韬朋路工厂工人于本月初组建，声称拥有会员约500人。

Subject Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company - Unrest among workers of the

Made by D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by [签名] A.S.

Unrest is revived among the workers of the Thorburn
Road Factory of the Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company, 674 Thorburn
Road, who are dissatisfied with the refusal of the Management
to grant a loan of about $15 to each worker on the pay day,
September 15. A rumour is current to the effect that the workers
will declare a strike in order to enforce their demand.
At 11 a.m. September 10, thirty representatives of
workers of various departments of the factory called on the
management and requested that a loan of a sum equivalent to
a half month wages be granted to them on pay day (September 15)
in order to enable them to meet their daily expenses. At
1 p.m. the same day the management informed the workers that
a loan of $4 each would be granted. This concession was
rejected by the majority of workers who accused eight of their
number of being responsible for this alleged unfavourable
treatment. These eight workers were responsible for
persuading the workers to call off the strike.
At 9 a.m. the following men
Han Sz-tso (韓帥初 ) No.141 Leaf Department
Wong Sao-tah(亞少達 ) No.35 " "

Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company - Unrest among workers of the
Thorburn Road Factory.

Unrest is revived among the workers of the Thorburn
Road Factory of the Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company, 674 Thorburn
Road, who are dissatisfied with the refusal of the Management
to grant a loan of about $15 to each worker on the pay day,
September 15. A rumour is current to the effect that the workers

workers of various departments of the factory called on the

a loan of $4 each would be granted. This concession was
rejected by the majority of workers who accused eight of their
number of being responsible for this alleged unfavourable
treatment. These eight workers were responsible for
persuading the workers to call off the strike.

Translation of/handbill entitled "A letter to the
labourers from the Strike Committee of the Yee
Tsoong Company, 3rd Factory."
.......

Dear Labour Friends,

We have declared a "tai-kung" strike in
order to support a female worker named Ah Ng (阿女)
who was dismissed without reason by the foreign manager,
and as a protest against the Chinese Factory Superintendent,
Wei Tse-zeu, who insulted workers. We appointed
representatives to submit a demand to the management for
the dismissal of Wei Tse-zeu, but the management refused
to interview our delegates. The factory was closed, and
the assistance of the police was obtained by the management.
In addition, the management has issued a notice instructing
all workers to resume work within a certain period, and
refusing to conduct negotiations with the workers. The
management has ignored the 2,600 workers. It is obvious
that the management is of the opinion that the workers are
not able to continue with the strike. However, we are
determined to unite and persist in the struggle. All workers
know that since the services of Wei Tse-zeu were engaged,
more than 400 workers with many years of service have been
dismissed. He used to reject the applications of workers
for leave of absence in order to show himself to be a
faithful "running dog." We have discovered the malpractices
of Wei Tse-zeu, and have requested assistance from the
Chinese authorities. The management, however, refused to
receive the representatives of the Chinese Authorities,
and ignored the instructions of our Government.
Consequently we are determined not to be fooled by the
management but to continue our struggle till we obtain
our demands.
pages.zh:
a
题为《颐中公司第三工厂罢工委员会致劳工书》的传单译文
.......

亲爱的劳工朋友们，

我们宣布“怠工”罢工，以支持被外籍经理无故解雇的女工阿女（Ah Ng），并抗议侮辱工人的华籍厂长魏子舟（Wei Tse-zeu）。我们指派代表向管理层提交要求，要求解雇魏子舟，但管理层拒绝接见我们的代表。工厂被关闭，管理层还寻求了警方的协助。此外，管理层发布通知，指令所有工人在规定期限内复工，并拒绝与工人进行谈判。管理层无视2600名工人。显然，管理层认为工人无法继续罢工。然而，我们决心团结起来，坚持斗争。所有工人都知道，自从雇用魏子舟以来，已有400多名拥有多年工龄的工人被解雇。他过去常常拒绝工人的请假申请，以显示自己是一条忠实的“走狗”。我们发现了魏子舟的舞弊行为，并请求中国当局协助。然而，管理层拒绝接待中国当局的代表，并无视我们政府的指示。因此，我们决心不被管理层愚弄，而是继续斗争，直到实现我们的要求。

pages.en:
- 2 -

Our slogans are as follows :-

1. Let us welcome the Chinese Authorities to
   relieve our sufferings.
2. Welcome support from the public.
3. Support General Chiang Kai Shek.
4. Down with the traitor Wei Tse-zeu;
   Let us unite and observe peace and order.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

我们的口号如下：-

1. 欢迎中国当局来解除我们的痛苦。
2. 欢迎公众的支持。
3. 拥护蒋介石将军。
4. 打倒汉奸魏泽（Wei Tse-zeu，音译）；
   让我们团结起来，维护和平与秩序。

Subject Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company - Strike situation in the
Thorburn Road Factory
Made by D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by [签名]

It is learned that the minority of the strikers of
the Thorburn Road Factory of the Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company
have expressed the intention of resuming work unconditionally
on the morning September 7, 1936. Upon receiving this
information, agitators among the strikers including Yang
An-tai (楊安泰) and Liu Ching-piau (劉金標) decided
to picket the vicinity of the Factory in the early morning
of September 7 in order to intimidate any worker who attempts
to resume.

The employees of the Thorburn Road Factory will hold
a meeting in the Yee Tsoong Company Employees' Doong Loh Club,
Lane 498, No.142 Ward Road, at 2 p.m. to-day, September 6, for
the purpose of discussing measures to be taken in connection
with the present strike.

An office was established by the workers on
September 5 at No.10 Tung Ling Li, Si Yao Ka Jao (西姚家橋),
off Thorburn Road, O.O.L. Yang An-tai and Liu Ching-piau,
two of the workers on strike are the promoters of this office.
Arrangements are being made by these two promoters to register
the strikers. It is reported that the expenses for the office
are borne by Tseu Hsueh-hsiang (周學湘), a committee member
of the General Labour Union and concurrently of the 4th
District Cigarette Workers' Union, Lane 376, No.42 Wayside Road.

制作人 侦探督察 Sih Tse-liang（音译） 转呈人 [签名]

据悉，颐中烟草公司韬朋路工厂的少数罢工者表示有意于1936年9月7日上午无条件复工。收到此消息后，罢工者中的煽动者，包括楊安泰和劉金標，决定在9月7日凌晨对工厂附近进行纠察，以恐吓任何试图复工的工人。

韬朋路工厂的员工将于今天，即9月6日下午2时，在华德路142号498弄的颐中公司职员同乐会举行会议，目的是讨论与当前罢工有关的应对措施。

工人们于9月5日在西姚家橋（Si Yao Ka Jao，音译），韬朋路旁，东灵里10号设立了一个办事处。罷工工人中的楊安泰和劉金標是该办事处的发起人。这两名发起人正在安排登记罢工者。据报道，办事处的费用由总工会委员兼第四区卷烟业工会委员周學湘承担，其地址为韦思德路42号376弄。

Subject Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company Employees' Nyi Yui

Made by D.I. Sih Tse-li-ng Forwarded by [Signature]

The employees of the Thorburn Road Factory of the
Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company organized on September 3, 1936,
a club entitled "Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company Employees' Nyih
Yui Doong Loh (Mutual Happiness after Office Hours) Club,"
with an office at Lane 498 (Zung Jhing Fang仁慶坊 ),
No.142 Ward Road. The objects of this club are stated to
be as follows :-
1. To promote co-operation among the employees.
2. To provide amusements for the employees when off duty.
3. To demand improvement in treatment when the management
acts in violation of the factory regulations.
4. To co-operate with the management in order to improve
the business of the factory, as well as to safeguard
employment.

The principal promoter of this club is Chen Yung-
foh (陳永福 ), a shroff of the Tin Foil Department of the
Thorburn Road Factory.

At 2 p.m. September 3, 1936, some thirty of the
strikers held a meeting in the office and distributed copies
of a manifesto, membership registration forms and regulations
of the club among the attendance (a sample of each is
attached to this report with translation). It was decided
to collect 50 cents from each member as contributions to
the fund raised for the establishment of this club.

The workers of the factory, now on strike, are
also arranging to form a union and a preparatory office has
been established in the house of one of the strikers named
Zing Hwai-yeu (秦懷有 ), at Lane 640, No.45 Ward Road.

Translation of a manifesto issued by the Yee Tsoong Tobacco
Company Employees' Nyih Yu Doong Loh Club

We have several times attempted to form an Employees'
Club, but our efforts have been fruitless owing to dissension
among the colleagues. In the factory there are altogether
eighty employees who are usually unable to meet together.
With a view to promoting friendship among the employees, we
decided to concentrate our energy to organize a strong body
in order to protect ourselves against unreasonable treatment
by the management. The foreigners treated us as weak people
and compelled us to do coolie work. A few employees
surrendered under the pressure of the management. It is due
to lack of organization that we suffered such oppression.
The management gave us no protection for employment. Recently,
the management announced that no wages would be granted to
the employees for the period of the workers' strike, and
those who continued to work during this period would be paid
according to the number of days and hours. The employees
live on their wages and how can we sustain the losses.

If we do not take suitable action against such
oppression, our fate shall be unspeakable. Now we have
but one mind, that is to struggle for our demand with united
strength. Should our efforts produce no result, we will
endeavour to reach our aim through legal channels. We
will persist in the struggle till we succeed.

Educated employees should not hesitate any further,
but rise up and protect our own benefits.

Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company
Employees' Doong Club.
1/9/36
pages.zh:
颐中烟草公司职员业余同乐会发布的宣言译文

我们曾多次尝试组建员工俱乐部，但由于同事间的分歧，努力均未成功。工厂共有八十名员工，通常无法聚在一起。为了促进员工之间的友谊，我们决定集中精力组织一个强有力的团体，以保护我们自己免受管理层的不合理对待。外国人视我们为弱者，强迫我们做苦力工作。少数员工在管理层的压力下屈服了。正是由于缺乏组织，我们才遭受这样的压迫。管理层没有为我们提供就业保障。最近，管理层宣布，在工人罢工期间不向员工发放工资，在此期间继续工作的人将按天数和小时数支付工资。员工靠工资生活，我们如何能承受这些损失。

如果我们不对这种压迫采取适当的行动，我们的命运将不堪设想。现在我们只有一个心思，那就是团结一致，为我们的诉求而斗争。如果我们的努力没有结果，我们将努力通过法律途径达到我们的目的。我们将坚持斗争，直到成功。

受过教育的员工不应再犹豫，而应站起来保护我们自身的利益。

颐中烟草公司
职员同乐会。
1936年9月1日

REPORT
Date August 31st 1936.

Subject Present situation of strike at Yee Tsoong Tobacco Co.

Made by D.S.I. Cady. Forwarded by

Sir,
At 7.30 a.m. 31-8-36, some 2,000 strikers turned up for their pay at the Yee Tsoong Tobacco Factory, No. 674 Thorburn Road, and also submitted a number of demands to the management, (as contained in the extract from I.R. dated 31-8-36).
Consequently the management agreed to make certain concessions, and offered to pay a full day's wages provided all the workers returned to duty by 1 p.m. to-day (31-8-36).
This offer however, they turned down, and the strikers, after receiving their pay, quietly left the premises, without any untoward incident occurring.
In the early hours of the morning, a number of notices were found posted up outside the factory premises, the translation being as follows:-
(1) Down with Wei Tse Chi (Chinese superintendent).
(2) Down with workers betrayer, Wei Tsi Chi.
(3) Abolish all the new conditions rendered by the factory management.
(4) Welcome all the workers of the B.A.T. factories in China to uphold us by "Ta Kung".
(5) Reinstate the female worker, Ah Ng, unconditionally.
(6) Down with the running dog.
(7) Get rid of Wei Tsi Chi, who oppresses the workers.

（批：31/8/36 / 7/9/36 White）

S. D. i/c
D.D.O. "D"
O.C. Special Branch

先生，
1936年8月31日上午7时30分，约2,000名罢工者前往位于韬宾路674号的颐中烟草工厂领取工资，并向管理层提交了一系列要求（详见1936年8月31日情报报告摘录）。
因此，管理层同意做出某些让步，并提出如果所有工人在今天（1936年8月31日）下午1点前复工，将支付全天工资。
然而，罢工者拒绝了这一提议，在领取工资后安静地离开了厂区，未发生任何意外事件。
清晨时分，有人在工厂外围发现张贴了一些告示，译文如下：-
(1) 打倒魏子基（华籍总监）。
(2) 打倒出卖工人的魏子基。
(3) 废除工厂管理层提出的所有新条件。
(4) 欢迎中国英美烟公司各工厂的工人通过“大公”支持我们。
(5) 无条件复职女工阿二。
(6) 打倒走狗。
(7) 赶走压迫工人的魏子基。

（批：31/8/36 / 7/9/36 White）

颐中烟草公司韬宾路工厂工人的“怠工”罢工始于1936年8月18日，据对工人的谨慎询问，此次罢工起因于工厂总监魏子潜（Wei Tsz-tsien）的行为。
工人们表示，此人长期以来一直对他们施以残酷对待，例如拒绝批准休假，并将迟到者视为缺勤，从而极大地影响了相关人员年底加薪的机会。
对华籍总监的反对情绪在8月18日达到顶点，当时锡箔部一名名叫阿二（Ah-ng）的女工被外籍监工发现工作疏忽。她被带到外籍经理面前，经理决定将其解雇。然而，在其他几名工人的请求下，解雇令被撤销，并同意对她处以停职两周的惩罚。此事本以为已解决，直到当天下午1时50分，工厂总监魏子潜来到锡箔部，宣布他不同意撤销对阿二的解雇，必须将其解雇，随即所有工人请求他从宽处理。他予以拒绝，声称他不仅有权解雇一名工人，而且有权解雇数百名工人，并且对他来说，招募数百名新工人比招募数百条狗更容易。这番言论激怒了工人，他们随即

stated that the rule of the factory requiring workers to
apply to the Chinese superintendent first for leave of

situation, workers be permitted to apply to the foreign
staff for leave of absence, should the Chinese superintendent
reject their applications.
Still dissatisfied with this concession, all workers
left the factory at 3.30 p.m. August 19.
At 7 a.m. August 20, all workers with the exception
of some 400 female workers turned up at the factory and
at 9 a.m. workers delegates submitted the following demands
to the management :-
1. That in future all workers be not subject to the Chinese
Factory Superintendent's control.
2. That wages be issued for the period of the "tai-kung"
strike.
The foreign manager rejected both demands, whereupon
the workers declared that they would suspend work for three
days to consider the matter. Subsequently all workers left
the factory.
On leaving the factory, eight representatives of

Pao Hwa Silk Weaving Factory - reduction in working hours
Owing to trade depression, night operations in the
Pao Hwa Silk Weaving Factory, 73 South Chao Ka Zah,
Edinburgh Road, O.C.I., were suspended on May 23, The
workers, numbering 220, have been divided into two shifts
working alternately every two days.

Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company - Pootung Factory to discharge
workers
Owing to the introduction of packing machines in the
Packing Department of the Pootung Factory of the Yee Tsoong
Tobacco Company, Loh Ka Zah, Pootung, approximately 30% of
the 1,200 female workers in this Department will be discharged
gradually in small groups. About 20 workers were discharged
at the end of last week. Each of the dismissed hands
received a retiring gratuity equivalent to 20 days' wages
($0.55 per day) for each year of service.

Nyi Yuan Rubber Factory - dispute between ex-workers and
management settled
The dispute between the ex-workers and the management
of the Nyi Yuan Rubber Factory, 920 Tongshan Road, over the
closing down of the concern (Vide I.R.2/5/36) has been
settled. It was agreed that a food allowance of $3.00 per
month be issued to each ex-worker for the period of suspension.

Made by D.P.S. Mackey Forwarded by [Signature]

Dissatisfaction was recently expressed by the 5th
District Cigarette Workers' Union, Pootung, with the management
of the Primary School for the children of workers of the Yee
Tsoong Cigarette Company (Pootung Branch), 75 Lan Nyi Doo Road,
Pootung. As a result the board of directors of the school,
in the presence of a representative of the Bureau of Education,
held a meeting in the afternoon of February 4 in the office of
the Union, 78 Lan Nyi Doo Road, Pootung, for the purpose of
discussing possible improvements. It was decided to dismiss
the headmaster, to examine the statement of accounts of the
school, and to increase the number of students from 600 to 900.
During the meeting, Sung Tseng-chen (孫震春) was
appointed chairman of the board of directors vice Tsang Tan-pah
(張載伯) retired.

The 5th District Cigarette Workers' Union, Pootung,
has recently expressed dissatisfaction at the management of
the Primary School established for the children of workers
of the Yee Tsoong Cigarette Company (Pootung Branch), 75 Lan
Nyi Doo Road, Pootung, and has decided to petition the local
Bureau of Education to convene a meeting of the board of
directors. As a result the school, although due to re-open
for the spring term on February 1, remains closed.

This school receives a monthly grant of $1,000 from
the Yee Tsoong Cigarette Company, and has an attendance of
600 students. It is managed by a board of fifteen directors,
of whom Tsang Tan-pah (張載伯) is the chairman, who were
appointed by the Company, the 5th District Cigarette Workers'
Union and the Bureau of Education.

-5-

International Savings Society - pays off 42 Chinese
employees

Owing to business depression, the International Savings
Society, 9 Avenue Edward VII, has paid off forty-two of
its Chinese employees.

China Soap Company - workers dismissed

Thirty-three out of 278 workers of the China Soap
Company, 2310 Yangtszepoo Road(Yangtszepoo District), were
dismissed on December 7, owing to business depression. All
the dismissed hands were paid retiring gratuities in
addition to the wages due to them.

Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company - increase of working hours
in Pootung Factory

Commencing from to-day, December 9, the Pootung Factory
of the Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company, which has been operating
ten hours per day since October 7, 1935, will increase
the working period to eleven hours a day. The Printing
Works, Designing Room and the Tin Foil Department will
continue to operate ten hours a day. 3,000 workers will
benefit by the increased working period.

Miscellaneous

Rent Reduction Movement - property owner loses Court action
against tenants

The prosecution instituted in the First Special District
Court by the landlord of houses in the Yu Ching Li (□□□)
Robison Road, against his tenants for non-payment of rent,
was concluded on December 4 when the Court ordered the
plaintiff to reduce the rents from $24 to $21.40 retroactive
from October 1, 1935.

陈北德（Chen Bei-teh，音译），镇江人，在大约七年前加入浦东英美烟公司（Pootung B.C.C.）之前，只是麦肯齐码头（Mackenzie Wharf）的一名苦力。自1927年浦东英美烟公司工人工会（现称第五区卷烟厂工人工会）改组以来，他一直在委员会中占据一席，并凭借这一职务，使自己在当地工会的政治和劳工运动中从默默无闻变得引人注目。作为第五区卷烟厂工人工会的代表，他在总工会委员会中任职，但由于职权问题，他与总工会委员朱学范发生了分歧。

回想起来，此前在该工会办公室举行的委员会重选被国民党宣布为非法（参见附上的1934年11月3日情报报告摘录）。在这次选举中，陈及其支持者取得了压倒性的胜利。

Extract from Intelligence Report dated November 3, 1934.
----------
5th District Cigarette Factory Workers' Union - election
of new committees declared illegal by Tangpu

On November 2, the 5th District Cigarette Factory
Workers' Union received an order from the local Kuomintang
stating that the election of the new Committees for the
Union which took place on October 28 was illegal and con-
sequently the affairs of the Union were to be managed by the
old committee pending a re-election.

This action on the part of the local Tangpu is the
outcome of the re-election of Chen Bei-teh who with his
followers, all natives of Kiangpeh, have monopolized the
Union for the past few years. Recently Chen with other
elements have been attempting to overthrow the General
Labour Union and undermine the authority of the Tangpu
and to counteract this the latter enlisted the support of
Lur Ching Kwan who heads an opposition clique of Shaoshing
men in the 5th District Cigarette Factory Workers' Union.
Lur and his followers were to oust Chen and his clique from
power in the Union. They not only failed in the election,
however, but Lur lost his old seat on the Standing Committee.
pages.zh:
1934年11月3日情报报告摘录。
----------
第五区卷烟厂工人工会 - 新委员会选举被汤浦（Tangpu，音译，指国民党党部）宣布为非法

11月2日，第五区卷烟厂工人工会收到当地国民党的一道命令，称10月28日举行的工会新委员会选举是非法的，因此，在重新选举之前，工会事务由旧委员会管理。

当地汤浦（Tangpu，音译）的这一行动是陈北德（Chen Bei-teh，音译）再次当选的结果；陈与其追随者均为江北人，过去几年一直垄断着该工会。最近，陈与其他势力一直试图推翻总工会，削弱汤浦（Tangpu，音译）的权威；为了对此进行反击，后者争取到了陆敬观（Lur Ching Kwan，音译）的支持，陆是第五区卷烟厂工人工会中一个绍兴人反对派系的首领。陆及其追随者本应将陈及其派系从工会权力中驱逐出去。然而，他们不仅在选举中失败，陆还失去了他在常务委员会中的原有席位。

Communist Propaganda - Prosecution
The case against a communist suspect named Li Yih Ping
(李一平) who was arrested on November 17, 1934, on Muirhead Road
(vide I.R. 20.11.34) was concluded in the Second Branch Kiangsu
High Court on November 26 when he was ordered to be extradited
to the Chinese Authorities.
----------
Pro-Communist Propaganda
Copies of a leaflet entitled "Letter to B.A.T.Workers in
the Eastern District," purporting to have emanated from the
Strike Committee of the Shanghai Eastern District British American
Tobacco Company No.3" were found by the Municipal Police on
November 22, 1934, on a piece of vacant ground near the Yee Tsoong
Tobacco Company, Thorburn Road Factory.
Apart from denouncing the alleged oppression of the workers;
the handbill urges them to ignore the mediation of the Kuomintang
in connection with the recent labour dispute and to await the
directions of the 'Red' Union in furthering their struggle.
----------
811 log.
Passed as yn.

1934年11月22日，市警察在韬宾路（Thorburn Road）颐中烟草公司附近的一块空地上发现了题为《致东区英美烟公司工人的信》的传单副本，声称出自“上海东区英美烟三厂罢工委员会”。
除了谴责所谓的对工人的压迫外，该传单还敦促工人无视国民党在最近劳资纠纷中的调解，并等待“红色”工会的指示以推进他们的斗争。

Translation of a pamphlet entitled "A letter to
Workers of the B.A.T. in the Eastern District"
and found on a vacant piece of ground in the
vicinity of the Thorburn Road Factory on 22/11/34

Dear labour friends,

A labour dispute existed sometime ago as
a result of oppression by the imperialistic capitalists.
At first they increased our work and reduced our wages,
but later they changed to a three days' working system
thereby causing us to experience considerable financial
sufferings. We were, therefore, compelled to declare
a strike. The imperialistic capitalists eventually
accepted the workers' demands in view of the hard
struggle of the labour friends in the "Old" and "New"
Factories at Pootung, and consequently the workers
resumed operation by the order of the "Red" Union.
A strike was again declared recently arising out of
the White Russians insulting labourers. They usually
search workers when the latter are leaving the factory
in order to flatter the capitalists. This is really
an insult to the workers. A barbarous White Russian
watchman, under the influence of the capitalists,
recently kicked a worker in the Cigarette Making
Department. The labourer was so seriously injured that
he instantly lost consciousness. In protest against
the action on the part of the watchman, the workers
of the factory have decided to form a Strike Committee.
Our demands and resolutions should be as follows :-
1. That the capitalists dismiss the white Russian watchman.
2. That medical expenses be granted to the injured worker.
3. That wages be paid as usual for the period of the strike.
4. Oppose interference by the Kuomintang, the Bureau of
Social Affairs and the "Yellow" labour union.
5. Await patiently the directions of the "Red" Union
in carrying out the struggle.

Strike Committee of the Shanghai Eastern
District British American Tobacco Factory No.3

1934年11月22日在韬宾路（Thorburn Road）工厂附近一块空地上发现的题为《致东区英美烟公司工人的信》的传单译文

亲爱的劳工朋友们，

前段时间，由于帝国主义资本家的压迫，发生了一起劳资纠纷。起初他们增加我们的工作量并降低我们的工资，但后来改为三天工作制，导致我们遭受了相当大的经济困难。因此，我们被迫宣布罢工。鉴于浦东“老”厂和“新”厂的劳工朋友们的艰苦斗争，帝国主义资本家最终接受了工人的要求，因此工人们按照“红色”工会的命令恢复了工作。
最近，由于白俄侮辱劳工，再次宣布罢工。当工人离开工厂时，他们通常搜查工人以讨好资本家。这确实是对工人的侮辱。一名野蛮的白俄看守最近在资本家的影响下，踢了一名卷烟部的工人。该劳工受伤严重，立即失去知觉。为了抗议看守的行为，工厂工人决定成立一个罢工委员会。我们的要求和决议如下：-
1. 资本家解雇该名白俄看守。
2. 向受伤工人提供医疗费用。
3. 罢工期间照常支付工资。
4. 反对国民党、社会局和“黄色”工会的干涉。
5. 耐心等待“红色”工会在开展斗争方面的指示。

上海东区英美烟三厂罢工委员会

吉塘東埔寨選民上友書

親愛的女士們，先生們：今天我們在這裡隆重集會，慶祝柬埔寨王國獨立十週年。在這個喜慶的日子裡，我們向柬埔寨人民致以熱烈的祝賀和誠摯的問候。

十年前，柬埔寨人民在諾羅敦·西哈努克親王的領導下，經過長期艱苦的鬥爭，終於擺脫了法國殖民統治，贏得了國家的獨立。這是柬埔寨歷史上一個偉大的轉折點，也是亞洲民族解放運動的一個重要組成部分。

獨立以來，柬埔寨人民在西哈努克親王的領導下，堅持和平、中立和不結盟的外交政策，積極發展國民經濟，提高人民生活水平，為維護東南亞地區的和平與穩定作出了重要貢獻。

中國人民一貫支持柬埔寨人民的正義事業。我們認為，每個國家都有權選擇適合自己國情的社會制度和發展道路，任何外來干涉都是不能容忍的。我們堅決反對帝國主義和殖民主義對柬埔寨內政的干涉，堅決支持柬埔寨人民維護國家主權和領土完整的鬥爭。

當前，世界形勢正在發生深刻變化。亞非拉各國人民爭取民族獨立和解放的鬥爭正方興未艾。我們相信，在全世界愛好和平和正義的人民的共同努力下，帝國主義和殖民主義終將被徹底消滅，人類必將迎來一個更加美好的未來。

最後，我們祝願柬埔寨王國繁榮昌盛，祝願西哈努克親王健康長壽，祝願中柬兩國人民的友誼萬古長青！

中華人民共和國國務院總理 周恩來
一九六三年十一月九日

（一）尊重柬埔寨的主權和領土完整；
（二）支持柬埔寨的和平、中立和不結盟政策；
（三）加強中柬兩國的經濟合作和文化交流；
（四）反對任何外來勢力對柬埔寨內政的干涉；
（五）促進亞洲和世界的和平與穩定。

Subject (in full) Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company, Thorburn Road Factory
- strike settled

Made by and Forwarded by D.I. Grubb

The 350 workers in the Cigarette Making Department
of the Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company, Thorburn Road Factory,
who declared a strike on November 13 to enforce a demand for
the reinstatement of a dismissed hand, resumed without
exception this morning, November 21. Following the
resumption of forty of their number at 7 a.m. November 20,
a further 160 reported for work the same afternoon. The
majority of the workers in other departments have also
resumed.

In connection with the strike two of the principal
agitators were dismissed and paid off by the management
on the morning of November 20. No concessions have been
granted to the strikers.

H. Grubb.
D. I.

Subject (in full) Yee Tscong Tobacco Company, Thorburn Road Factory
- Strike Situation

Made by and Forwarded by D.I. Grubb

Some forty out of the 350 strikers in the Cigarette
Making Department of the Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company, Thorburn
Road Factory, resumed work this morning, November 20, while
the remaining hands continue on strike. In addition, some
twenty workers in the Leaf Department and 100 miscellaneous
workers are operating at present.

At 8 p.m. November 19, two representatives of the
strikers called upon Tseu Hsueh-hsiang, committee member of
the 4th District Cigarette Workers' Union, at his home and
requested him to endeavour to seek a solution of the existing
dispute. Tseu promised to solicit the assistance of Tu Yueh
Sung, through Loh Ching-dz, on their behalf.

（批：Information known to Yulin Rd J.R.）

D. I. Grubb

Subject (in full) Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company, Thorburn Road Factory
- Strike situation

Made by and Forwarded by D.I. Grubb

The strike of the 350 workers in the Cigarette
Making Department of the Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company, Thorburn
Road Factory, continues this morning, November 16. These
strikers turned up at 7.15 a.m. but left at about 8 a.m.
November 16. As a result some 2,300 workers in other
departments have been rendered idle, with the exception of
some 100 miscellaneous employees.

On the morning of November 15, two representatives
of the strikers appealed to the local Kuomintang Headquarters
for assistance in bringing about a settlement of the dispute
existing in the factory. They were promised that investigation
would be made into the matter.

At 1.30 p.m. November 15, a delegate of the Bureau of
Social Affairs called at the factory with a view to conducting
mediation, but was refused an interview by the Management.

REPORT
Date November 15, 1934.

Subject (in full) Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company, Thorburn Road Factory
- Strike situation

Made by and Forwarded by D.I. Grubb

The "tai-kung" strike of the 350 workers in
Cigarette Making Department of the Yee Tsoong Tobacco
Company, Thorburn Road Factory, continues this morning,
November 15. As a result, the workers in other departments
have been rendered idle, with the exception of some 200
hands in the godown.

In view of the management rejecting their demands,
including the reinstatement of a dismissed worker, some ten
of the strikers, among whom were No.135, 250, 160 and 265,
held a meeting in the 4th District Cigarette Workers' Union,
Lane 376, No.42 Wayside Road, at 4 p.m. November 14. It was
decided that two delegates be detailed to appeal for mediation
to the local Tangpu and the Bureau of Social Affairs on the
morning of November 15. The strikers, with the assistance
of the 4th District Cigarette Workers' Union, are endeavouring
to solicit the assistance of Tu Yueh-sung through Loh Ching-dz,
a committee member of the local Kuomintang.

Some ten workers, representing their colleagues
in the Tin Foil Department, the Leaf Department, and the
Tin Department, requested the management this morning to
give them work. It is reported the strike of workers in
the Cigarette Making Department has aroused dissatisfaction
among the other operatives and that the strikers have secured
iron bars against possible conflict with their colleagues
in view of their discontent.

怡和烟草公司韬朋路工厂卷烟部350名工人的“怠工”罢工在今晨，即11月15日，仍在继续。结果，除仓库约200名工人外，其他部门的工人被迫停工。

the strikers from the Thorburn Road Factory of the B.A.T.

left Soochow Road, apparently in order to return to Thor-

Date November 13 1934

Subject (in full) Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company (B.C.C.) Thorburn Road Factory
- "tai-kung" strike in the Cigarette Making Department

Made by and Forwarded by D.I. Grubb

At 7 a.m. November 13, 1934, some 350 workers
employed in the Cigarette Making Department of the Yee Tsoong
Tobacco Company, Thorburn Road Factory, declared a "tai-kung"
strike. It is learned that a number of workers in this
department decided on November 12, to take this step with
a view to forcing the management to reinstate a dismissed
worker. The worker in question was dismissed following his
interference with a Russian watchman on November 9, when
searching employees leaving the factory.

The refusal of the 350 workers in the Cigarette
Making Department to resume work has affected about 700
others in the Leaf Department and it is expected all of
the employees, numbering some 2,700, will eventually be
affected should the strike continue. The 700 workers in
the Leaf Department have demanded full wages as it is
through no fault of theirs that they are rendered idle.

Senior Detective Yulin Road informed at 7.45 p.m.
November 12 of pending trouble.

（批：JL）

Date. November 14, 1934.
Subject (in full) Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company Thorburn Road Factory
- Strike continues
Made by and Forwarded by D.I. Grubb

The situation in the Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company,
Thorburn Road Factory, remains unchanged this morning,
November 14. The 350 workers employed in the Cigarette
Making Department, who declared a "tai-kung" strike at
7 a.m. November 13, 1934, turned up this morning but again
refused to work, while the 700 workers in the Leaf Department,
who were consequently rendered idle on November 13, did not
report for duty as there was no work for them to do in
consequence of the strike in the Making Department.

On November 13, some ten strikers, including workers
No.135, 160, 250 and 365, held a conference in the factory
and reached the following decisions :-
1. That the following demands be submitted :
(A) That the dismissed worker be reinstated.
(B) That foreigners (Russian watchmen) discontinue
acting in an insulting manner when engaged in
searching workers.
2. That work be not resumed until these demands are met.
3. That if the Management of the Factory refuses to accede
to the demands a delegation be appointed to proceed in
a body at 9 a.m. November 14 to the offices of the
Company, 6 Soochow Road.
So far the management have ignored their demands.
At 8.30 a.m. November 14 they left the factory
with the intention of proceeding to the offices of the
Company on Soochow Road, and by 11 a.m. some 100 of them
assembled in Soochow Road Gardens. Four delegates
interviewed the manager who advised them to return to
the factory where he would discuss the matter with them.

事由（全称） 怡和烟草公司韬朋路工厂 - 罢工持续
由 督察格鲁布（Grubb） 制作并呈报

今晨，即11月14日，怡和烟草公司韬朋路工厂的情况保持不变。1934年11月13日上午7时宣布“怠工”罢工的卷烟部350名工人今晨出现，但再次拒绝工作，而因此于11月13日被迫停工的烟叶部700名工人也未报到上班，因为由于制造部罢工，他们无工可做。

11月13日，包括编号135、160、250和365号工人在内的约十名罢工者在工厂内召开会议，并作出以下决定：-
1. 提出以下要求：
(A) 复职被解雇的工人。
(B) 外国人（俄国看守）在搜查工人时停止侮辱性行为。
2. 在这些要求得到满足之前不恢复工作。
3. 如果工厂管理层拒绝答应要求，则任命一个代表团于11月14日上午9时集体前往苏州路6号的公司办事处。
到目前为止，管理层无视他们的要求。
11月14日上午8点30分，他们离开工厂，打算前往苏州路的公司办事处，到上午11点，其中约100人聚集在苏州路花园。四名代表会见了经理，经理建议他们返回工厂，他将在哪里与他们讨论此事。

Date Nov. 13, 1934.
Subject (in full) Labour trouble at B.C.C.
Made by D.S. Kourjansky. Forwarded by [Signature]
Sir:
At 7.a.m. 13-11-34, 350 male workers of the Making Department
of the B.C.C. factory, Thorburn Road, although they entered the
factory refused to resume work, the action of these employees caused
the suspension of operations in the departments owing to lack of
supplies.
From enquiries instituted it was learned that on 9-11-34, whilst
the workers were leaving the factory at 5.p.m., a Russian watchman
stopped and searched a man from the Making Dept., this man resisted
the search so the watchman began to take him into the Head Office.
Whilst on his way another employee named Yue Tseu Kung (袁瑞松),
from the same department came out of the crowd and began to assault
the watchman, both men were then taken to the office, where the
manager dismissed Yue Tseu Kung on the spot and gave the other man
a final warning.
During the weekend a number of employees in the Making Dept.,
called a meeting (in one of the employees' houses, address unknown),
when they decided that unless the management reinstated the dismissed
man, cancelled the final warning, and dismissed the Russian watchman
they would refuse to work.
During the day a deputation interviewed the manager, but he
would not entertain their demands.
The situation at 5.p.m. 13-11-34, was that all departments
other than the Making and Stemery Departments will not attend the
factory tomorrow, owing to the lack of supplies as above, /and if the Making Dept. refuse to resume operation
the factory will close until such times as the workers agree to
resume.
Police are in attendance outside the factory in case of
disorder.
I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

先生：
1934年11月13日上午7时，英商中国烟草公司（B.C.C.）韬朋路工厂制造部的350名男性工人虽然进入了工厂，但拒绝恢复工作，这些雇员的行为导致各部门因缺乏供应而暂停运作。
经查询获悉，1934年11月9日，当工人们于下午5点离开工厂时，一名俄国看守拦住并搜查了一名来自制造部的男子，该男子抗拒搜查，因此看守开始将他带往总办事处。在途中，另一名来自同一部门、名为袁瑞松（Yue Tseu Kung）的员工从人群中出来并开始袭击看守，两人随后被带到办公室，经理当场解雇了袁瑞松，并给予另一人最后警告。
周末期间，制造部的一些雇员召开了一次会议（在其中一名雇员的家中，地址不详），会上他们决定，除非管理层复职被解雇者，取消最后警告，并解雇该俄国看守，否则他们将拒绝工作。
白天，一个代表团会见了经理，但他不愿考虑他们的要求。
1934年11月13日下午5时的情况是，除制造部和梗片部外，所有部门明天都将不到工厂上班，原因是上述缺乏供应，/如果制造部拒绝恢复运作，工厂将关闭，直到工人同意复工为止。
警察在工厂外值守，以防发生骚乱。

Made by D.S.I. Moore Forwarded by A. Grubb A.J.

In consequence of the closing down of the B.C.C.
"Old" Factory, the Management of the B.C.C. opposed the
attendance of children of ex-workers of the factory in
question the B.C.C. school at Pootung, and in August reduced
the monthly allowance to the institution from $1,200.00 to
$750.00.

As a result of this decision, the members of the
Board of Directors of the school, including Chen Bei-teh
(陳培德), committee member of the 5th District Cigarette
Workers' Union and well known agitator, interviewed the
Managing-Director of the B.C.C. and requested that the
children of ex-employees of the "Old" Factory be allowed to
attend the school, and that the former monthly allowance of
$1,200 be carried on. In reply, the Managing-Director
promised to refer their request to the Board of Directors
of the Company.

Subject (in full) B.C.C. Factories - Situation

Made by and Forwarded by D.I. Grubb

With reference to report of August 21 stating that
the B.C.C. "New" Factory, Pootung, would operate three days
a week instead of four, this decision on the part of the
Management has been cancelled for the time being owing to
a slight improvement in business.

On August 21 the Management of the B.C.C. Factory,
Thorburn Road, issued a notice announcing the measures
regarding the distribution of wages when the working period
is further reduced. It emphasizes that a subsidy will be
granted to the operatives in view of the hardship they will
experience following the proposed further reduction in working
days. It is said that twenty days' pay a month will be issued
to those whose daily earnings range from 40 to 85 cents,
nineteen days' pay to those whose daily earnings vary between
85 to 90 cents, and eighteen days pay to those over 90 cents.
The notice, however, announces that the Company may abolish
the subsidy at its discretion, and that wages will be paid
in full when normal operations are resumed. These measures
have met with the approval of the workers.

As a result of the closing down of the "Old" Factory,
Pootung, sixteen Chinese police watchmen who formerly served
there will be dismissed at the end of August.

事由（全称） 英美烟公司工厂 - 情况

由 D.I. Grubb 撰写并转呈

参照8月21日关于浦东英美烟公司“新”工厂将从每周工作四天减为三天的报告，由于业务略有改善，管理层的这一决定暂时取消。

8月21日，韬朋路英美烟工厂管理层发布公告，宣布进一步缩短工作时间时的工资发放措施。公告强调，鉴于拟议的进一步减少工作日将使操作工面临困难，将向他们发放津贴。据悉，日收入在40至85分之间的工人将按每月二十天发放工资，日收入在85至90分之间的工人按十九天发放，日收入超过90分的工人按十八天发放。然而，公告宣布公司可自行决定取消津贴，并在恢复正常运营时全额支付工资。这些措施得到了工人的认可。

由于浦东“旧”工厂关闭，曾在那里服役的十六名华籍巡捕将于8月底被解雇。

档案
抄送 DOD

Subject (in full)....................................................B.C.C. Factories - Situation.

Made by....................................and...............................Forwarded by....................D.I. Grubb.

At 9.30 a.m. August 15, the Manager of the B.C.C.
"New" Factory, Pootung, summoned some forty foremen in various
departments to his office and informed them that owing to
business depression, the Company is arranging to further reduce
the working days. He added that as this would cause hardship
amongst the operatives they would be paid four days' wages a
week although the working period was less than this. In addition,
$2.00 food money would be issued to each of those whose earnings
are insufficient to maintain their families. In conclusion,
the Manager informed the foremen that an increase in wages will
be granted to the operatives when business conditions improve,
and instructed them to advise the workers to operate without
worry. The matter was conveyed to the workers who, it is
reported, expressed satisfaction with the attitude of the Manager.

A similar announcement was also made by the management
of the B.C.C. Thorburn Road Factory to its operatives, which
apparently met with the approval of the latter. Consequently
the unrest which existed among the workers against the announce-
ment of the management on August 13 to further reduce the working
period (Vide I.R. 14/8/34) has been removed.

These plants continue to operate four days a week
at present.

Subject (in full) B.C.C. Factories in Pootung - Situation

Made [ illegible ] and Forwarded by D.I. Grubb

In connection with the request of the British
Consul-General in the form of a letter recently despatched
to the City Government, asking the Authorities to check
the activities of the pickets formed by the strikers at
Pootung (Vide I.R. 21/6/34), instructions to this effect
have been given to the Bureaux of Public Safety and Social
Affairs. General Wen, Chief of the Bureau of Public Safety,
accordingly instructed the Officer i/c of the 3rd Division
to arrest Chen Bei-teh, Committee member of the 5th District
Cigarette Workers' Union, who is the ringleader of the
present dispute in the B.C.C. factories in Pootung. The
Divisional Officer, however, did not affect the arrest and
in an interview with the Mayor in the afternoon of June 22
stated that in his opinion, such a step would only cause
the workers to extend their agitation and consequently the
dispute would be prolonged. He suggested that as an
alternative Chen be warned that he will be held responsible
for preventing any illegal activities of the disaffected
hands. So far no further instructions to deal with the
dispute have been made by the Authorities.

On the morning of June 22, Tsu Kwei-ling, a mediator
of the Bureau of Social Affairs visited Chen Bei-teh and
Leu Ching-kwan (樓景觀) in the Workers' Union at Pootung
and informed them that they would be held responsible for inducing
the workers not to cause any trouble and warning the pickets
to refrain from carrying out activities to such an extent
as would be detrimental to the business of the Company.
All the committee members promised to comply with these

由督察长 Grubb 制作 [字迹不清] 并转发

鉴于英国驻沪总领事近期致函市政府，要求当局制止罢工者在浦东组织的纠察队活动（参见 1934年6月21日情报报告），公安局和社会局已接到相应指示。公安局长温将军随即指令第三分局负责人逮捕陈北德（Chen Bei-teh，音译），此人是浦东英美烟公司工厂当前纠纷的头目，也是第五区卷烟业工会委员。然而，该分局警官并未执行逮捕，并在6月22日下午会见市长时表示，他认为此举只会导致工人扩大煽动活动，从而延长纠纷。他建议作为替代方案，警告陈北德，他将因未能防止不满工人的任何非法活动而被追究责任。截至目前，当局尚未就处理该纠纷发出进一步指示。

6月22日上午，社会局调解员朱桂龄（Tsu Kwei-ling，音译）前往浦东工会拜访了陈北德和楼景观（Leu Ching-kwan），告知他们需对诱导工人不惹事负责，并警告纠察队不要进行损害公司业务的活动。所有委员均承诺遵守这些指示。据报道，社会局认为

Subject (in full) Communist propaganda bearing on the strike of B.A.T. workers.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by （签名）

Hereunder are brief translations of three communist
handbills bearing on the strike of the workers of the B.A.T.
Factory, which were obtained by Agents A-2148 and 3365 in
Western Chapei on June 14, 1934 :-

(1) Handbill entitled "Letter to the toiling masses in support
of the strike of B.A.T. workers," purporting to have emanated
from the Kiangsu Provincial Committee of the Chinese Communist
Party, exhorting the working classes to come forward and
render assistance to B.A.T. strikers and to oppose mediation
by the Social Bureau and Yellow Labour Unions in labour
disputes.

(2) Handbill entitled "Outline of the struggle of the strikers
of the B.A.T. Factory," dated June 3, 1934, which urges
the workers to declare a general strike, to oppose the closing
down of factories and to request the general public to
boycott B.A.T. cigarettes.

(3) Leaflet addressed to workers of the B.A.T. Factory urging
them to demand the following :-
a) That the old and new factories resume operations.
b) That an increase of 5 cents in wages be granted half
yearly.
c) That the transfer of work and reduction of wages be
opposed.

Kuh Pao hwa

Manifesto of the Provisional Kiangsu Provincial
Committee of the Chinese Communist Party in
connection with the lockout of workers by the
B.A.T. Management.

To the whole body of B.A.T. Workers,

British capitalists, assisted by their running-dogs
- the Kuomintang and Yellow Labour Unions - are intensifying
their oppression of workers for the purpose of relieving
their financial difficulties resultant from the world-wide
economic crisis.

Last year the British capitalists of the B.A.T.
factories declared through the Yellow Labour Union that
should the workers join the Yellow Labour Union there would
be no closure of factories. When the workers had joined
the Yellow Labour Union, the promise was not fulfilled and
the Old B.A.T. Factory was closed down. From this we
can see that the promise was not meant to be kept, but to
prevent the workers from organizing themselves into one
body and resisting oppression.

The British capitalists and the Yellow Labour Union
are further endeavouring to prevent the union of the workers
of the Old and New Factories so that they will □□ be able
to dismiss workers without meeting strong opposition. This
oppression is being intensified. The working hours of the
third factory have been reduced from eight to six and
working days have been reduced from six to four. Thus the
wages are reduced but the same amount of work remains to
be done. The capitalists are also dismissing workers
gradually and are employing labour traitors.

While the British capitalists are oppressing workers,
the British imperialists have occupied Pan Hoong and are
attacking Singkiang and Thibet. In addition, the Japanese
imperialists have occupied North China, the French imperialists
are invading Yunnan and Kwangsi, whilst the American
pages.zh:
1934年6月11日下午3时在华德路与韬朋路交界处的英美烟公司工厂外发现的共产主义传单摘要译文。

中国共产党江苏省临时委员会
关于英美烟公司管理层封锁工人的宣言。

致全体英美烟公司工人，

英国资本家在其走狗——国民党和黄色工会——的协助下，为了缓解世界经济危机导致的财务困难，正在加紧压迫工人。

去年，英美烟厂的英国资本家通过黄色工会宣称，如果工人加入黄色工会，工厂就不会关闭。当工人加入黄色工会后，承诺并未兑现，英美老厂被关闭。由此可见，该承诺并非打算履行，而是为了防止工人组织起来抵抗压迫。

英国资本家和黄色工会正进一步试图阻止老厂和新厂工人的联合，以便他们能够 □□ 在不遇到强烈反对的情况下解雇工人。这种压迫正在加剧。第三厂的工作时间已从八小时减少到六小时，工作日已从六天减少到四天。因此，工资减少了，但工作量保持不变。资本家还在逐步解雇工人，并雇佣工贼。

在英国资本家压迫工人的同时，英国帝国主义占领了潘洪（Pan Hoong，音译），并进攻新疆和西藏。此外，日本帝国主义占领了华北，法国帝国主义正在入侵云南和广西，而美国

pages.en:
-2-
imperialists are planning to occupy the Yangtsze Valley.
In a word, the various imperialists are endeavouring to
enslave the proletarian classes of China.
Therefore, we have to save ourselves by carrying
out desperate struggles against Fascists, the Kuomintang,
Yellow Labour Unions, and other reactionaries. We
must establish our own Soviet political rule. Let us
shout the following slogans:-
Oppose the closing down of factories!
Demand the payment of wages in arrears!
Demand the issue of allowances for the period of the lockout!
Oppose the reduction of working hours with the subsequent
reduction of wages!
Oppose the dismissal of workers without reasonable cause!
Overthrow Tu Yueh Sung who is the running dog of British
capitalists, and the Yellow Labour Union!

Provisional Kiangsu Provincial
Committee of Chinese Communist
Party. 4.6.34.

帝国主义正计划占领长江流域。总之，各帝国主义列强正企图奴役中国的无产阶级阶级。
因此，我们必须通过对法西斯分子、国民党、黄色工会和其他反动派进行殊死斗争来拯救自己。我们必须建立自己的苏维埃政治统治。让我们高呼以下口号：-
反对关闭工厂！
要求支付拖欠工资！
要求发放封锁期间的津贴！
反对因减少工时而随之降低工资！
反对无故解雇工人！
打倒作为英国资本家走狗的杜月笙和黄色工会！

中国共产党
江苏省临时
委员会。1934年6月4日。

親愛的工友們，你們知道嗎！著有卅餘年之悠久歷史的浦東老廠，現在本經我黨政機關核准

全國英美烟廠被壓迫的工友同胞們：英美烟公司，突於五月十二日，將上海浦東首創開設三十餘年之老廠，竟無故停閉矣
，三千餘工友，一朝生計同陷斷絕，全上海英美工友，凛「唇亡齒寒」之義抱「沉舟破釜」之心誓與帝國主義資本家作殊死之
一戰，因為一廠的停閉，不僅是局部問題，而是全國英美烟廠工友，整個的生死利害關係，停廠原因，既不是營業清淡，也
不是工友不受指揮，而是公司想解僱大批工作最久工資最大之工友，更圖賴却多數的撫金，我們已有事實証明，公司此種
計劃，現在能行于上海，將來不難行諸於全國，如果無論何處英美烟廠，儘可以自由行動，隨時隨地都可停廠，隨時隨地都
可解僱一批工資最大工作最久之工友，而僱用工資最低之工友，所以公司的一貫政策，倘不剷除，將來更相為用全國英美烟
工友，都要變成失業，看呀：一廠方停閉，別廠工人的儲蓄金，女工生產費，還有其他優待條件，都要取消了，資本家
白光閃閃的鋼刀，現在從一廠殺來，一步一步將來要殺遍全國，我們不要猶豫，我們不願旁觀我們「唇亡齒寒」之義我們抱
定「沉舟破釜」之心，一致團結，共同奮鬥，反對無故停廠的英美烟公司。

我們的口號是：
1. 全國英美烟廠工友一致團結起來
2. 反對公司無故停廠
3. 要求即日復工維持工人生活
4. 請求黨政緊急制裁公司非法行動
5. 請求各界主持正義
6. 嚴守工會紀律
7. 保守工友秩序
8. 嚴防反動份子乘機亂
9. 剷除工賊走狗
10. 中國國民黨萬歲

Subject (in full) Pootung Cigarette Workers' Union Committeemen
attempt to bring Thorburn Road Factory workers
out on strike - activities of Chen Bei-teh

Made by D.S. Mac Adie Forwarded by Whouman DSS.

At 8 p.m. May 30, Chen Bei-teh and Iur Ching-kwan
(樓景观), representing the 5th District Cigarette
Workers' Union entertained under the false name of Wong
Tien-foh (王天福) some 30 representatives of workers
of various departments of the B.C.C. Thorburn Road Factory
to dinner on the 2nd floor of the San Woo Restaurant,
Nos.13-17 Rue Palikao. Chen Bei-teh who presided, stated
that the Management of the B.C.C. Factories suddenly ceased
operation in the B.C.C. Pootung Old Factory on May 12 and as
a protest, workers of the B.C.C. Pootung New Factory had
walked out. He added that as the efforts of the Bureau of
Social Affairs to mediate had so far met with failure, the
only effective means to crown the movement with success was
to assemble workers of the same concern under one flag to
fight against the management to the bitter end. In conclusion
he expected that the comrades in the Thorburn Road Factory
would render assistance. The attendance intimated that as
this movement would affect all workers, they could not give
a reply at once and would hold a general meeting of workers'
representatives on Monday, June 4 to discuss the matter.

At 10.20 p.m. Chen Bei-teh and twelve leading
representatives of the attendance left the restaurant and
held a secret conference in Room 632 Tah Wu Hotel, No.5,
Lane 341 Avenue Edward VII when Chen stated it was imperative
for the workers of the Thorburn Road Factory to join the
strike. The attendance then asked whether the workers would
be certain of obtaining strike/relief, intimating that the strike
could never be successful without money. Chen promised to
give a reply on Sunday, June 3 on the question of relief money.

主题（全称） 浦东卷烟业工会委员企图煽动韬朋路工厂工人罢工——陈北德之活动

由 D.S. Mac Adie 撰写，由 Whouman 副警司转呈。

5月30日晚8时，陈北德与楼景观（Iur Ching-kwan），代表第五区卷烟业工会，假借王天福（Wong Tien-foh）之名，在百老汇路（Rue Palikao）13-17号三和酒楼二楼宴请英美烟公司（B.C.C.）韬朋路工厂各部门工人代表约30人。主持宴会的陈北德称，英美烟公司浦东老厂于5月12日突然停工，作为抗议，英美烟公司浦东新厂工人已举行罢工。他补充说，由于社会局的调解努力迄今未果，使运动取得成功的唯一有效手段是将同一公司的工人集结在同一旗帜下，与管理层斗争到底。最后，他表示期望韬朋路工厂的同仁给予协助。出席者暗示，由于此次运动将影响所有工人，他们无法立即答复，将于6月4日星期一召开工人代表全体会议讨论此事。

晚10时20分，陈北德与十二名主要出席代表离开酒楼，在爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）341弄5号大华饭店（Tah Wu Hotel）632室举行秘密会议，会上陈声称韬朋路工厂工人加入罢工势在必行。出席者随后询问工人是否能确获罢工救济金，暗示若无资金，罢工绝难成功。陈承诺将于6月3日星期日就救济金问题给予答复。

Yee Tsoong Workers
Declare Sit-Down Strike

Two thousand workers of the
Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company
went on a sit-down strike at about
5 o'clock yesterday afternoon,
following the refusal of the man-
agement to accede to their demands
for increased wages and higher rice
allowance.
The strikers locked themselves up
in the factory, whereupon the police
was called out and dispersed the
crowd. The management and re-
presentatives of the workers will
try to reach an amicable under-
standing today, it was learned.

SHANGHAI TIMES.
JUL 7 1946

SIT-DOWN STRIKE IN
B.A.T. FACTORY

Police Expel Rioters
When 2,000 Refuse
To Leave Premises

Two thousand employees of the
Yee Tobacco Company Factory on
Thorburn Road were involved in a
sit-down strike yesterday afternoon
when their demands that their half
a month's rice allowance be paid
them at once were refused by the
management.
The disgruntled workers, there-
fore, refused to leave the premises
when the time to close the factory
arrived, stating that they would re-
main there until their demands
were met. During the rioting which
followed, several window panes
were smashed by the workers.
The management, however, lost
no time in reporting the matter to
the police and men from Yulin
Road Station, assisted by the Re-
serve Unit, were dispatched to the
scene of the disturbance. The riot-
ers were thereupon forced out of
the building and quickly dispersed.

July 11, 1940. Morning Translation.

Shun Pao, Sin Wan Pao, Chinese-American Daily News, National Herald :-

YEE TSOONG TOBACCO COMPANY REPATRIATES WORKERS BY FORCE

The entire body of workers of the British-owned Yee Tsoong Tobacco Company at No. 733 Ward Road, more than 3,000 in number, learned that due to the present situation, the company will be reorganized and become American-owned, and that the company will suspend operation for three months. All living allowances and the rice allowance will be non-operative during the period of suspension, and the workers will be paid at 60% of their present wages. In view of the present high cost of living, the workers are greatly concerned at the news.

Representatives of the workers were sent to negotiate with the management yesterday morning demanding that existing conditions be continued. No satisfactory reply has been obtained from the management.

After having finished their work yesterday afternoon, the entire body of workers decided to remain in the factory to await a reply. The police were informed by the management, resulting in more than 200 Chinese and foreign policemen being despatched to the factory, in three or four motor trucks. The workers were forced to board the motor trucks by the policemen. The workers dared not resist, and the policemen therefore succeeded in removing the entire body of workers from the factory premises.

Since this matter gravely threatens them, the workers will send representatives to interview the management to-day and ask for a reply. It is learned that the factory will temporarily suspend operation from to-day.

1940年7月11日。晨间译文。

《申报》、《新闻报》、《中美日报》、《国民新闻》：

颐中烟草公司强行遣返工人

华德路733号英商颐中烟草公司全体工人，人数超过三千，获悉鉴于当前局势，公司将改组为美商所有，并将停业三个月。停业期间所有生活津贴及米贴停止发放，工人工资按现工资的60%支付。鉴于目前生活成本高昂，工人们对此消息深感忧虑。

工人代表于昨日上午前往与管理层谈判，要求维持现状。但未从管理层获得满意答复。

昨日下午下班后，全体工人决定留在工厂内等待答复。管理层通知了警方，导致两百多名中西警员分乘三四辆卡车被派往工厂。工人被警察强迫登上卡车。工人不敢反抗，因此警察成功将全体工人移出工厂区域。

由于此事严重威胁到他们，工人将于今日派代表会见管理层并要求答复。据悉，工厂将从今日起暂时停业。

TWO THOUSAND WORKERS OF B.A.T. CO. ON STRIKE

About 2000 workers of the B. A. T.
Company at No. 175 Soochow Road recently submitted
the following demands to the Company (1) an increase
of pay, (2) Better treatment, (3) Issue of a bonus.

Japanese Halt
S. M. P. Riot
Vans At Bridge

Although complete arrangements had been made previously with the Japanese authorities, two Settlement riot vans sent to Hongkew because of labor unrest at the Yee Tsoong Factory in Theeburn Road, were stopped by a Japanese Naval officer on Garden Bridge, at 3.45 p.m. yesterday.

It was not until one and a half hours later that the vans were allowed to proceed, and in that time, it was stressed by eyewitnesses, anything might have happened at the Yee Tsoong factory.

Eye-witnesses of the incident told THE CHINA PRESS that the Naval officer had happened on the scene, and had detained the vans because Sikh members of the riot squad were carrying carbines.

Representatives Made

Immediate representations were made by high Police authorities to the Japanese Assistant Commissioner of Police, as it had been previously agreed between the Japanese authorities and the Council that the police would not carry Thompson guns into Hongkew, while no mention had been made of rifles and carbines. It had been also agreed that the police would not take action outside Settlement boundaries.

The Japanese Naval officer, however, eye-witnesses continued, objected violently to the carbines being carried, and insisted on the vans being returned.

Reserves Turned Out

In order to expedite the transport of reinforcements to the squad already stationed in Yulin Road, near the factory, a Russian reserve unit was sent across the bridge.

Eye-witnesses also related that during the 90 minutes the vans were held up, the Japanese were polite but firm.

Shanghai Municipal Council authorities last night would not support a rumor that the Japanese action might have been taken as a result of troubles over the boarding of the Asama Maru by officers of a British cruiser.

Interviewed late last night, Major K. M. Bourne, Police Commissioner, said that the matter was still under investigation, and, that negotiations for a satisfactory understanding were proceeding.

Work Resumed

No information on whether the alleged threat of labor trouble in the Yee Tsoong factory had made any progress was available yesterday.

Meanwhile, it was reported that on the release of the three men whose detention had caused a strike at the International Dispensary No. 1 Factory, on Ferry Road, the 200 workers of the plant had resumed operations at 7.00 a.m. on Thursday. The three men's names were Li Chiao-pao, Hsu Chin-san and Shen Hu-keng.
pages.zh:
日军在桥上
拦截工部局警务处
防暴车

尽管此前已与日本当局作出全面安排，但昨日下午3时45分，因韬朋路颐中工厂劳工动荡而派往虹口的两辆租界防暴车，在花园桥被一名日本海军军官拦停。

直到一个半小时后，车辆才被允许通行，目击者强调，在这段时间内，颐中工厂可能发生任何情况。

事件目击者告诉《字林西报》，该海军军官偶然出现在现场，并以防暴队中的锡克族成员携带卡宾枪为由扣留了车辆。

提出即时交涉

高级警务当局立即向日本副警务总监提出交涉，因为日本当局与公董局此前已达成协议，警察不得携带汤姆逊冲锋枪进入虹口，但未提及步枪和卡宾枪。双方还商定，警察不得在租界边界以外采取行动。

然而，目击者继续说道，日本海军军官强烈反对携带卡宾枪，并坚持要求车辆返回。

出动后备队

为了加快向已驻扎在工厂附近榆林路的分队运送增援部队，一支俄国后备队被派过桥。

目击者还叙述道，在车辆被拦截的90分钟内，日本人礼貌但坚定。

上海公共租界工部局当局昨晚不愿支持一种谣言，即日本的行动可能是由于英国巡洋舰军官强行登上浅间丸号（Asama Maru）引发的纠纷所致。

昨晚深夜接受采访时，警务处长 K. M. Bourne 少校表示，此事仍在调查中，正在就达成令人满意的谅解进行谈判。

复工

昨日尚无关于颐中工厂所谓的劳工动荡威胁是否取得任何进展的消息。

与此同时，据报道，在渡边路（Ferry Road）国际药房第一工厂导致罢工的三名被拘留者获释后，该厂200名工人已于周四上午7时恢复作业。这三人的名字是李交宝（Li Chiao-pao）、徐金山（Hsu Chin-san）和沈胡庚（Shen Hu-keng）。

JAN 27 1940

POLICE VANS HALTED
ON GARDEN BRIDGE

Carrying Rifles Into
Japanese Area; Pass
After Short Delay

Two riot vans of the Shanghai
Municipal Police with a party of 52
police were turned back at the Gar-
den Bridge at 4.15 yesterday after-
noon by the Japanese authorities, al-
legedly due to the fact that they
were armed with rifles.
The police party were said to be
proceeding to the premises of one of
the Yee Tsoong Tobacco Co., Ltd.'s
factories where considerable unrest
has existed for the past few days
among the workers. Representa-
tives of the workers, however, are
said to have come to some sort of
an agreement with the management
last evening with a view to settling
the issue.
At the press conference last even-
ing, the Japanese Army spokesman
stated unofficially that he had been
informed that an armed party of the
S.M.P. were proceeding to the
factory but had been halted on the
bridge in view of the fact they were
entering an area of the Japanese
Defence Force in possession of rifles.
Although he stated that police bear-
ing pistols were allowed to pass,
no armed parties were allowed to
pass according to the regulations.
However, the police party were
allowed to pass at 5.15 p.m. since
they had then notified the Japanese
authorities beforehand of their mis-
sion.

警车在
花园桥被拦

携带步枪进入
日方区域；短暂
延误后放行

昨日下午4时15分，上海公共租界工部局警务处的两辆防暴车及一行52名警察在花园桥被日本当局折返，据称原因是他们携带了步枪。
据悉，该警察队伍正前往颐中烟草有限公司的一家工厂，过去几天该厂工人中存在相当程度的不安定情绪。然而，据说工人代表已于昨晚与管理层达成某种协议，以解决此事。
在昨晚的新闻发布会上，日本陆军发言人非正式地表示，他获悉一支武装的工部局警务处队伍正前往工厂，但鉴于他们携带步枪进入日本防卫部队控制区域，因此在桥上被拦停。虽然他声称携带手枪的警察被允许通行，但根据规定，任何武装队伍均不得通行。
然而，该警察队伍于下午5时15分被允许通行，因为他们当时已事先向日本当局通报了他们的任务。

00011
NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS
JAN 27 1940

Japanese Officer
Stops Riot Vans

Police Unable to Cross
Bridge Though Complete
Plans Made Earlier

An officer of the Japanese Naval
Landing Party refused to permit two
riot vans of the S.M.P. Reserve Unit
to cross the Garden Bridge at 3.50
p.m. yesterday afternoon, after they
had been ordered to proceed to the
Ward Road plant of the Yee Tsoong
Tobacco Co., notwithstanding the
fact that during the noon hour ar-
rangements had been made between
the Japanese Naval Landing Party
Headquarters and officials of the
Shanghai Municipal Police.

The police were informed earlier
yesterday that the workers in the
tobacco factory were contemplating
a strike and that negotiations were
being commenced at 3 p.m. While
there was every reason to believe
that the dispute would be amicably
settled, it was held possible that in
the event of no settlement being
reached, the workmen might get out
of hand.

In view of the fact that the effec-
tives stationed in police stations North
of the Creek have been at a minimum
for some time, it was decided to hold
the Reserve Unit ready for any even-
tuality. In order to prevent delays,
high officials of the S.M.P. contacted
the Japanese authorities and arranged
that the Reserve Unit should be sent
over in case of need. It was further-
more agreed that while the S.M.P.
officers would intervene in the fac-
tory itself, the Japanese Naval Land-
ing Party would keep law and order
outside of the premises.

Japanese Wishes Respected

In accordance with the wishes of
the Japanese Naval Landing Party,
the two vans which were ultimately
sent, were manned by 52 foreign and
Sikh members of the S.M.P. and no
Thompson sub-machine guns—al-
though these weapons are usually
carried by the Riot Squad—were
taken along. It was furthermore
agreed that in the event of necessity,
the unit would be supported by all
the effectives which could be muster-
ed at Yulin Road police station.
pages.zh:
00011
《字林西报》
1940年1月27日

日本军官
拦截防暴车

警方虽早前已做好周全
计划，仍无法过桥

昨日下午3时50分，尽管上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.P.）预备队两辆防暴车已奉命前往亿中烟草公司（Yee Tsoong Tobacco Co.）的华德路工厂，且日本海军陆战队总部与上海公共租界工部局警务处官员曾在午间就此事达成安排，但一名日本海军陆战队军官仍拒绝允许这两辆防暴车通过外白渡桥。

警方于昨日早些时候获悉，该烟草厂工人正酝酿罢工，谈判将于下午3时开始。虽然有充分理由相信纠纷将得到和平解决，但也认为若未能达成协议，工人可能会失控。

鉴于苏州河以北各警署的在岗警力近段时间一直处于最低水平，当局决定让预备队待命，以应对任何突发情况。为避免延误，上海公共租界工部局警务处的高级官员联系了日本当局，并商定在必要时派遣预备队过河。双方还同意，上海公共租界工部局警务处警官将在工厂内部进行干预，而日本海军陆战队则负责维持厂区外部的秩序。

尊重日方意愿

根据日本海军陆战队的要求，最终派出的两辆防暴车由52名上海公共租界工部局警务处的外籍和锡克籍警员驾驶，且未携带汤姆逊冲锋枪——尽管防暴队通常配备此类武器。此外双方还商定，如有必要，该分队将由能在榆林路警署集结的所有在岗警力提供支援。

pages.en:
The two vans were consequently
sent towards Hongkew shortly before
4 p.m. When they arrived on the
bridge, the sentry telephoned to local
headquarters and an officer soon ap-
peared. The vans were examined and
just as they were about to continue
on their trip to Ward Road, the officer
in question refused to grant them
permission to do so on the grounds
that the Sikh constables were armed
with carbines. In this connection it
must be pointed out that these wea-
pons are the standard equipment for
Sikh members of the Reserve Unit
and that they had been previously
agreed to by the Japanese authorities
during the conversations which took
place at noon. After conversations
on the spot, which lasted 30 minutes,
and at which a high Japanese S.M.P.
officer, who had also made earlier ar-
rangements in the matter, attended,
the two vans had no alternative but
to return to Gordon Road police
station where they are usually posted.
The vans were permitted to pass
along North Soochow Road then
crossing the Chapoo Road bridge back
to the south side of the Settlement.
At 5:15 p.m. a single van, manned
solely by foreign members of the
Unit, finally was permitted to cross
and on arriving at the tobacco firm's
premises found that fortunately no
trouble had broken out.

Carbines Always Carried

Police officials questioned regarding
the incident last night said that the
conversations on the Garden Bridge
were cordial, although they pointed
out that all arrangements to prevent
just such a hitch at a time when
labour trouble was being expected,
had been made three hours earlier
and all the wishes which the Japanese
authorities had in this connection had
been complied with.
The "North-China Daily News" was
also told that Sikh constables of the
Reserve Unit could not possibly have
been armed with revolvers because
the carbine was their standard wea-
pon. Interesting is also the fact that
at least one half of all the Sikh
watchmen in areas North of the creek
are armed with carbines.
The "stay-in" strike on the part of
the Yee Tsoong workers started early
yesterday afternoon but work was
soon resumed pending negotiations
with the management concerning
hard-times allowances. When ne-
gotiations were satisfactorily conclud-
ed, the Reserve Unit van returned to
its depot.
pages.zh:
因此，这两辆防暴车于下午4时前不久向虹口方向进发。当它们到达桥上时，哨兵打电话给当地指挥部，不久便有一名军官出现。防暴车接受了检查，正当它们准备继续前往华德路时，该名军官以锡克巡捕配备卡宾枪为由，拒绝给予通行许可。在此必须指出，这些武器是预备队锡克籍成员的标准装备，且在午间的会谈中已事先获得日本当局的同意。经过现场持续30分钟的交谈，一位曾参与早前相关事宜安排的上海公共租界工部局警务处高级日本警官也出席了会谈，但这两辆防暴车别无选择，只能返回其通常驻守的戈登路警署。随后，防暴车获准沿北苏州路行驶，经乍浦路桥折返至租界南区。

下午5时15分，一辆仅由该分队外籍成员驾驶的防暴车最终获准过桥，抵达烟草公司厂区后，幸未发现发生骚乱。

卡宾枪系常备装备

昨晚就此事接受询问的警方官员表示，外白渡桥上的交谈气氛融洽，但他们指出，为防止在预期发生劳资纠纷时出现此类阻碍，所有安排早在三小时前就已做好，且日本当局在此方面的所有要求均已得到满足。

《字林西报》还获悉，预备队的锡克巡捕不可能配备左轮手枪，因为卡宾枪是他们的标准武器。另外值得注意的是，苏州河以北地区至少有一半的锡克籍巡捕配备卡宾枪。

亿中工人的“留守”罢工于昨天下午早些时候开始，但在就困难时期津贴与管理层进行谈判期间，工作很快恢复。随着谈判圆满结束，预备队防暴车返回了车库。

January 4. 1940.
Afternoon Translation

MAINICHI

JAPANESE MARINES AND SAILORS TO HOLD
JOINT PARADE

It is reported that at 10 a.m.
January 7 Japanese marines and sailors will hold
a joint parade under Vice-Admiral Ohikawa, Commander
of the Japanese Fleet in China waters, and Rear-
Admiral Takeda, Commander of the Japanese Special
Naval Landing Party. The mechanised unit will
parade on Kiangwan Road and the marines and sailors
in Hongkew Park.
The marines and sailors will march
along the following routes:-
The 1st Company:Kiangwan Road, North Szechuen
Road, Paoshan Road and Jukong Road.
The 2nd Company: North Szechuen Road, Dixwell
Road, Urga Road, Sinkee Pang Road and Seward Road.
The 3rd Company: Kiangwan Road, North Szechuen
Road, Tientungan Road, Paoshing Road, Chungshan
Road and Kungwo Sing Road.
The 4th Company: Kiangwan Road, West Recreation
Club Road, Euyang Road, Ziang Tuh Road, North Szechuen
Road and in front of the Chiyo Yoko.
The 5th Company: North Szechuen Road, North
Soochow Road and in front of the Japanese Consulate-
General.
The 6th Company: North Szechuen Road, Dixwell
Road, Kashing Road, Woosung Road and in front of the
Japanese Imperial Telegraph Office.
The mechanised unit: Kiangwan Road and North
Szechuen Road.

下午译文

《每日新闻》

日本海军陆战队与水兵将举行联合阅兵

据报道，1月7日上午10时，日本海军陆战队和水兵将在驻华日本舰队司令大川（Ohikawa，音译）海军中将和日本特别海军陆战队司令武田（Takeda，音译）海军少将的指挥下举行联合阅兵。机械化部队将在江湾路阅兵，海军陆战队和水兵则在虹口公园阅兵。

海军陆战队和水兵将沿以下路线行进：

第一中队：江湾路、北四川路、宝山路和虬江路。
第二中队：北四川路、狄思威路（Dixwell Road）、乌尔嘎路（Urga Road，音译）、新记浜路（Sinkee Pang Road，音译）和熙华德路（Seward Road）。
第三中队：江湾路、北四川路、天潼路、宝兴路、中山路和公平路（Kungwo Sing，音译）。
第四中队：江湾路、西娱乐会路（West Recreation Club Road，音译）、欧阳路、江土路（Ziang Tuh，音译）、北四川路及千代洋行（Chiyo Yoko，音译）门前。
第五中队：北四川路、北苏州路及日本总领事馆门前。
第六中队：北四川路、狄思威路（Dixwell Road）、嘉兴路、吴淞路及日本帝国电信局门前。
机械化部队：江湾路和北四川路。
